reviews.text: We had a blast at the resort. The food and drinks were all delicious, and the staff's hospitality was amazing and helpful. Scott's is a great place to unwind and hit that reset button. Also, don't forget to get a quick workout session at their cool fitness room.
reviews.author: Cooltown Cardinal

reviews.text: This place is NOT a resort (despite the resort fee they charge). There is no elevator, you have to go through the pool to get to your rooms, the hallways leading to the rooms smell like garbage, and the pool(s) are small and incredibly dirty. It reminded me of an old Motel 6 that was refurbished. I was told I would get a courtyard view but it was a parking lot view. The location is decent - Close to Old Scottsdale and all the shops and restaurants but again,  THIS IS NOT a resort. Staff was kind and very helpful throughout the stay but I was so disappointed when I arrived - The website descriptions are not accurate.
reviews.author: Natalie Boateng

reviews.text:
2026 review: I am so bummed. This was my second stay at this hotel and I only ranked it at 4 stars last time but loved the vibe of the hotel so much that I booked our babymoon here. I upgraded us prior to check in to a king pool view room with early check in that morning at 6 am. When we arrived at the hotel at 2:30 pm. We were told the room was not ready. No problem. We went ahead and went exploring in Scottsdale to kill time. We arrived back at 3:50 pm to check in for the regular 4 pm check in. Told the room still was not ready. We waited in the lobby. Around 4:30 pm went back up to check if the room was ready. They said not yet. That the person checking out of the room we were getting had a dog so it was taking longer to clean. They said they would let us know when the room is ready. 5:10 pm we went up and asked if it was ready yet. They said no. I asked if we could go back to our originally booked room instead of the king pool view upgrade. They said no because those rooms were all full. They offered a parlor suite room as an option. We said we would just wait. 5:30 pm comes around and we go up to them again and just ask for the parlor suite room. Which honestly is a huge downgrade compared to their king and queen rooms. The parlor suite is a Murphy bed set up. How is that an upgrade? Anyways. All that was waived was the resort fee for our troubles. Definitely should have been more since we did not get a room for 90 minutes past check in time.

The room itself was fine. Was a downgrade compared to the two queen room that I had stated in previously.

The hotel pool was fine. It was fairly dirty with things just in the pool. The service was a little slow too.

The cleaning staff does the bare minimum. They didn’t change the sheets or pillow cases at all during our entire 4 night stay. We know because there was one pillow case with a brown/black stain on it that was placed on our bed every single time after they were in our room. We even used a spoon from the coffee spot to eat something. They just put the spoon back in the original place instead of cleaning it and putting it back. We know because we ate left over Mac and cheese and the cheese was still on the spoon. You could see it.

The fact that the pool isn’t full and busy and the spa is amazing is what saves this hotel. The rest of it was terrible.

2024 review: Booked my first night of my trip to the Scott Resort. The lobby itself was beautiful. It’s like you are stepping into a vacation. The atmosphere is calming. The colors are neutral.

The hotel room itself is tastefully updated. You can tell that they did their best with what they could do. It was probably some older hotel that was a little run down that they renovated. You can tell with the decor in the room they were trying to make up for that older building feel.

The property as a whole was beautiful!
reviews.author: Jina Jilek

reviews.text: Just everything I needed in a get away.  The staff was sweet and on point.  The food was interesting and memorable.  It's a beautiful place and you'll see me again soon!
reviews.author: Salu Digby

reviews.text: It’s a conversed motel - photos are so faked angled. Fowl smell, dirty rooms, water smells like sewer, the overall 70s motel is not worth even a drive by - awful! So disappointing with how they entice you with false marketing. Fridge dirty and smells like rotten fruit - absolutely disgusting!
reviews.author: Aggie Maciejowski

reviews.text:
DO NOT STAY HERE - THEY CHARGED US $160 FOR CHECKING OUT EARLY

These people basically took an extra $160 from us for doing something that actually made their job easier.

Our room was already paid for through the following day. We weren't asking for a refund for the unused night. We simply decided to leave the evening before.

Instead of thanking us for freeing up the room early so housekeeping could prepare it for another guest, The Scott Resort decided to charge us an additional $159 "early departure" fee.

When I asked the manager on duty, Ryan Witzke, to explain the logic behind the charge, all I got was, "I'm sorry, sir... it's company policy."

That's not an explanation.

I asked him a simple question: What did the hotel lose?

Nothing.

The room was already paid for. We weren't asking for money back. In fact, by leaving early, we made the room available sooner. Yet somehow that earned us a $159 penalty.

If your only justification for taking someone's money is, "It's company policy," but you can't explain why the policy exists or who it benefits, that's a problem.

And as if that wasn't enough, the bar charged $29 for a single drink. Absolutely ridiculous.

I'll be speaking with the Director of Rooms, Tyler Staten, but based on this experience, I cannot recommend The Scott Resort. If you value fair treatment and common sense, I'd stay somewhere else.
reviews.author: Devon Brown

reviews.text: Amazing decor, bar at canal club, local oriented service, outdoor lounging + great Canal Club bar with killer drinks + service!

reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at The Scott. The property is absolutely beautiful—the lobby, pools, rooms, and spa were all so well done and made the whole experience feel relaxing from start to finish. The staff was friendly, welcoming, and always helpful.

Thank you for such a great stay. We would definitely come back and highly recommend The Scott to anyone visiting Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Taylor Persico

reviews.text:
⭐️ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at The Scott Hotel. I booked this stay specifically because it is advertised as a dog-friendly hotel, and I arrived with my two French Bulldogs expecting a welcoming environment.

Shortly after checking in, I stepped outside with my dogs to the shared outdoor patio/balcony area. My dogs were not barking, causing any disturbance, or bothering anyone. They were simply outside with me. A neighbor immediately came out of his room, aggressively confronted me, and started yelling about my dogs being outside. I told him it’s a dog friendly hotel. I was shocked, especially because this is a dog-friendly property and my dogs were not on his patio, not creating noise, and not doing anything inappropriate.

After this interaction, I received a knock on my door from hotel management stating that there was a noise complaint from the same neighbor. This was frustrating and upsetting because there was no barking or noise issue — we had just arrived. The only negative interaction was the neighbor’s hostile behavior toward me.

I spoke with the hotel manager and filed a complaint because I felt harassed over something that was completely unreasonable. It was extremely uncomfortable and impacted our entire stay.

Guests should be aware that although this is a dog-friendly hotel, bringing your pets may result in conflict with other guests who are not respectful of that environment. I came here to enjoy a normal stay and instead spent my time dealing with an unnecessary situation. Unfortunately, because of this experience, I would not stay here again.
reviews.author: Christina Cardenas

reviews.text: Sehr schönes, stylisches Hotel im modernen Ambiente. Die Zimmer mit Garten-/Lagunenblick hatten ihren persönlichen Charme, die Pools waren einfach traumhaft. Die Getränke und Speisen sind sehr lecker. Das Frühstück war herausragend!

reviews.text:
Absolutely wonderful!! The grounds and room are absolutely stunning, stylish and very clean/updated. Staff were all incredibly warm and welcoming. Quiet, even though I was right next to the pool. The perfect balance of fun daytime vibes and very mellow, relaxing quiet outside those hours. Food was exceptional as well. Standout bartender made me the best “Spanish coffee” this morning - wow! Perfect walking distance to old town. Very close to a pretty walking path along a canal. Good little gym.

Will definitely be back. I can see why our business accelerator group keep coming back year over year!

reviews.text: Went here for a company retreat. Didn't take more than an hour to call the Mrs and tell her we need to come back to The Scott for a vacation. The pool area is what caught my eye. Tons of areas to lounge around and the pools are will designed. You get that big resort feeling without the big resort prices. The rooms are very clean and the beds were super comfortable. I heard a lot of colleagues mention they had the best night sleep ever in a long time because of them. Can't wait to get back there.

reviews.author: Jason DeBruler

reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience at The Scott and cannot recommend it enough — especially for weddings and events. We also stayed at the hotel ourselves, and our stay was absolutely wonderful from start to finish. The property is beautiful, relaxing, and so thoughtfully designed, and every staff member we interacted with was welcoming and attentive. It truly created such a special overall experience for us and our guests.

The true standout of our experience was Avery, the event coordinator. She was beyond amazing to work with throughout the entire process. Avery was responsive, organized, patient, and genuinely cared about every detail. Planning an event can be stressful, but she made everything feel so easy and handled every question and request with kindness and professionalism. It’s rare to find someone who is not only exceptional at their job but also such a calming and supportive presence during the planning process.

Although we ultimately decided to go in a different direction simply because we had a very specific personal vision for our wedding, I would still highly recommend The Scott to anyone looking for a beautiful venue with outstanding service. The experience we had there was nothing but positive, and Avery specifically made such a lasting impression on us. We are so grateful for everything she did to make our experience so special.
reviews.author: Elle Becker

reviews.text:
We stayed one night twice whilst on a road trip and have to say it was the best hotel stay we had during our 17 day holiday. I would go so far as to say this hotel impressed us beyond words. Firstly the beautiful decor inside and the outdoor pool area and seating  were gorgeous, somewhere where you could relax in tasteful luxury. The pool had plentiful sunbeds and towels nicely spaced out with lovely views from all aspects. The bar staff were true professionals in the art of making cocktails which could be adapted to personal tastes and they were spectacular !! I personally thought menu was a little limited in variation but the food we had on both occasions was cooked to perfection. we did not have the opportunity to use the spa or gym so cannot comment on those facilities. The rooms were spacious, well equipped with a good mini bar selection and a good array of quality toiletries. There was an available spacious car park on site and also a free shuttle service into town in a nostalgic American old classic car.
However the thing that impressed us the most were the amazing staff, making you feel like individual special guests rather than just another customer. We were greeted by Ava both days who was so lovely and welcoming and even gave us a drink noting it was my birthday. On our return she remembered us and again made us feel like friends returning...an absolute delightful member of staff. Whilst at The Scott Resort we also met Tony , I believe he was the manager on duty on both visits. He came to speak to us on numerous occasions checking everything was ok during our stay and could not do enough to help us. It was so lovely to be personally recognised by Tony who was busy but always had time to stop and talk to us and made our stay feel very special. These are only two examples of an excellent team of staff and for us it was the staff that set this hotel a class above the rest.
reviews.author: Stella Guest

reviews.text: 5 stars isn’t high enough ! I came for a staycation, I’m a local and I live and work in the area so I’ve explored a lot of the resorts and restaurants. First off, the resort itself is super cool and inviting from the minute you walk into the lobby. Chic, cool , elegant vibes take you away. My room was perfectly appointed. Went to to the pool and met some of the great staff, Austin was my bartender mixing up delicious cocktails but with personal experience and conversation to ensure my time was enjoyed. Next went for dinner to canal club,  servers Tye and Alexa both showed true hospitality with their guest service.  Food was impeccable, presentation and flavor on point. Manager Hailey made me me feel welcomed and appreciated. Highly recommend this weather your a local or visiting. Location is perfect for everything Scottsdale has to offer
reviews.author: Jeremy W Dawson

reviews.text: The Scott Resort & Spa is a stunning oasis in Old Town Scottsdale. The lush, tropical lobby and "Havana-inspired" decor create an immediate vacation vibe. We loved the sandy beach pool and sipping craft cocktails at The Canal Club. The service was top-notch, and being steps away from Fashion Square was incredibly convenient. A perfect, photogenic sanctuary!

reviews.author: F

reviews.text:
Really nice property overall with a lot to like. The renovation of the public spaces is very well done and gives the hotel a great feel right when you walk in.

The rooms themselves are comfortable and well put together. That said, there are a few practical issues that stood out. Getting to the rooms can be a bit challenging with uneven steps, especially when rolling luggage, and there’s no elevator for second-floor rooms, which makes it less accessible than it should be.

It’s nice that water is available in the lobby, but it would go a long way if they provided at least one complimentary bottle in the room, especially since the in-room bottles are priced at $10.

The shower setup could also use some improvement, as water tends to spray outside of the shower area.

On the service side, the front desk team was friendly and helpful. The only negative experience was with the shuttle driver, who came across as unfriendly unless tipped generously, which didn’t feel great.

Overall, it’s a well-designed, comfortable hotel with a strong foundation, just a few operational details to tighten up.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text:
This place was amazing! The room was clean and comfortable. I enjoyed the private patio where I was able to read and enjoy some peace and quiet. My only complaint was that the bed was a bit too soft for me. That is my personal preference.

Most of all, this was my first solo trip and I felt safe. The food from the restaurant was delicious. Austin, Riley, and Zach from the bar were amazing! Very patient and got every order right! Also, the DJ that was there on Friday night made the ambiance so much better.

The pool and jacuzzi area was nice, comfortable, and clean. And the spa was sooooo relaxing. I got the 75 min body scrub with the added on foot treatment. It was nice to have the complimentary champgane after. Overall i really enjoyed my stay and can't wait to come back! The Scott is alright with me.
reviews.author: Karen Harlan

reviews.text: The first floor rooms allow any bystander walking by to see everything, so you essentially have to have the curtains pulled shut the while time, so no view of anything. Bed was comfortable.
reviews.author: Danielle Waterfield

reviews.text: I had the pleasure playing violin here for a few weddings and IT IS GORGEOUS HERE!!! The staff is not only amazing, but it’s the perfect venue for a wedding. It is so unique! I love it here.
reviews.author: Esko Violin

reviews.text:
I really wanted to love this place because the lobby is absolutely stunning—completely Instagram worthy and perfect for photos. However, once you get past the initial entrance, the reality of the stay sets in.
The rooms are incredibly dated and clearly showing their age. The most unbearable part, though, was the smell. There is a persistent, overwhelming odor of old pipes and sewage that lingers in the rooms. It made it very difficult to feel comfortable or relaxed.
To make matters worse, while some employees were fine, a few of the staff members were noticeably rude and unhelpful when issues were brought up. Between the plumbing smells and the inconsistent service, it is simply not worth the price they are charging. You're better off going elsewhere; a pretty lobby isn't worth living with a sewer smell.
reviews.author: carol shin

reviews.text: I’ve stayed here a few times and I think this past stay is our last.  The shower was so full of mold I just don’t understand how they don’t spray these showers down with bleach after each guest. I had to move rooms because I guess they had no one to clean it. I even offered to just bring me so bleach spray and I would clean it. Also if you dont wake up at 8 am you will not have a pool chair just an fyi.
reviews.author: Tara Jones

reviews.text: I really can't say enough nice things about this place and our stay. We typically stay at Marriott Bonvoy properties but decided to stay here because of the sandy beach for our five year old. And it more than delivered! Not only that, it's rare that a hotel restaurant is a favorite from an entire vacation but The Canal Club delivered. Huge portions, great flavor and Tye is a great manager! Def want to come back, even though it's not on Bonvoy!
reviews.author: Matt Matros

reviews.text: It really is a luxury resort. However, hygiene could be better maintained around tje pools. Also, navigation is difficult. Plus, the free shuttle they provide is extremely slow.
reviews.author: The Quiet Critic

reviews.text:
I was very disappointed with my stay, primarily due to the condition of the room and the pool environment.

Upon entering the room, there was a strong sewer-like odor that made it very unpleasant. I contacted maintenance, and while they responded promptly and were courteous, they informed me the smell was likely due to issues with the sewer pipes. Although they attempted to fix it, the odor persisted throughout my stay, which significantly impacted my comfort.

Additionally, the pool area was not a relaxing environment. There were numerous children playing loudly—throwing footballs, jumping into the pool, and playing games like Marco Polo. While I understand that families use the pool, it made it difficult for adults to relax, read, or enjoy a peaceful experience. It would be a great improvement if there were a designated adults-only pool or quiet area.

Overall, these issues made the stay far less enjoyable than expected.
reviews.author: Shaun Wilson

reviews.text: This resort could be 5 stars. Avid traveler here...The decor, music and vibe is nice, however where it misses the mark is there should be a designated pool for families with kids and one for adults trying to relax. As I sit here poolside now, its hard to relax when parents let there kids use the pool like there own personal pool throwing footballs as people are trying to just relax and read books or wade in pool to also the annoying sound of Marco polo. There are two pools. Make one adults only. Many guests we encountered felt the same. Children should be able to play in the pool, but be respectful of guests trying to relax and not be hit with footballs. A simple fix would be a family friendly pool and an adults only. Another lack was our poolside room got worse each day of sewage smell that hit you when you opened the door. We complained and maintenance came and just sprayed and said it was due to older plumbing.  We paid a premium here and should not have to sleep in a room that smells like sewer and musky smell! Such a disappointment because this place has the opportunity to be perfection with some changes. We did like the complementary shuttle. Would love to come back, if these changes were made.

reviews.text: Super boutique-y. Love the nespresso machines in the room. Love the shuttle service they provide. Staff is all so friendly. Food is good. The almond butter toast is too dry, you can skip it. The portion sizes are great. I was a solo traveler and felt safe. It seems like a great place for groups to stay—so may areas to hang in large groups or small around the resort. The “off the garden” rooms were so quiet—no noise pollution spill from the busy part of the resort. Definitely worth the extra money to not be looking into the parking lot or the potentially noisy pool.
reviews.author: Maggie Spanuello

reviews.text: I held a 2-day business meeting at the resort. The team we worked with to set it all up was excellent, the meeting room, staff and food were awesome! The resort itself is a must stay, overall experience was 5-star. The pool looked amazing!
reviews.author: Darren Califano

reviews.text: Not what we were expecting for the price point. This hotel had cool vibe but was lacking in quality of food and overall experience.  The pool was nice and we liked our balcony view.  But the hotel room smelled of musty dog urine and there was a French fry on the carpet. The staff was nice, except for one of the front desk receptionist.  Food was okay, not exciting tasting. We appreciated the free shuttle service. |Overall we wouldn't stay here again.
reviews.author: 308emt

reviews.text: The Scott is a lovely resort and spa in central Scottsdale. You have close access to lots of restaurants and bars, as well as the old town. The staff are friendly, and the resort is relatively quiet and enjoyable. If you're looking for a pool to hang out at all day and restaurants and shopping nearby, The Scott is a great choice.
reviews.author: Grant Glaser

reviews.text: The Reaort grounds are beautiful and the pools are nice. Our furst room was dark overlooking some gravel and I complained as I had asked for poolside or pool view. The next day I was moved and the difference in light was night and day. From depressing to beautiful. The balcony overlooked the pool area and was much brighter. Room cleaning service was amazing but the food service on the restaurant was hit and miss. One morning I got up 5 times to ask for more coffee, jam, the toast thy forgot and so on. The manager saw me getting up and didn't offer me anything or say sorry . I went to the front desk and complained and the hotel manager said he would take care of the breakfast but at checkout today the breakfast was still on there. They did of course comp it but glad I checked. Overall a nice hotel but expect service by the pool or in the restaurant to be hit and miss.
reviews.author: moniquewG8107EX

reviews.text:
The pools are very nice!  It does have a relaxing atmosphere.  The location is a little too far north to walk to Old Town but they shuttles that will take you around a 3 mile radius and the drivers are super friendly.

My issue is the water coming out of the taps and shower smelled VERY strongly of sulfur / rotten eggs.  You could not drink it.  Our hair smelled of sulfur after showering.  It stripped my natural curls out of my hair and took out hair dye.  So be prepared.

Also the bartenders are very rabid about asking for IDs for drinks and not letting anyone under 21 even sit at the bar (even when ordering non-alcohol drinks).  I saw little kids ask for "a drink" and the bartender told them no because they thought they wanted alcohol (or were ordering for a parent).  The kid just wanted a Pepsi.  This place should just be 21+ since it was a real pain.

The Wi-Fi is very slow and often spotty.  I just relied on 5G.  Something to keep in mind if you really need Wi-Fi access.

But the water smell alone (pool were fine - just in the rooms) will not have me returning.  I have not experienced this issue at other hotels in Arizona - even other hotels in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Kim Bartels

reviews.text: My husband and I went to the spa for massages. He got a Swedish massage which he liked a lot but I got a few tissue massage by Briana and omg it was the BEST deep tissue massage I’ve ever gotten. I like a lot of pressure and she 100% delivered. I feel so relaxed now!
reviews.author: Jk6891

reviews.text: OK, I stopped here simply because I had a layover and it looked pretty great from a tiny little online thumb now, but this is so special of one of the most beautiful excellently interior and specially designed hotels. I have been to even globally that I am literally coming back with my mom when I can.  It is the space alone that is breathtaking. There are many excellent design, details and attentive, wise and amenities wise is no less than excellent.  Definitely stuck here if you are anywhere within the Phoenix area.!!
reviews.author: Tara Phoenix

reviews.text: Truly one of the best hotel experiences we’ve ever had. The hotel itself is absolutely stunning. Pools are amazing, they play old films outside at night, and multiple fire pits and seating. What really sets this hotel apart though is the service and staff. Every single person we interacted with was so polite and made us feel so welcome. The staff here goes out of their way to make your experience special and make you feel catered to. The bartenders, hostesses, and practically anyone we spoke with remembered our names and just made us feel like we were friends. We will 100% be returning, and hope they continue to go above and beyond for their guests because it makes a difference. Thank you!!!!
reviews.author: Courtney Cullen

reviews.text:
Just spent a week at the Scott.  It was lovely.  As people have mentioned, the staff are top notch - great service and so personable.

Food was delicious.  Francine at the spa was amazing.  Overall a really great experience.
reviews.author: Kit Mudd

reviews.text: This hotel is a small scale luxury resort with beautiful grounds and a lovely pool, greatly shaded, which in AZ is perfect.  cabanas are available as well for additional fee.  There is a separate but connected "beachy" area with a kids wading area and adult section as well.  Food is limited but very good, bar staff excellent.  It is on Scottsdale Road but you cannot hear the road and so it feels serene.  Since the food options are limited and there isn't any tennis or golf, a shorter stay  is perfect.  they do have bikes available and it's close to lots of shopping and restaurants.
reviews.author: Sarah Koloms

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with great amenities, friendly staff, and close to plenty to do.
reviews.author: Zach Don

reviews.text: Loved this place, the workers were overly friendly and I appreciated that.  Only complaint i have and I don't think it's their fault, google maps takes you to the side parking lot instead of main entrance... this is also the case with the Waymo driverless cars.. I never could get them.to pick me up infront.  Still minor issue that's probably not their fault, I was SUPER impressed with this place!!!
reviews.author: Trent Nunnelee

reviews.text:
If you love the esthetic, come and have a meal and stay for a drink in the lobby - that’s the best part!! But I’d find somewhere else to stay for the price.

We stayed at the Scott for two nights in March. The resort lobby was stunning, very well maintained and very beautiful!! When we checked in around 5pm, the front desk help was not very welcoming and it was an awkward encounter. We were not briefed on any of the amenities, pool times or parking. The bellmen were so friendly and answered our questions.

The hallway to our room was warn down and The gates/doors with key card access were open or unlatched 90% of the time. Not a secure property but we never felt unsafe per say. Our room was very well designed and decorated, just worn down. The bathroom door was off so it was nearly impossible to close.  Bed was comfy and we slept good. Walls were thin and could hear any walking above us, they seemed to start working on repairs in the hall about 8am and that was very loud.

Overall for the price, it was not worth it for us and I would not recommend. It needs some maintenance and upkeep and the amenities could offer more for the price.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Hashley

reviews.text: We've stayed here over and over, for nearly 10 years because of the outstanding vibe, wonderful staff and grounds. It is so convenient to walk to restaurants!
reviews.author: Sandra Dunst

reviews.text: Kind staff, great service, food and location!
reviews.author: fredia Hawthorne

reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful resort. I loved the vibe kind of Palm Royal vibes. Bed was very comfortable and very comfortable room overall. Great location.
reviews.author: Erika

reviews.text: My daughter and I went here for the massage and OMG it was amazing!
reviews.author: Valery Garcia

reviews.text:
Great location near Old Scottsdale;  complementary shuttle to the historic area where lots of easy walking sights and restaurants are located.
Nice driving distance (via Uber/Lyft or rental car) to outstanding Musical Instruments Museum, Botanical Gardens, Frank Lloyd Wright area, and butterfly museum.
Hotel property is beautifully landscaped, with serene areas for eating/drinking, reading, swimming and relaxing.
reviews.author: Marjie Witman

reviews.text:
Attended a wedding here. The venue is beautiful, lush and gorgeous with lots of fountains. The steak was the best I've ever had! The cheese table was incredible, the bartender was great as were the front desk gals. Even with guests in the pool, it still felt private and very serene. No detail was overlooked, truly gorgeous!

My only critique was one of the servers, he was passing out hors d'oeuvres and the champagne, he really seemed like he did not like his job and was rude and condescending. Middle aged guy, dark hair, possiblly Hispanic but didn't catch his name. Other than that, this place was absolutely amazing!!
reviews.author: Karen Erickson

reviews.text: Lovely hotel. The first thing you notice is the 1956 BelAir in the front courtyard and the unique  character continues to flow reflected in every detail throughout. Greeted with a lobby that smelled beautiful with their signature spa scent and fresh cold beverage station..|Staff were wonderful, especially the gentlemen at the front who coordinated the complementary transportation. Pool cleaners, gardeners, housekeepers all greeted us with smiles and a hello.|Rooms are clean, comfortable with all amenities.|Pool and hot tub were perfect temperatures and lounge chairs comfortable. We ordered a drink at the lobby bar and enjoyed the ambiance.|A wonderful experience. It loses a star for the high prices. Our 2 drinks, wine and martini, were $50 US which is rather steep. Mornings coffees were $8 US each. We dined off the resort to explore local eateries. Also found having to use keycard several times to get to our room was a bit of an inconvenience. (At pool entry, at hall entry, at room entry)
reviews.author: abbyford

reviews.text: A real gem
reviews.author: Rachael Aragon

reviews.text: A beautiful resort and a ton of small touches that really shined.
reviews.author: Tatiana Cecelia

reviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous hotel. Feels very zen and perfect for a true getaway. Loved the pool, the rooms, the spa, the lobby, etc. I will agree with others comments that one of the pools did end up being closed for a whole afternoon during our stay. Luckily we were able to get seats at the other pool but this was a little disappointing as it was the bar pool that was closed. But we truly loved our experience here! You can also walk easily to old town within 15 minutes and you can also hop on the Arizona canal trail for walking/running
reviews.author: Courteney Stewart

reviews.text: Great staycation spot for us. Will be back again soon.
reviews.author: Brian Ginsberg

reviews.text: Such a beautiful place to relax. Great amenities.
reviews.author: Bria Norris

reviews.text: Lovely accommodations; friendly staff, super clean and the pool area is beautiful. I was there for work, so did not have a chance to use the pool or spa, but the food was amazing.
reviews.author: Ken D

reviews.text: My friend and I accidentally ended up at the wrong resort. We decided to stay for lunch. The decor at this resort is exceptional. We sat outside and while service was a little slow, the food was awesome! Highly recommend the Cobb salad and the pomegranate/squash salad. Big portions and really fresh!
reviews.author: Will and Stephanie Barth

reviews.text: Great property, good location, staff was excellent.
reviews.author: Phil Coosaia

reviews.text: This resort is nice, but its not worth the price you pay to stay there. You can stay across the street at Embassy Suites way cheaper. The gentlemen who drive the shuttle are AMAZING! ALL VERY friendly and gave us good places to eat and see.
reviews.author: April Marth

reviews.text: I didn't stay here, but attended a conference and absolutely loved the space!! The hotel itself is absolutely gorgeous, every room is so thoughtfully designed and flows into the next. The plants all look so healthy and happy which makes such a difference! There are TONS of spaces for you to sit, relax, or enjoy a drink. The drinks and food are pricey but delicious and good portions. The staff is probably the best part of the hotel...even though I wasn't staying there, they went out of their way to make me feel comfortable and welcomed! Everyone was so nice and friendly, I will absolutely stay here next time I'm in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Lauren Harrington

reviews.text: Friendly staff, beautiful hotel and facilities, extremely clean, and easy access to Old Town.  Will definitely be staying at The Scott Resort again!
reviews.author: Genell Siemens

reviews.text: Close to airport, unique and the staff in every area was incredible.
reviews.author: Angela Palo

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with excellent staff and atmosphere!
reviews.author: Jennifer Hill

reviews.text: More impressive once you get inside than from the road. Great vibe. Smaller and accessible. Location right down the road from Old Town Scottsdale. Nice restaurant. Great lobby/bar area.
reviews.author: Mike Helander

reviews.text: Beautiful property. Outstanding staff from check-in yo checkout. Every person was outstanding which seems impossible but is true. Gorgeous room and relaxing spots all around to tuck into.
reviews.author: Roni Bell

reviews.text: This hotel and staff are truly top-notch. From the moment you arrive, the team delivers a true white-glove experience and makes you feel exceptionally well cared for.||I stayed for four days while attending a conference, and unlike most conference hotels where food can be hit or miss, the dining here was outstanding. Every meal was fresh, thoughtfully prepared, and absolutely delicious, with great variety and quality throughout the stay.||I was so impressed that I’m already planning to return with my family for a long weekend getaway. Highly recommend.||OH and they have a shuttle that will take you around up to a 3 mile radius. See what I mean?  Yeah you should go!
reviews.author: CMz122

reviews.text: This is a beautiful hotel with a very friendly staff. We very much enjoyed the pool, hot tub, delicious food at the restaurant, and the overall beauty of the grounds. The room was clean and comfortable. We will definitely be staying there again.
reviews.author: Kristen Ramos

reviews.text: The most beautiful hotel in the heart of Scottsdale! It has a very boutique feel to it. Gorgeous property, great service and close to everything. Our favorite place to stay in Scottsdale and can't recommend it enough!
reviews.author: Marissa Whisman

reviews.text: Accommodations, cleanliness and staff were great, although we have had identical experiences at accommodations for half the price.
reviews.author: Donna Heer

reviews.text:
My wife and I recently got married at the Scott Resort & Spa. The venue was beautiful, the food tasted great, and the day of service was good. That's where the positives end.

Communication with anyone at the resort in advance of the event was nothing short of a nightmare that made the overall experience so much more stressful than it needed to be. Our event planner was unreliable and took weeks to get in contact with. It seemed like she didn't know what she was doing and often took over a week to respond every time we reached out via email. The housing and billing manager had to be told to fix several mistakes with the booking of our contracted rooms, one of which took 3 tries to finally get the correct end result. The planning process fell behind schedule on multiple occasions, and the only reason the day of the wedding went so well is because of how amazing our 3rd party day-of coordinator was.

There is evidently a total lack of communication between operating arms at the resort. During our menu tasting, we were provided food that apparently was not included in our package. The day of the wedding we were told that one of the meals we tasted would not be available, despite us asking for it directly. We also received complaints from multiple guests that the person working the front desk didn't have any idea there was even a wedding that day and could not direct guests to the ceremony location.

The rooms were fine, but not worth the price. Even at the discounted price offered under our event contract (which was about 60% off), the rooms were underwhelming and didn't feel very "luxury." Some of our guests even had a few issues with their rooms, such as a mildew smell and a broken sink.

Overall the venue is pretty and the serving staff during the reception were great, but everyone else we worked with made the process much harder than it needed to be. The rooms didn't feel worth the price, and their communication with us was shaky at best. Save yourself the trouble of booking an event here.
reviews.author: Kristopher Steelmon

reviews.text: There are not enough words to describe the amazing vibe at the Scott.  It's like Palm Springs meet Hawaii!  I needed a little staycation for 1 and it was PERFECT!  My room was amazing - the patio was quiet and calm and beautiful.  The grounds are incredible - lush, tropical, calming water features and serene fire pits with boho seating.  There are so many little sitting places to just escape to, sit a cocktail and enjoy some peace.  Dinner at the restaurant was so delicious - I had the Crispy Salmon - YUM!  The cocktails were delicious.  My room had an adorable cocktail cart and a Nespresso machine.  All the little details in this hotel/resort make every difference in a setting that is peaceful, fun and just good for the soul!
reviews.author: Kelly King

reviews.text:
Basic, spare room with poor lighting. The bed was a Murphy bed with a frame that stuck out way too far and the collar matched the floor so we have multiple bruises from it. The bed was uncomfortable and there was no luxurious bedding.
The staff were not rude but not very friendly.
reviews.author: Deborah Dinsdale

reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful; the grounds are immaculate and location unbeatable. The drinks are really good. Overall, we have stayed at the Phoenician, and this is better.
reviews.author: Jill D

reviews.text: Great overall stay! We have stayed for girls weekends, and for couples weekends and both have been enjoyed. Location cannot be beat for closeness to old town and fashion square mall. Staff are all so kind, room service was very quick and the hotel has a more boutique feel for a less intense stay then at the Phoenician or Fairmont which we have stayed and enjoyed as well.
reviews.author: Amanda Olivari

reviews.text: We had an amazing experience during our stay at this resort. From the moment we arrived, the staff was welcoming, professional, and incredibly helpful. The food was so delicious and consistently well prepared. Our room was spotless, comfortable, and relaxing. Everything was well organized and exceeded our expectations. We truly enjoyed our time here and would gladly stay again.
reviews.author: Mrs. W

reviews.text: One of my favourite trip experiences. What a beautiful resort.
reviews.author: Mellissa Britt

reviews.text: I had an amazing stay at the Scott this past weekend. I had the good fortune for my conference. The hotel was beautiful and well appointed. It was unfortunately too cold to enjoy the pool or hot tub area but those areas were lovely and well maintained.  The staff is terrific. Every single employee was helpful and friendly.  The water pressure in the bathroom was AMAZING, best shower I've had in a long time!  The ONLY thing that I didn't love was that the bed and pillows were too soft for me.  I slept well but had some difficulty falling asleep at night.  Other than that, the rooms were well appointed and nicely decorated.
reviews.author: Ronda Roemmelt Sneider

reviews.text:
The hotel is fine but old and it shows in the bathrooms. Our shower has discoloration and for some reason the plumbing was installed backwards on the sink. At the special price we were able to get with a Black Friday deal it was fine (like 550.00 a night) but when we asked about extending our stay one day because our plane was cancelled we were quoted over $800 for the night. There were many empty rooms as it was a Monday night. We checked in next door for half the price.
Four glasses of a basic wine at the bar was over $100 before tip. Lunch for four ( sandwiches and two beers each ) was over $250. This is a nice hotel and the staff were very helpful but it’s priced like the Ritz Carlton and it’s not that.
reviews.author: doug Moore

reviews.text: Boutique hotel with the best bar, great restarant and pool area as well as a fantastic spa!
reviews.author: Christy Hakman

reviews.text: We hosted our company awards ceremony here and had a great experience. The staff was incredible accommodating, the space was amazing, the food was delicious. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: W and P operation s

reviews.text: We had a great stay! Yanis at the front desk, Zach in the bar, Chance in the restaurant, Haley and Francine in the spa — the entire staff is fabulous. The decor is lovely and the atmosphere unique. We’ll definitely be back!
reviews.author: Shannon Ewing

reviews.text: I had an absolutely wonderful massage experience at The Scott with Angela. From the moment I arrived, everything felt calm, welcoming, and thoughtfully done. Angela is incredibly skilled. She listened carefully to what I needed and tailored the massage perfectly. Her touch was both relaxing and effective, and I left feeling completely refreshed, loose, and re-centered. You can tell she truly cares about her clients and her craft. This was hands-down one of the best massages I’ve had, and I can’t wait to come back. Highly recommend Angela at The Scott!
reviews.author: B8850UWshannons

reviews.text: I was here for a 2-day work event, with about 150 colleagues last week; it was a great experience. The hotel was beautifully decorated, the pool area was amazing, and the rooms were top-notch! Very clean, and just a great vibe overall.

reviews.text: Great hotel for conferences and family fun!

reviews.text: Well maintained vintage hotel with rooms that are large, updated and well appointed.  The bed and linens were luxurious and super comfortable.  They had plenty of staff that were always courteous and helpful.  The property  is very large and spread out but grounds were immaculate and well maintained.  The pool was very clean.  The meeting rooms were conducive for business and the staff unobtrusive...they were readily present but you really didn't know they were there.  I wish I could have stayed longer to enjoy everything they had to offer.

reviews.text: Fitness center should have better equipment and more space

reviews.text: Hotel was lovely and staff was wonderful!

reviews.text: A destination for lovers. Staff were amazing and went above and beyond to ensure our comfort. We will be back. Thank you Scott Resort & Spa

reviews.text: Over all great place to stay
reviews.author: Vijay Reddy

reviews.text: Unreal!!! I will be staying here every time I am in Scottsdale. The Spa, Service, Food, everything was incredible!
reviews.author: Nick Melnyk

reviews.text: Beautiful place and back patio. Nice drinks, fireplace and staff. The food was unremarkable.
reviews.author: HippieJoe Rex

reviews.text: Fantastic resort. We held our conference here and it was perfect. The ambiance was crazy good - fires, water features, music and lots of private seating.  The venue itself fit exactly our needs.  The food was fantastic and the snacks between breaks were unlike I’ve seen at any other venue - huge variety and large sizes.
reviews.author: Jason Hunt

reviews.text:
I recently organized our company holiday party at The Scott Resort & Spa, and it was truly a wonderful experience from start to finish. The event was a success, and our decision to choose The Scott was an easy one thanks to its ideal location, excellent value, beautiful amenities, comprehensive event packages, and—most importantly—exceptional customer service.

Out of the six to nine venues I toured, Maddie at The Scott was the only person who proactively reached out and invited me in for a tour. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with a warm smile, a welcoming demeanor, and even a thoughtful gift—an impressive first impression.

Once we secured the venue, Donna Eastwood, our Events Coordinator, was attentive, kind, and incredibly organized throughout the entire planning process. Norma and the Banquets team, along with their department head, were eager to assist and ensured everything ran smoothly. Avis in Reservations was also wonderful, helping us seamlessly manage our guest room block.

From beginning to end, the level of service, professionalism, and genuine hospitality was outstanding. The property itself is stunning, rich in history, and impeccably maintained, which made our event even more memorable.

I sincerely hope these team members receive recognition for their hard work—whether through acknowledgment, time off, or a well-deserved bonus. If you are searching for a venue for a special occasion, I wholeheartedly recommend The Scott Resort & Spa. You’ll find not only a beautiful setting, but a team that truly cares about delivering an exceptional experience.
reviews.author: Tina Scherling

reviews.text:
The Scott offers upscale rooms that are reasonably priced considering the hotel's location (near Fashion Square and within walking distance of Old Town). However, they are basic - if you want to watch anything on a streaming service (Netflix, Prime, etc.), you have to use a personal device to connect (it's a bit confusing at first). Room didn't have any information about the hotel, shopping, recreational opportunities nearby. Our hotel phone wasn't labeled, so we had to call the front desk with our personal phones.
The Scott has one restaurant that is pricey (but good), a bar with $20 cocktails and a spa that offers facials and massages only. T
The staff was attentive and responsive - no issues there!
reviews.author: Julie Edgar

reviews.text: Clean quiet room facing the back parking lot area.
reviews.author: Anthony Arismendez

reviews.text: Great place for company holiday parties!
reviews.author: J Sand

reviews.text:
The Scott is 11/10 on every level!
We enjoyed a 4 night stay celebrating our anniversary and everything was above and beyond. From cleanliness, friendliness, relaxation, appearance - truly everything.
If you are looking for a beautiful getaway that is in the perfect location and in walking distance from everything - this is your place. You will be so happy you did it!

reviews.text: There were some really good parts but mostly it wasn’t worth the price.||Location is good—walkable to lots of shopping, restaurants, etc. Ubers and Waymo readily available. reviews.text: I was blown away by how accommodating the staff was; the rooms were beautiful, the landscaping was stunning, and it was truly the best hotel experience I’ve ever had. They let guests enjoy the fire pits as late as they’d like, never nickel and dimed us for the little things you’d expect at other hotels, and every interaction with the staff felt genuine and thoughtful. Everything from the room to the grounds exceeded my expectations. I can’t wait to come back.
reviews.author: Kay R

reviews.text:
We were able to check in a little early, which was appreciated. The lobby was great and so was the pool area. Beyond that it was very average. While we didn’t use the transportation included with the resort fee, it does seem like a nice amenity.

The room itself was fairly ordinary and nothing special. If you’re mindful about spending and want room service:  a burger + Cobb salad + 23% fee + $5 fee + 22% tip ≈ $83. The wedding we attended was a blast, but we were also loud. If I was a regular guest with an adjacent room to the event I’d be upset with the noise.

Unless you’re celebrating a special occasion with loved ones or don’t mind paying extra for the atmosphere, I’m not sure it’s worth the price. At $800 for two nights (even with a wedding block discount), I would likely look elsewhere.
reviews.author: Jesus Fuentes

reviews.text:
Our stay had both highlights and disappointments.
There was a noticeable lack of hospitality — no greetings or warm interactions from the front desk, which set a cold tone for the visit and continued on throughout our stay with all hotel staff interactions. Internal calls went unanswered multiple times, which made simple requests frustrating. Calls were only responded to when we used our cell phones. There was a wedding and hosted reception held directly outside our room on 2 nights of our stay, which made it nearly impossible to relax or sleep. The music, laughter, and crowd noise went late into the evening, and it felt as though the event was happening inside our room rather than outside of it. We understand and appreciate that events are part of the resort experience, but hosting one directly beside guest accommodations without notice or any sound consideration was extremely disruptive. A simple heads-up or a room change option would have gone a long way in ensuring a more comfortable and enjoyable stay. The TV system was confusing and unreliable, and the salsa (a small detail, but telling) was genuinely terrible.

On the positive side, the spa providers were excellent — professional, kind, and skilled. The Bell-Aire driver was also wonderful — friendly, helpful, and made getting around easy. The resort grounds are beautiful and well-maintained, and our room was very clean. Overall, there’s a great vibe and potential here, but the guest experience could be much better with more warmth and attention to detail.
reviews.author: Becky Rothstein

reviews.text: Beautiful setting and a great relaxing place to hang out for staycation or vacation. I only ate brunch here and walked the property so I can not rate the rooms at this point. However the property has hammocks. Grass , trees, pools, great food and bar , lobby is very inviting and gives you the feel you are more in a tropical vacation with big fireplace and large couch seating areas and tables. I will update thoughts on the room once I stay the night.
reviews.author: J W

reviews.text: Amazing time!
reviews.author: Derek Oesterblad

reviews.text:
Horrible experience. Nice looking hotel, but they put us in a room adjacent to a major wedding with the reception happening in front of our room on the grass without letting us know. House music pounded until 10:30pm and there was a party going on in the room next to us and the hotel staff did nothing to quiet them either. Not what my wife and I expected booking this with no communication about what was happening on property.

The room design was nice, but the bathroom shower had a sewer smell emitting from the drain that filled the whole bathroom and smelled horrible.

Very dissapointed with the experience at this place, and bummed because it presented well online with nice architecture and design. Better experience at a courtyard marriot for half the price. This place is on the "ditch" list.
reviews.author: Eric Crane

reviews.text: Top notch hotel with top notch service and ammenities.  Saw two beautiful wedding services while staying at the property as well!
reviews.author: Anthony Dickson

reviews.text: This was very nice place to stay. I did enjoy the appearance and atmosphere of the lobby and outdoor areas. The young lady at the front desk was very kind, courteous and helpful. She ensured we would be able to locate our room and offered to answer any questions we had prior to leaving the desk. The room was nice and comfortable. The pools were very nice, and I especially liked the sand bottom at the pool entry. The food that was provided was good. My only complaints would be not having a microwave in the room and that the fridge was pretty full of items, so there was not much room for storing anything I brought in from outside. I did not use any of the provided in-room food or drinks with the exception of the espresso machine and pods. The gym was clean, orderly and sufficient.  Overall, it was a nice stay, and I enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere.
reviews.author: Jeremy Conway

reviews.text: A beautiful resort with the most perfect location! Within walking distance of so many amazing restaurant, to name a few, The Montauk, Olive & Ivy, The Sauce, and bars like The Social Tap and many coffee spots, our favorite was Press Coffee! Old Town Scottsdale was a short drive away with even more amazing restaurants! The pool area was beautiful and we truly loved this resort!
reviews.author: Madyson Harrison

reviews.text: This resort had the best vibe. From the waterfalls and classic convertible out front, to the romantic lightning and fireplace inside, no details were missed. I loved the low lighting at night.
reviews.author: Marita Olson

reviews.text: Attended an on-site business meeting, rooms were nice and facilities were excellent.
reviews.author: Christopher Stoces

reviews.text: Absolutely stunning venue, location, and service! It had an amazing time with wonderful people here at The Scott Resort & Spa, the food was spot on, the atmosphere is truly calming and exciting at the same time, with calming colors and a young, thrilling community. Thank you for hosting events here!
reviews.author: Edis

reviews.text: The resort is beautiful.  The pool water (Early October) was very cold.  Didn't try the restaurant or bar due to being too high priced for my budget.  Great there weren't any kids running around.
reviews.author: Mike Haro

reviews.text:
During our recent stay, we had the pleasure of interacting with Jon, who worked both at the front drop-off area and as the shuttle driver. From the moment we arrived, Jon was friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable about the local area. He gave us great recommendations for places to eat and must-see attractions around Scottsdale.

Beyond just providing helpful tips, Jon was a delight to chat with, making our ride to and from various spots in the city enjoyable and informative. He even helped us with our luggage, going above and beyond to ensure we felt welcomed and comfortable.

If you're staying here, I highly recommend requesting Jon. His dedication to making sure guests have a fantastic experience truly sets him apart. Thanks, Jon, for making our trip even more memorable!
reviews.author: Seth

reviews.text: Amazing experience. Wonderful spot if you're looking to be close to Scottsdale and have a more quaint hotel experience vs. large resort style. Couldn't have been better for a girlfriend trip of mom's with young kiddos needing a quiet, relaxing getaway. Would also be a great couples spot.
reviews.author: Kate Boehme

reviews.text:
My husband and I had a great time at the Scott Resort. The staff were always friendly and helpful. The pool wasn't too busy and had plenty of seating. Pool bar was nice but drinks are about $20. There were lots of other areas on the property to relax outside as well including fire pits that they light at night.

Our room was spacious. We had a king room with a couch area. The bed was comfortable. We did end up getting a room with a street view instead of a pool view due to a system error between my credit card that I booked through and they worked with me to refund the difference or move rooms. Street view was loud when on the patio so would definitely recommend paying the extra for the other view options.

We used the complimentary shuttle service a few times which was fast and easy to use.

I used the spa as well for a message and it was very relaxing and the masseuse did great.
reviews.author: Dona Marthaler

reviews.text: Beautiful Cuban style property located in close proximity to mall and restaurant. Bar and restaurant on site has great food and drinks. Ambiance is great and relaxing
reviews.author: Qūe McFerguson

reviews.text: Cute date night place.
reviews.author: Patrick Roe

reviews.text:
The Scott Resort in Scottsdale is such a gem! It has a totally retro vibe blended with modern luxury, giving it the feel of a boutique resort that’s both stylish and welcoming. I love the size — not too big and overwhelming, but not too small either. It’s just the right scale to feel intimate while still offering great amenities.

The location near Old Town Scottsdale is perfect, and everything on the property is super easy to access. The restaurant, pool, and pool bar are all convenient, and the atmosphere around the pool has so much character — relaxed, fun, and full of energy.

Overall, this resort has a unique and memorable vibe that makes it stand out. I stayed here for business and enjoyed it so much that I’ll definitely be coming back for a second visit, this time for vacation. Highly recommend checking it out if you’re visiting Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Mary Gilbert

reviews.text: We loved the shuttle service.
reviews.author: Shayne Nevins

reviews.text:
My wife and I are staying at The Scott for our 10-year anniversary. Instead of a resort and spa, it seems to be a small event and conference hotel. The name is misleading. There is very little rest and relaxation here.

Our room has paper thin walls with noise and loud music from the outside pool bar, loud talking from housekeeping in the hallway most mornings, and maintenance loudly working on a room two doors down the hall for several hours the first few days of our stay. We can also clearly hear the conversations in the room next door late at night.

Room service is available but the menu is limited. We placed our order for two breakfast sandwiches at 7am when they opened but our breakfast was not delivered to our room until an hour later. We kept being told it was “on the way.” Second attempt to get breakfast via room service on another day, the line just rang and rang then prompted to leave a voicemail. Good luck getting a call back. This service seems like an understaffed after thought. Not indicative of a 4-star resort. By the way - very, very limited choices for breakfast sides.

The Scott offers a complimentary shuttle service to all guests within a 3 mile radius. The staff that operate the shuttle have all been very nice. However, the problem is that it’s not truly a shuttle bus that runs on a schedule. It’s just a white SUV parked out front on a first come first serve basis for drop off and pick up. This worked well for us until Friday evening when we could not reach anyone for return pick up after dinner. After several unanswered calls and a long hold by the front desk, we ended up spending $12 on an Uber to go 2.5 miles down North Scottsdale Road to get back to The Scott. Also, their SUV needs to be washed and detailed.

The Scott is definitely overpriced. I’m surprised this is considered a 4-star hotel. The lobby and bar seem renovated but the rest of the property is old and dated and the hallways smell musty like mildew. Did I mention the guest room walls are paper thin? Basic items in the room like bottled water are $8-$10 a bottle. The stay was definitely not worth the price we paid. In all honesty, our stay has been disappointing. We would not stay here again, especially on such a special occasion.
reviews.author: Jonathan Swann

reviews.text: Overall , I mostly enjoyed staying here. A little outdated but good rooms, spacious, close to downtown Scottsdale where I needed to be. Only downfall was the room cleanliness, as the room was not to clean and some of the pillow cases were stained. Also, there is no little shop to purchase anything and there is a ton of construction around which made it longer and harder to get out of there.  Food was great, at least the few purchases I made over the weekend.
reviews.author: Andy McVay

reviews.text: Great stay. The staff was amazing, great location !
reviews.author: Jeff Smith

reviews.text: We had the best time at The Scott Resort and Spa!  The bed was amazingly soft and comfy. Everyone was so friendly and kind.  Highly recommend checking them out.
reviews.author: Christy Moore

reviews.text: Great atmosphere!
reviews.author: Donna Naglieri

reviews.text:
Had an incredible time! Love how they embraced an old place and made it work! reviews.text: Do NOT stay here. We had to move rooms 3 times due to the rooms being unsanitary; when moving to the third room, it was still dirty. (hairs in the bed, dried-up contacts and trash on the floors, hair in the showers, weird stains on the pillows, and stains on the mirrors and TV). The customer service was bad and very rude, and when making many, MANY mistakes, they did not have any accountability or overall a positive, friendly manner. Below are some of the photos from the rooms, including stains in the bedsheets, hairs on and in the bed, stains on the pillows, and trash and dried-up contacts on the floor. Also, when checking out, they completely messed up the total, adding hundreds onto the actual price.
reviews.author: Rachel Springer Rosenblum

reviews.text:
We had several issues with our stay. I have eaten at the restaurant on a few different occasions and always enjoyed it, which is what inspired me to book a mini “staycation” this past weekend. Unfortunately, the experience ended up being very disappointing. I live in Scottsdale and I thought it would be fun to come and enjoy the pool, spa, and amenities of The Scott but things did not go as I had hoped.

My disappointment actually started prior to my stay when I called to ask for my dog to be added to the reservation. The man on the reservations team that I spoke to was not as hospitable or conscientious as I had expected and, in fact, sounded rude and short on the phone. However, that situation was handled, and I will say that the in-person staff member at check-in was incredibly nice and welcoming.

Once I was on the property many things were not up to the standard I had expected. When walking into Building E, where our room was located, I noticed above the door there was a missing panel and there were a bunch of exposed and hanging wires. It looked off-putting and even made me question if it was safe. The Wi-Fi in the room was down, which was inconvenient. The overall pool area was not well kept, and it was not the kind of attentive service that I had imagined. In fact, while walking into the pool I was holding onto the safety railing, as one does, and it isn’t secure and it moved causing me to slip. I also noticed that one of the pool lights seemed to be falling off.

The room itself was great, however, on Saturday at around 9AM landscaping work began outside the building and by 10AM they were right outside the glass patio door. While I completely understand that normal landscaping maintenance is necessary, I did not expect how intrusive the experience would be. At one point, a gardener was standing less than twelve inches from my back door blowing leaves, and shortly after that, painting began. This made it very uncomfortable to even open my blinds and rendered the patio area completely unusable.

Because of all these issues, I ultimately decided not to stay for my second night. I was very pleased that the staff worked with me and allowed me to cancel the rest of my stay and only pay a late check-out fee. Still, I was disappointed to have to leave early and miss my dinner reservations, but it felt like the more suitable option since the overall experience was not what I had hoped for.
reviews.author: Molly Forish

reviews.text: Aesthetics galore. Love love this resort, close to everything and amazing bar drinks and tasty food. 20/10 recommend. Also the ceviche is uber bomb.
reviews.author: Atraio N

reviews.text:
Staying at the hotel now.  Desk staff promised a pool view when I called  ahead to ask if we could have one but at check in no record was found of my call.  Needless to say we got no pool view.    Why would a staff member not just be honest when I called and say you have to pay extra if you don’t want a view of the parking lot?

Were checked into a room that was quite obviously dirty.  Moved rooms because that was the solution the desk offered.  Second room dirty also, including stained sheets on a bed that had been hastily made.  Had to call the desk again!  This all took a lot of time and did not bring us the joy we were seeking on this getaway.

Staff not gracious about the hotel’s multiple shortcomings.

Quite disappointed that this special weekend we saved up for is here and  that we feel less than as guests.  I should have looked more at the low star reviews before booking because we definitely not getting the 5 star experience we hoped for.   ☹️

PS

AC went off in the night.

reviews.text: 50/5 stars! I travel quite a bit and this has been the best experience from top to bottom in years. I was planning on staying at a nearby casino where the conference was being held, but they lost my reservation and didn't answer the phone for over four hours. In a panic, in route, I booked a stay at The Scott. I cannot believe my good fortune in finding this magical gem of a place. Rooms, pools, food, staff, service, cleanliness, decor/design, lighting, AC, ambiance, amenities, you name it, all simply could not be better. I'm even thinking of staying an extra night or two and usually I can't wait to get home from work trips. I may even take a personal trip to Scottsdale again soon, just to stay here and experience the spa. I can't recommend The Scott Resort and Spa enough.

reviews.text: I had the pleasure of visiting The Scott for a photography session with one of my couples, and I absolutely loved my visit. We rented a cabana and were taken wonderful care of from check in to poolside service. If you love aesthetics and appreciate intentional architecture and design (as a photographer, I love these things), this resort is perfect for you. Every corner is photo-worthy, not to mention the phenomenal cuisine. I can’t stop thinking about the ceviche and peach Bellini from the pool bar! I’m already planning my next visit.
reviews.author: Brenna Bowen

reviews.text:
We absolutely LOVE The Scott! This has been one of our favorite places to stay over the years thanks to the incredible staff, the beautiful Canal Club and lobby area, and the consistently amazing food. The guest rooms are comfortable, and the overall vibe is truly special.

That said, we’ve noticed that some areas are starting to show their age. The paint, rusting handrails, pool tiles, and landscaping—especially the grass and plant areas—are beginning to fall below the high standards we associate with The Scott. We understand it was last remodeled in 2018, but it may be time for another refresh to maintain the experience that makes this place so unique.

We still absolutely love it here and appreciate everything the team does to make our stays memorable. Looking forward to seeing how it continues to grow and improve!

reviews.text: Stayed here for one night for a girls trip and our only regret is not staying here longer. Absolutely beautiful resort, excellent location, and the standard room was gorgeous. Exceeded our already high expectations after we saw the pictures and read the reviews online. Everywhere you turned looked and smelled beautiful!

Service excellent..except for retrieving dishes at poolside and bar. Server bypassed stacked dishes multiple times while walking directly to bar and busbin. Some rooms with surge protectors next to bed ??? 5*?.. sad so many water features off -.yoga+..pools+..some rooms were not clean.period..an ADA Guest did not have proper door width. reviews.text: My wife and I just stayed at The Scott for my high school reunion. The staff is very professional, courteous, and helpful. The food both at our catered events and in the restaurant was excellent. They also had a nice grab-and-go selection on Friday and Saturday for breakfast and lunch. Our room was well appointed and maintained. I was impressed that they were doing room upkeep with repairs and painting to keep the facility looking good. There was plenty of space indoors and outdoors for our 200 plus people to gather, reminisce and catch up. The location is perfect for access to stores and restaurants. I would not hesitate to stay there again.

reviews.text: Positive: "" Negative: ""

Loved The Scott for my second visit, and will be back! Intimate, pretty, fun boutique hotel perfectly located for a girls weekend. The option to add margaritas and guacamole w/chips to start our stay was excellent and well worth the $50. Super comfy beds, the valet and front desk are so kind, and we really appreciated the water stations and coffee refills. Can’t wait to return, pat on the back to all of the staff! 👏

reviews.text:
This hotel is the definition of lipstick on a pig. A real life “apartment landlord special.”

The lobby is lovely, nicely decorated and gives the illusion of a nice spot for a weekend getaway, or a fun place to stay close to all the fun of old town and Fashion Square. However, that’s where the quality ends.

The rooms are nothing more than a motel six with a mix your own cocktail bar. With pealing paint, loose/wobbly/broken/rusty fixtures, shallow ceilings, cheap beds, moldy corners, and poorly planned use of space (especially the bathroom), the rooms leave much to be desired.

The pool is incredibly small with dramatically overpriced cabanas. There is a nice bar by the pool, but be ready to rub skin with a stranger and have no privacy at all.

I can’t believe how nice they make this hotel look in the pictures. The actual experience is so far from what the pictures portray.

reviews.text:
I would rate this hotel 3.5/5 above average. I was convinced to come here due to social media ads when searching for hotels on tik tok. Pros:
1.aesthetically the lobby is beautiful
2. The grounds are beautiful will many photo opportunities.
3.bedding was firm and comfortable
4.location was amazing close to everything

Cons:
its an older remolded hotel but you don’t notice until you sleep overnight in the rooms. Upon first impression the rooms were nice and comfortable clean. The problem was because it was older the water smelled of rotten eggs. The food at the canal is overpriced for the quality of the food. I had a burger and you could definitely taste it was just a frozen patty with a sprinkle of salt. The breakfast was ok but to be Cuban inspired I expected better coffee.

reviews.text: Unfortunately the last few days of our peaceful stay were no longer that. A full convention took over the entire hotel, which was calm and peaceful the first few nights we stayed. The hotel catered to the convention rather than regular guests. Front desk people were somewhat rude and no help for simple asks. A Resort and spa hotel, which is charging a high nightly resort fee, shouldn’t be hosting a massive convention which disrupts things for the regular guests who are here on vacation. Beware of booking during one of these as it will completely ruin your experience.

reviews.text: Currently staying here let me first say customer service excellent room clean nice and spacious however,when I booked online on  there site back on March I had no idea they would be under construction meaning restaurant closed spa are closed the only amenities was the pool. reviews.text: Got a day pass to relax and use the pool. The water was slightly chilly, it has a fun beach entry though the sand was a little rough. Plenty of both shady and sunny lounge chair options and the staff was friendly. Excellent food too!
reviews.author: Kathryn Bobb

reviews.text: Nice hotel, rooms. Wifi is terribly slow.
reviews.author: Josh Sabol

reviews.text:
Overall, my experience at The Scott was pleasant but I would not stay at the resort again. Upon arrival there were a number of work conferences taking place which caught me off guard and didn’t make the resort feel relaxing and luxurious as I thought it would be. The resort advertises an early check in time of 12:00pm for an additional $50 but the room was not ready until almost 2:00pm.
• The resort offers complimentary transportation services for guests to places within a 3 mile radius which was very convenient.
• The gym was empty, very clean, and offered a variety of equipment.
• The bed and pillows in the room were very comfortable.
• The AC in the room did not work effectively and the room remained warm over night.
• I would not recommend eating at The Canal Club on the property. The coffee was bland and the espresso was very low quality. The food was average for both breakfast and lunch and the service was okay. I would suggest going into town as there is no shortage of great restaurant options, like Cala at Senna House and Elephante.
reviews.author: L C

reviews.text: Wonderful place.   Nice and clean
reviews.author: Pat Morstad

reviews.text:
When we arrived, the gentleman at the valet just looked at us multiple times but didn't come to help until he saw his co-worker headed our way. We asked about valet and taking luggage to our room but were told its easier if we do it ourselves. Then later that day, we saw the same man taking a cart full of luggage to another guests room. The pool isn't large enough to accommodate the property. We specifically stayed here for a good pool day and upon arrival we were told one entire side of the pool was closing within the next hour for a private event. That should have been communicated at reservation, confirmation and then check-in. We tried to rent one of the 3 open cabanas and were told they were already rented, however they were never occupied by anyone. So that felt like a blatant lie.
Upon arriving to our room it was very warm, AC didn't seem to actually be blowing even though I had it on 66. There were food bowls outside in the hallway, on the floor, from the time we checked in until the time we checked out. Overall, it just wasn't the experience we were expecting. Other than the bartenders, it felt no one was there to actually provide good service!
reviews.author: Brittny Berry

reviews.text: Recently stayed at The Scott and it was absolutely worth it! The Resort overall was so clean and stunning! The staff was very friendly(Shout out to Katie M. She was very friendly, professional, and accommodating) You definitely want to stay at this beautiful resort, I highly recommend it!

reviews.text: Staff was amazing and attentive and very helpful!!! I will definitely be going back!
reviews.author: Ed Adams

reviews.text: This is a beautiful hotel and grounds. My husband and I stayed in a parlor suite over our wedding weekend and had a few negative experiences, however, the general manager more than addressed our concerns. We look forward to staying at The Scott again.

reviews.text:
Lodging dates: 5/04-08/2025.
Cool venue, antiquated but perfect theme for retreat in Scottsdale. Various stores near by, but food and actual shopping is a bit of a distance. The FREE Shuttle was a pleasant option. .the pools are great, and the vibe is positive. Banquet food was decent. The Canal Club restaurant was also decent but needs to expand on more options for various diets.
Room was unique and I did like it. Bed was comfortable. Bathroom was spacious. I was floor 1.
Meeting space is small and it’s strange walking through bars and common areas to get to various rooms. Overall decent, but unorthodox.
Would recommend and would happily return.

reviews.text: Had a great time in the pool hanging out with my children! What a great resort.

reviews.text:
Beautiful boutique hotel. Relaxing and tranquil environment. This would be good for couples/vacation and families.

The only complaint is food/drink prices. It is probably not outrageous but I don’t get out much so it was quite a splurge for me.
reviews.author: Alexia Chapparone

reviews.text: My husband and I were really disappointed in our stay due to (1) the constant drilling /jackhammering to repair the hot tub during the day for 1/2 our stay. The drilling started at 9AM one morning and then 11AM the next. This wasn't disclosed anywhere and was extremely frustrating because when I voiced my concern about this to the concierge via messaging asking how long the drilling would last for; I never got a reply. Further, the drilling caused dust and debris to fly into the air. I'm expecting and explained this to the concierge too, and again, I never received a response; (2) I was also disappointed that one of the pools was closed due to a private event for an entire afternoon during our stay - again, this wasn't disclosed until the day-of by a posting by the pool. Had we known that either of these issues would occur, we would have picked a different hotel for our vacation.
reviews.author: Kimberly Rocheford

reviews.text: What an incredible property! I stayed here for 4 nights and everything from the rooms to the food, the pool and the spa was delightful. I'd especially like to highlight the fantastic staff. Homero, Andy, Jeff, Jim, Jocelynn, housekeeping, the front desk team and the shuttle drivers. Thank you for a wonderful week.
