reviews.text:
We are staying here for the week and as someone who travels a lot - I can already tell you that this  place is 11/10 all the way. Any reviews claiming anything but positivity are simply false! Everyone is so nice, helpful, kind, and friendly! We’ve had too tire experience from check in, housekeeping, waiters and bartenders, literally everyone.
Big shout outs to Alexa, Erica and Justin at the pool! They took such good care of us and were super attentive ALL DAY! They made our experience even better by taking the time to actually chat with us!

So far - this place exceeds every expectation! Definitely plan your stay here! It’s worth it!!
reviews.author: Hayley Stumbo

reviews.text: I stayed here a year ago, had problems and the gave me a certificate for a free 2 night stay. When i went to use my certificate i couldnt get in contact with anyone. The phone lines wouldnt even ring. I did email the girl I had previously been in contact with with the dates i wanted to stay. I didn't receive an email back until the day that i would have liked to check in (other plans had been made) they did call me the afternoon i would have liked to check in to confirm my stay… really? The afternoom of? Certificate is now wasted. Really disappointed in the customer service. Guess my review of this place will stay one star. I can recommend multiple other beautiful places to stay.
reviews.author: Sara Jossi

reviews.text:
I love this resort! The lobby bar is really fun, staff is so nice and food Is yummy.
Had a great time with friends at the pool. Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Cindy Bynum

reviews.text: Positive: Honestly, I didn't like anything about the hotel. The front of the house staff were disorganized, the resort fee for a 12-hour stay was exorbitant, and there were no food options other than overpriced burgers and no elevator. Negative: All of it- the staff, tiny bathroom, the ridiculous resort fee, and the lack of food options. I have never reviewed a hotel, but I felt compelled to do so. They describe it as walking distance from downtown - nothing could be further from the truth.
reviews.author: Jacqueline

reviews.text:
Enjoyed our 6 night stay at The Scott. It’s stylish and peaceful.  Nice decor, the gardens are beautiful and everything is very well taken care of. We were attending a conference at The Scott, arrived a few days early to enjoy the property. Great pool, love The Canal Club, nice rooms.  Quiet, we slept really well.  Excellent beds.

Only negative that really impacted our stay was the poor air conditioning in our room. Many reviews that we read prior to our stay indicated that poor air conditioning is a very consistent problem at The Scott. Maintenance adjusted the water pipes, didn’t make a huge difference, they said there was an air conditioning problem in building D (Duarte) and brought us a tower fan to assist with cooling. It helped but wasn’t ideal as it adds more noise.

It was a nice place to stay, however we wouldn’t stay there again.
reviews.author: Pamela Orr

reviews.text: Although the room was gorgeous and the bed was super comfy, the hotel left much to be desired. Each time we ordered room service, our order was incorrect. The snacks in the bedroom were not allergy friendly and the menu wasnt very extensive for people with allergies either. Lastly, the staff members was relatively curt and unpleasant to interact with. Aside from the less than desirable interactions I had, the location is great. If you have dietary restrictions, or accessibility restrictions (there are no elevators), I would say take a close look before staying here.
reviews.author: Monae Prince

reviews.text: Wonderful vibe at this hotel. Walking distance to great shopping and food
reviews.author: Tricia LaLonde

reviews.text: Honestly, this was probably one of, if not, the best hotel experiences I have had anywhere. My wife and I loved the ability to reserve and get an early check-in, which made it so easy to then enjoy the property, pool area, lunch, drinks, etc. after traveling in early in the morning. Also, it was very nice and convenient with the shuttle to enjoy a nice dinner off-property. Lastly, just the lobby/bar areas and general sitting areas throughout the property were so cool and nice. I know there was a substantial renovation done previously, but it is obvious that this property is very well maintained.
reviews.author: Steve Crooks

reviews.text: Staff was extremely friendly. Upgraded our room! We are hoping to visit back with a group of friends. We had a 10/10 experience with our stay, the pool, & the facility! Thank you so much!
reviews.author: Logan Jones

reviews.text:
So let me preface this low review by acknowledging it is specifically directed at inappropriate behavior from an individual events employee. His name is Homero

The issues with Homero started with his rude and very unprofessional announcement (the very first saw him) until the end of the second day on our way out.

I believe Homero has a chip on his shoulder. With the little athority he has, he feels the need to flex dominance on his staff, use foul language towards our a.v. company (when clients were on site). He was very condescending to our a.v. crew, postured his body language aggressively, and attempted to escalate conversations with rude undertones. Childish behavior is the best way to describe it.

I posted this days ago, and not a single response from management or corporate.
reviews.author: Groove Unit

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️ 3/5: Come for the cocktails, stay for the...key card cardio?

It truly pains me to give The Scott Resort just 3 stars. I wanted to be swept away by the desert charm and those dreamy cocktails, but alas, the service saga at the front desk dragged it down like a soggy pool towel.

I was in town for a work conference and arrived early; props to the team for having our rooms ready before 3 PM! The decor is giving “stylish Sonoran sanctuary,” and I was vibing with it. But one major issue in the room: no bathroom fan. So unless you enjoy your post-shower routine in a steam room built by Mother Nature herself, bring a defogger or just embrace the cloud.

Now let’s talk poolside, 10/10. The food? Fire. Get the ceviche, warm arugula salad, and the plantains with refried beans. Trust me, your tastebuds will send you a thank-you note. But the true MVP? The Helen & Maude cocktail. I hyped it so hard, I’m basically its brand ambassador now. You're welcome, Scott Resort.

And now, the tragedy of “Keygate 2025.” I requested a late checkout for $50; fair enough. I planned to return from my conference, take a quick shower, pack, and head out. Easy, right? WRONG. I got back at 12:10 PM, cut through the pool like a local, only to discover…my key didn’t work. Cue the first trek to the front desk. Rekeyed. Walked back. Still no dice. Lather, rinse, repeat...four times. I finally stationed myself at the bar (with a Helen & Maude in hand, what choice did I have?), while my poor roommate played Mission: Unlockable. Finally, on the FIFTH attempt, the key worked! It was now 12:45 PM. My $50 "extra hour"? Spent entirely trying to break back into my own room.

I called to ask for more time since, you know, I spent my first paid hour cosplaying as a locksmith. The front desk seemed blissfully unaware of the situation. I was mid-conversation explaining everything when a bellhop knocked...10 minutes early, while I was still half-showered, half-packed, and 100% not in the mood. I felt rushed, invisible, and worse...un-cocktailed.

No real apology. No gesture to make things right. Just a bellhop, a ticking clock, and my Helen & Maude slowly melting at the bar.

Would I stay again? Maybe. But only if the Helen & Maude comes with a working key and a side of empathy. Do better, Scott Resort. You were so close to greatness.

SB
reviews.author: Stephanie Bernal

reviews.text: I booked 2 nights at the Scott Resort & Spa. My flight was very late.  And, at the last minute it was canceled.  We booked a different flight in the morning to make it to the wedding.  With all the confusion and being so tired, we never thought of calling the property after 11 pm when we learned that the delays were finally resulting in a cancellation.  When I called in the morning, the staff was so rude telling me that I was a no-show and that my room was gone and I should not think I was "off-the-hook for the first night".  I explained to him that that I was not looking to get any money back.  All I wanted is a room to stay for the wedding.   He said there was no guarantee.  After putting me on hold for about 10 minutes, another person picked up saying "how can I help you"...  I asked if she knew what was going on so I do not explain again, and she said "yes, I am aware.  You are a no-show and your room is gone.  Let's see if we can get you a room."  And, meanwhile, my wife and I are waiting at the airport to board on the new flight not knowing if we have a room.  It was the most uncomfortable experience.  We were so disappointed with how the staff treated us as if we are trying to take something for free.  It's just not what you would expect from a resort.
reviews.author: Dikran Hovagimian

reviews.text: Cute but I drove an hour to get here for an event that had online partnered with The City of Scottsdale only for me to be told they have no idea what I’m talking about and turn me away. She said they did something during the week but the event online said todays date.
reviews.author: Haley Champion

reviews.text: A great place to stay. The spa and doorman were 100% helpful, along with the front desk staff. The restaurant was nice, the food was great. To God be the Glory!
reviews.author: Earlene Hines

reviews.text: I recently had a corporate event held here. Overall the hotel has a very nice aesthetic and atmosphere. However the house banquets manager or lead, Homero Juarqin, was rude, dismissive, and had no regard for our setup and strike crew. Great experience otherwise, but sadly was tarnished by one individual.
reviews.author: Joe Miletti

reviews.text: Excellent, a must visit. Great hospitality
reviews.author: Brenda

reviews.text: Awesome experience,  great staff, lovely grounds.
reviews.author: Shelli Briscoe

reviews.text: I loved everything about this charming hotel - the location, atmosphere, service, and food were top notch.
reviews.author: Erika Rossi

reviews.text: Loved our stay here and wish we could’ve stayed longer! My partner booked a night here for my birthday and it was a fantastic 24 hours. We were able to get into our room early so we could spend the afternoon at the pool, and the staff was so friendly when we checked in. Loved all the outdoor spaces, the pool was so relaxing and the fire pits at night were wonderful. Rooms were comfortable and beautifully designed! Also loved how walkable the location is to everything in Scottsdale. Absolutely would come back!
reviews.author: Carlie Penning

reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay! Comes with a pool, indoor and outdoor bar, and small restaurant. Room service was great. Walking distance from Old town Scottsdale, fashion square mall and more!!! There’s bikes on the property to use. There’s a shuttle to take you to places within a certain mileage distance. The few downfalls I have is that there is no microwave and the fridge is packed with drinks and candy so you’ll have to remove it to store your own food. The fridge is super small with no freezer and in our room the fridge wasn’t working but it wasn’t a major necessity for us. Overall we enjoyed our stay. Make sure you try any of the cocktails from the bar in a coconut!
reviews.author: Lacelle

reviews.text:
One of the most beautiful properties I have ever stayed in the lobby is absolutely exceptional. The bar had amazing drinks to offer as well. The room was gorgeous and the bed was so comfortable. Also loved the large walk in shower.  I want to also shout out the direct streaming offer for the room TVs. I wish all properties had this
Highly recommend, especially for couples
reviews.author: Erica Cox

reviews.text: Really enjoyed the bar. We had a carrot drink, one of our favorite drinks ever.  Bartender/manager Ashley was very informative and helped us with our drink and food selections. The staff made the experience very enjoyable, and we will definitely be going back.
reviews.author: Jonathan Nash

reviews.text: Beautiful resort vibes with insanely good food and a short walk from Old Town. You can tell they put a lot of effort into their guests' experience. Would recommend it to anyone and would love to come back one day.
reviews.author: Rebecca Savoni

reviews.text: I had the worst experience with the security guy. He lied stating we were blocking doorways while doing some photos. I have been here many times no issues as we always respect the rules and ask for permission anticipating the session, when I told him that he was doing it out of spite, he simply said yes. We ended up going to the Grand Hyatt Resort and they were amazing.
reviews.author: Jessica Valdes

reviews.text: We stayed for 6 nights with teens and mother in law. Wanted rooms close, hotel wasn't able to accommodate but tried to get us close. Gal up front super nice and tried her best. Rooms a little dated but goes with vibe of hotel. Room wasn't cleaned everyday and with 4 in a room would of been nice. Depending on day not a lot of room by pool. Close to downtown Scottsdale. Very pretty landscaping and calm feel. Will stay again.
reviews.author: Brittany

reviews.text: Good nice experience. Not a lot of food options, and rooms lack size. No smart TVs. For around the same price would rather stay at the Omni Montelucia down the road.
reviews.author: Andrew Lent

reviews.text: Older remodled resort with a Cuban vibe. Had a cabana by the pool with great cocktail service. Room was nicely decorated with newer furnishings. Had a great time. We will be back.
reviews.author: Brian Smith

reviews.text: I had a great stay at The Scott Resort! Beautiful lobby and room. The staff was friendly and my toddler loved the pool.
reviews.author: Rebecca Johnson

reviews.text: The Scott Resort & Spa is an absolutely beautiful space. I've experienced it twice for work events and will definitely be hosting a girls weekend here in the future. The staff are so helpful, the food is fantastic, and the grounds are so peaceful and luxurious. Well done!
reviews.author: Trina Fisher

reviews.text: Had an awesome experience with staying at the Resort for a conference. We were treated very well and had awesome food and a great environment. Very clean and the beds were very comfortable.
reviews.author: Keri Francl

reviews.text: Positive: Location, private quiet landscaping, unique decor touches, daily yoga and free bikes, wonderful pool with pool bar, Canal Club bar,Private balcony Negative: Espresso coffee machine in room was loud and not to our taste.?Prefer regular drip coffee machine in room.Wish there was a small microwave in room to reheat restaurant leftovers.Less liquor in refrigerator.Bathroom lighting was too dim.
reviews.author: Wendy

reviews.text: We loved staying at The Scott. It is a little pricey, but worth it for the ambience, food and location.
reviews.author: Connie Cramer

reviews.text: The views are amazing. The location is awesome. And great amenities offered !
reviews.author: Rachel Roots

reviews.text: Keep coming back because it’s a great place to stay!
reviews.author: Dyanne Barnabo

reviews.text:
It appears the hotel is severely understaffed. I was a guest at the hotel for a wedding and they refused to allow the bride to sit outside at the restaurant for brunch on Sunday because we were told they were all reserved and would be sat in the next hour. However, there were still several vacant tables outside well into the next two hours. I found out that 4 staff members had called out that day so that was actually why they couldn’t seat us outside. Due to the staff shortages, everything took very long. One of the meals didn’t arrive until 10 minutes after the others had already been brought and we had to walk to the bar to get the espresso shot that was never brought out.

Additionally, I was told I couldn’t even pay for the option of a later checkout even though I had requested it because they had already hit the allotted number of late check outs. They should really prioritize those who are staying in the wedding block.

There were issues with the gas line for the fire pits on Saturday night and they told us they couldn’t turn it on for us, so that was frustrating that it wasn’t working.

There was a second wedding party that dominated the lobby when we were trying to take professional wedding photos. As the wedding party actually having a wedding on site, our wedding should have had priority in photography sessions. Because of the other wedding party, our wedding schedule was severely delayed and we had to make multiple accommodations, missing out on a lot of good opportunities. The reception also failed to distribute all the welcome bags that the wedding party specifically paid to have done.

Overall, the hotel is beautiful and clean but the service is terrible and it seems to be an issue coming from management. The staff was very polite and were in a very difficult situation trying to work under those conditions. Expect a very nice looking decor but very poor customer service.
reviews.author: Jessica Paulson

reviews.text: I have been to events at the Scott but never stayed. There was great feedback from others and that is why I stayed this time. Everything was great, and I will be back!
reviews.author: Hank Grabowski

reviews.text: If you’re accustomed to luxury getaways, don’t go here. If you’re local and want a cute little staycation, this is the place for you.
reviews.author: Jessica Bramble

reviews.text: Great location, great pools.
reviews.author: Patrick Coyle

reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful. The rooms are very unique and the lobby is gorgeous. However we were double charged for the stay upon check in and had issues with late checkout.
Overall we had a wonderful time, just not sure if we will book again due to these issues.
reviews.author: Christine Silvers

reviews.text:
I booked a cabana on 3/1 for my birthday via resort pass. I regret that decision. There is no ordering service provided at the cabana/poolside. You must go to the bar to order. There is very limited staff so be prepared to wait a while. The cabana was stained. The amenities promised (sunkit, Chandon + Chandon bucket, and selection of non alcoholic beverages) were not provided and are unavailable. The Scott has been aware for a year that the resort pass booking is inaccurate, but does not notify the booking client proactively about issue. The manager offered to fully refund us for the cabana given my groups poor experience and lack of fulfillment of amenities and instructed me that I would need to simply reach out to resort pass and they would approve the refund request. Resort pass responded to my complaint with a 50% refund and a coupon for future use which I will not use. Not acceptable and a total waste of money. Don’t book.. especially not for a special occasion

Edit:3/27 - despite emailing to resolve this issue as requested in the reply I never received any follow up email or a complete refund as promised.
reviews.author: Luwam Tekle

reviews.text: Great place for a getaway! My wife and I really enjoyed our stay.
reviews.author: Isaac Brown

reviews.text: Weather wise, Scottsdale is everything everyone ever said it is, crisp, cool, and comfortable! People and accommodations were great.
reviews.author: Chris Kaiser

reviews.text: This was our first time staying in Scottsdale, and would highly recommend The Scott Resort and Spa. The location was outstanding as we could walk to area shops, restaurants, and the trail along the canal. The resort was clean and very well maintained.
reviews.author: Brian Buseman

reviews.text: This venue is better suited for a social event or wedding rather than a professional meeting or conference. The rooms are fairly basic and could benefit from some updates, but the onsite staff are fantastic. The food at the restaurant and bar was excellent, adding to the overall experience. I’d highly recommend it for a girls' trip or staycation.
reviews.author: Heather Lynch Walters

reviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous resort - and so convenient. Walkable to downtown Scottsdale, but why leave when the resort is so beautiful!?! Great food, great pool, great grounds - will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Natalie Sorge

reviews.text: Wonderful property. Oasis in the middle of a busy city.  Excellent food and beverage choices, well trained and delpful staff.  Beautiful pool area with healthy , well maintained trees offering shade. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: barry Kingston

reviews.text: Very Cozy, I enjoy the outside patio with the fire stone rocks, the margarita was delicious, ceviche a little too spicy but overall it was a decent meal.
reviews.author: Amanda G

reviews.text:
Loud neighbors at 3:30am when they came back to their room. We called the front desk to remedy the situation and the next door guests must have been told we had complained because they put a large cup of water outside our hotel room door hoping we would trip over it. Security should never reveal where a complaint came from. Going in that morning for a full knee replacement I didn’t need to trip or panic over knocking over a large cup of water. Very unprofessional on the hotel’s part. Front desk was not interested and didn’t give us correct contact information for the manager.
Rooms are old and tired looking. Nothing special at all for the price. The lobby area and pool area are beautiful.
Not worth the money until they upgrade the rooms to match the public areas.

reviews.text: The Scott is just stunning!!   Lobby and grounds are beautiful with plenty of space to relax!  Room was large, lovely and comfortable!

reviews.author: Dee

reviews.text: Had a blast at this hotel! My favorite was sitting outside on the patio for breakfast. I also enjoyed the lobby.

reviews.text: Loved our recent stay at The Scott! Lovely ambiance, friendly and accomodating staff. Great drinks and only minutes from Old Town Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Shelly Campbell

reviews.text:
Very nice resort in Scottsdale, AZ.
Was there for a convention. Meeting rooms were way too cold! Otherwise, good feeling. One of my colleagues was very close to get his computer and credit cards stolen by a staff member... Hopefully the person at the reception desk was super helpful and could get them back from her coworker.
reviews.author: Joel Gay

reviews.text: Quaint but difficult to navigate. The staff was nice throughout, and the bar was well stocked. Food was imaginative. The rooms were a bit dated but comfy overall.

reviews.text: Nice place. Expensive
reviews.author: Andy Cleland

reviews.text: Have stayed here a few times for quicks scottsdale trips. Perfect location. Perfect size if you don't like the giant resort non stop elevators. Rooms and large. Pool and poolside service is the best! Staying again in a few weeks for a girls staycay. Can't wait

reviews.text: Great kitchen and bar staff

reviews.text: Overall pretty resort but service was meh!
reviews.author: Joseph Iannuzzi

reviews.text:
I recently had the opportunity to stay at The Scotts Resort, and I must say, my experience was not what I had hoped for. While I had high expectations for a 4-star establishment, the reality fell significantly short, making it feel more like a budget accommodation.

Upon entering my room, I was greeted with a decor that felt dated and lacked the luxurious touches one would expect from a premium hotel. The furnishings were basic, and the overall ambiance was more reminiscent of a motel than a high-end resort.

Cleanliness is a non-negotiable aspect of any hotel stay, and unfortunately, The Scotts Resort did not meet the mark. While the room appeared tidy at first glance, I noticed several areas that had clearly been overlooked during cleaning. The bathroom, while functional, showed signs of wear and tear that suggested it hadn’t been properly maintained.

The service was another area where the resort fell short. While the staff was polite and attempted to be helpful, the level of attentiveness and professionalism was lacking. For a hotel of this caliber, I expected a more personalized experience. Additionally, there were delays in room service (1h wait), pool orders drink (30mins) and the espresso machine was broken.

Conclusion:
In summary, my stay at The Scotts Resort was disappointing. While I understand that location and demand can influence a hotel's reputation, the quality of the room, cleanliness, and service did not align with the expectations set by its star rating. If you’re considering this resort, I would recommend looking elsewhere for a more authentic luxury experience that truly justifies the investment. For a premium stay, I expected far more than what was delivered.
reviews.author: Kurt Dannon

reviews.text: Great location but the culinary experience could be better. Rooms are comfortable but bathrooms are small and water seeps through glass door very easily.
reviews.author: H H

reviews.text: THIS ONE RATING IS NOT FOR THE SCOTT ITSELF BUT FOR YOUR SECURITY!!! I am a Dasher and every time I've delivered to this hotel the clerks at front desk have always been kind and very respectful to me and every time I have asked to use the bathroom they never hesitate to say yes... Tonight I had the worst experience with their Rent-a-cop with a VERY BIG CHIP on his shoulders, letting me know that the hotel itself has no say so ON WHO USES THE RESTROOM and SECURITY HAS ALL THE POWER AND SAY SO and if I use the bathroom there again whether The Scott says it's okay, he is going to consider me trespassing... He was VERY RUDE AND AWFUL AND HE MADE ME FEEL LIKE I BROKE THE LAW AND I WAS SOME KIND OF CRIMINAL JUST FOR USING THE BATHROOM.... I am a decent human being and never ask for trouble/problems for anyone... I am on the job and want nothing to do with the guests in any kind of harmful or disrespectful way but sometimes Nature calls and it would be nice not to be criminalized for it.....
reviews.author: C Juarez

reviews.text: We just had a corporate event there and we will be back!  The courtesy and responsiveness of the staff, from the table and chairs set up team to the event planner, to the food coordinator, to name a few, were second to none and better that we have ever experienced!
reviews.author: Nanette Pace

reviews.text: What a beautiful place to stay!  Cozy rooms and great amenities.
reviews.author: Jenny LePoris

reviews.text: Wonderful  location, fantastic spa and food. Bummer the 1 pool was not available. If it was me, I'd update the pools and spa w new tile and plaster.
reviews.author: Deb Seibel

reviews.text:
Very over priced for how old and outdated the place is. The AC blows real loud and didn't work the second day. Water bottles were not restocked the 2nd day. Hallway carpet to the old rooms matched. (Old)
Not what I expect for a $800+ a night stay.
reviews.author: Bryan Gillmore

reviews.text: The aesthetics of this hotel are nice—especially the lobby and common areas. The rooms are nice, too, but a bit dark, as are the hallways. Our room was clean. It is also very loud, you can hear every word from the hallway and outside. Not very relaxing. The service, also, left much to be desired. We tried to order room service starting at 5pm (which they claim to “offer daily from 11am -10pm”). We called the room service line 3 times over the course of 20 minutes and they never answered. So, we called the front desk, who told us they would speak to a manager and get room service to contact us. No one contacted us after that. An hour later, I went to the front desk and was told my order would be put in immediately. It was not and I never received any order or follow up of any form. Very strange experience and not what one would expect at this price point. Will not return 😽
reviews.author: Maisy Buchanan

reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. The lobby and bar and so fun and nicely decorated. The staff is very friendly. The AC did not work each night. We reported it. They said they fixed it, but it still did not work the second night. We had it on cool 70 and woke up each night sweating. Besides this, we enjoyed our stay, we would stay again besides the air issues.
reviews.author: Carly Dorsen

reviews.text: Beautiful facility,  friendly staff and delicious food.  Highly recommend
reviews.author: Leianne Watson

reviews.text: Lovely place to stay!
reviews.author: Alexander Cammy

reviews.text: The spa service was great.
reviews.author: Edgar Morell-Rivera

reviews.text: Great stay at this smaller, luxury resort. All the accoutrements were perfect. From the Nespresso in the rooms to the hot tub and outdoor fires to chase the evening cool away, the Scott Resort & Spa is great! Highly recommend. Great location too.
reviews.author: Beth Bernardi

reviews.text: Great place in the middle of Scottsdale to stay.  We did not take advantage of the pool area (highs in the low 60s) but we have on prior stays.  The staff seemed a bit overworked due to shortages.
reviews.author: John Morsberger

reviews.text:
We chose The Scott Resort for our company party and booked Sunset Room and patio.  The room was perfect, intimate with plenty of space to dance and socialize.  The food was exceptional.  It was located in an area near our tables, but in a beautiful space adjacent to our tables in a private area.  The patio was perfect, partially enclosed by landscaping with plenty of heaters to keep us comfortable.
We enjoyed an amazing cocktail experience to kick off the night.  I cannot express in words how incredible the staff was to work with.  They were warm, always available, professional, and patient.  They didn't overwhelm us, but were present and timely with all aspects of service.
In addition to the event, we booked rooms to extend the evening.  The check in was flawless, rooms were clean and accommodating, and we even enjoyed the heated pool.  It is hard to find a place that is so willing to give you the space and support to just enjoy yourself.
We have had an annual party for over a decade at many of the Old Town Scottsdale resorts.  This resort made our entire experience one to remember and we are so happy we decided on the Scott!  In the words of Arnold, we will be back!!!
reviews.author: BBVSALON

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with pool and spa. Outdoor courtyard is stunning. Bar served great cocktails. Loved getting pics with the Canal Club convertible out front.
reviews.author: Tammy French

reviews.text: Rooms are very inconvenient for privacy during showering and Dressing
reviews.author: Dr Trayourus

reviews.text: Love the location and the rooms. The service from the restaurant and bar was very bad.
reviews.author: Santiago Illia

reviews.text: Beautiful but older with issues. No refrigerator or microwave in the room. Lighting in room was very dim.
reviews.author: Diane

reviews.text: The pool and lobby are gorgeous and a great place to lounge.  The Cana Club waitstaff were rude. The room was dirty and smelly.
reviews.author: Katelyn Jackson

reviews.text:
I cannot express how disappointed I am in this hotel. I always overlook long, poor reviews when the rest are good, but I beg you not to overlook this one if you are considering planning an event here.

I had my rehearsal dinner here as well as my wedding room block. I have severe food allergies and worked with Julie for months to make sure all food at my rehearsal dinner was safe for me to eat. On the night of the event, the chef came out after I expressed my concern that food looked like it had my allergens in it. He went down the buffet line with me and determined that the only thing I could eat was some chicken and some steak that were supposed to go inside of tacos. If I hadn’t double checked, I would’ve ended up in the hospital the night before my wedding. They said there was nothing I could do because the food was all “pre-made.” I sent them an email to let them know immediately and Julie called me to (what felt like) argue with me about what we had agreed on. We paid for upgrades to food items in the package we selected for the sole purpose of me being able to eat it and I couldn’t. They also promised an allergy friendly dessert that was simply not there. They left our bar open for an additional hour that night which was nice, but that didn’t even begin to cover how bad our experience was.

On top of this, we had asked for champagne on ice to be delivered to our room on the night of the wedding. When we came back after our wedding, our room HADN’T EVEN BEEN CLEANED and there was no champagne, which we were willing to pay for. Julie and Avis have done the bare minimum to resolve the issue and when I asked for more, they ended up giving me a whopping $296 refund when we had agreed on half-off our room for wedding night which was $750, 10% overage fee to be refunded, as well as 10% refund on our banquet order. It has taken 2 months to communicate about resolving the issue and not to mention they “accidentally” auto charged me even more in the process and didn’t realize until I told them. Don’t bother planning your event here.
reviews.author: Savannah de Geus

reviews.text: My fiance booked the little staycation spa day Weeknd and after we checked in and walked up into our room right outside our door housekeeping was cleaning the adjacent room 5 minutes later I went to an appointment that I had and I walked out looked at the person that was doing the housekeeping I said hello and I walked out 15 minutes later I get a call from my girl telling me that the guy opened the door and walked right in without knocking and she was in the bathroom changing into her robe. He knew that we were in that room he saw us walk in he saw me walk out. To make matters worse the head of security tells my girl that oh she should have put her do not disturb placard on the door handle he also said that he was just checking to make sure that the room was clean only to have the front desk receptionist tell her that that's weird because the room was labeled as cleaned was she assigned it to us and gave us the keys. VERY unprofessional behavior from the security I'm totally unacceptable by the house keeping attendant
reviews.author: Dennys Damian

reviews.text: Great location in downtown Scottsdale! Super clean 👌
reviews.author: Joey Pantuso

reviews.text: Bathroom grout was covered in limescale. Wifi is $15 per day. Staff is rude. Charged $30 for early check-in to a room that didn’t have running water, and the staff refused to work with me to return the early check in fee. For the money, I’d look somewhere else.
reviews.author: Justin Bodner

reviews.text: This is a nice property with spacious rooms, comfortable beds and great pool. Prices are a little on the high end of the range especially during peak season. The grounds have several hammocks and other lounging areas just to sit and do nothing. Food at restaurant nothing fancy. Staff friendly snd helpful. Check out is 11am with a complimentary 1 hour extension. After that, it’s $30/hr late check out. Location wise, it’s sort of in the center of Scottsdale and a 10 min walk from the Fashion Square mall. There is a free first come first served shuttle service taking you anywhere within a 3 mile radius. Uber or Waymo from the airport will run you about $25-30. Prices for food items in the min bar not cheap. A 16oz water will run you $10!
reviews.author: Alan

reviews.text: We got placed in a room by the service entry and lost a whole night and morning of sleep while the staff brought loud clunking metal carts back and forth outside our room.  Front desk manager acted annoyed when I asked for different rooms at 5:15am (not one apology) and then up charged us for the different rooms.  Also if you want a tiny bathroom this is the hotel for you!  Not sure I could recommend this hotel for the prices they charge.
reviews.author: Kelly Ballenger

reviews.text: Beautiful boutique property, you can tell a lot of thought went into all design details. Pool was refreshing, Canal Club, the restaurant, had something for everyone in our party, the staff was top- notch and the location of The Scott itself was perfect. We were within walking distance of nice shops and restaurants. Already looking forward to our next stay!
reviews.author: Mark McDevitt

reviews.text: I am holding my review pending further action. Photos, Video and Audio. Currently editing a video review of the resort with detailed video interactions with staff. I will edit this review & post a YouTube link when available.
reviews.author: Paul Lucyk

reviews.text:
The Scott Resort and Spa is undeniably beautiful, and we were so excited to stay there. The resort offers amazing amenities like cornhole, a spacious lawn for the kids to play on, giant Connect 4, chess in the bar/lobby area, two gorgeous pools (one with a beach entrance), several seating areas with cozy bonfires, and an overall aesthetic vibe that’s perfect for relaxation.

Unfortunately, our experience was overshadowed by an issue with the air conditioning. After returning from dinner, we found the room to be nearly 80 degrees with no functioning A/C. Since the windows don’t open and the French doors lack screens, airing out the room wasn’t possible without letting critters in. We were informed that no other rooms with working A/C were available, and while a fan was provided, it wasn’t enough to make the room comfortable.

This was especially disappointing for our family of four, including two small children, who were eager to enjoy everything the resort had to offer. Instead, we had to repack and find alternative lodging on Christmas Eve—a stressful and disheartening experience during what was supposed to be a special holiday getaway. It’s such a shame because the resort has so much potential to create a wonderful stay.
reviews.author: AJ Sanchez

reviews.text: Very clean resort and friendly staff. The Canal Club had great food!
reviews.author: Arielle Ambrosia

reviews.text:
Parking for the evening event was very sparse.  Had to park in the hotel area & walk around the outside of the facility.
But the personnel, environment presentation,  and event were outstanding!!
reviews.author: Jerry Storrs

reviews.text: Friendly staff, shuttle service was excellent and location is perfect.
reviews.author: Cynthia Brown

reviews.text: super great place to hang out, specially if u planning to launch a work party
reviews.author: Arizona 4 Ever

reviews.text: Went for a company Christmas party for the last 2 years.  The food was great, the rooms were great. Throughly enjoyed ourselves.
reviews.author: Anthony & Kathy Sexton

reviews.text: The Scott is one of those hotels that spends a lot of time & money on the cosmetics (website, fancy entrance/bar area) and none on the actual rooms, or the employees.  On top of the chipped walls and ratty hallway carpet (I stayed in building D), my room A/C didn’t work. When I first complained maintenance brought me a fan. When I asked reception the next morning they said they would fix it during the day - and I don’t think anyone came. It definitely still didn’t work. When I checked out the morning after that the bored receptionist had no idea the A/C didn’t work, and said they would “look into it”.  Well that doesn’t help me, I’m leaving!  And no offer of a refund.  Disappointing and won’t stay here again.
reviews.author: Michael Walker

reviews.text: Lovely resort - attended a 3-day conference and had a great time.  Staff was friendly, room was nice, food at the restaurant was good.  Other than the unfortunate HVAC issues that seemed to make the conference rooms very warm.  Mgmt. did address the issue with fans until repairs were complete, so overall a good experience.
reviews.author: Heather Nielsen

reviews.text: The air conditioner in the room did not work during our 4 day stay. When we notified front desk they said it was broken and to sleep with the door open. We requested a fan because it was so hot and they said they couldn't provide one. The rooms are very dated and not very nice.
reviews.author: Tammie Lowes

reviews.text: Beautiful Boutique Hotel, felt very comfortable and inviting. The food was amazing and the staff very approachable. I would choose this property again in the future when the opportunity arises.
reviews.author: Stefanie Savell

reviews.text: Beautiful 😍
reviews.author: Tiffany Ulatowski

reviews.text: Really enjoyed staying here.
reviews.author: Kristin Gunderson

reviews.text: Unbelievable stay!!!
reviews.author: Geri Joy

reviews.text: Love, love, lovely hotel!  The Scott was the perfect place to sneak away to for a quick weekend getaway.  The property is absolutely goregeous and well-maintained, with beautiful decor throughout the lobby and other public spaces.  The rooms are also tastefully decorated in a retro-yet-modern style, which we found to be clean, spacious and comfortable for our too-short stay.  We enjoyed grabbing a drink at the Canal Club bar each night before headding out to dinner, and also spent an afternoon by one of the two pools.  The water was a bit on the cool side despite the pools supposedly being heated but it was still a nice place to relax.  On the other hand, I found the fitness center to be too warm and without the ability to manally adjust the temperature. The location also can't be beat as it's within walking distance of restaurants, shopping and the waterfront.  It was a treat to spend the weekend at The Scott and I would return in a heartbeat!
reviews.author: Jessica Infantino Trumble

reviews.text:
The best part about the resort is Jason, one of the bellman. He is friendly and goes out of his way to make sure you have a good stay!

Unfortunately the rest of my comments are negative. The resort is forgotten. Forgotten by those that run it, and forgotten by visitors. There seems to be no money being put into the resort. The resort is dead and understaffed. Dishes were everywhere. Pool is run down. No service at the pool. More than half of the equipment in the gym is broken. Rooms need updates and deep cleaning.

The vibe at the hotel was non existent. Hardly anybody was there and when there were some people there, there weren't enough staff. Instead of getting table service in the bar/restaurant, I had to stand in line at the bar and wait 10-20 minutes to order. Liquor options at the bar were minimal.

We were told it's low season, but when we went to other hotels in Scottsdale, they were bustling. We would not stay here again. We will be at the Global Ambassador with everyone else in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Nikki Shepherd

reviews.text: Awesome place to stay
reviews.author: C Campbell

reviews.text: This is my second time staying at the Scott Resort and Spa. I stayed again because of how STUNNING, relaxing, welcoming and rejuvenating it was. Highly highly recommend. The rooms are top notch with a home feel, the pool and lagoon is breathtaking along with the staff make you feel so welcome and cared for. Best place to stay in ALL OF AZ. It was my bachelorette weekend and I even got a personal card and gift in my room from the staff along with heartfelt care.
reviews.author: Hannah Hansen

reviews.text: Had a great stay.
reviews.author: Mike Mueller

reviews.text:
Shower - tub was broken
Room dated
Air conditioning OR heat was on for the full facility not separate one night was stifling
reviews.author: Kerry Shannon

reviews.text: Stayed here while staying in Scottsdale to hike camelback. The front desk girl wasn’t the warmest on check in but the ambiance of the hotel made up for that. We wish the outdoor bar had been open for pool service but we just ordered drinks and food at the inside bar, no problem. Very nice bar staff. Loved the pool. Beautiful boutique hotel. We didn’t realize the room wasn’t cooling until the middle of the night when it was still 73*… I did ask the front desk the next day and she said that they could have adjusted it for us, but 73* seems hot to sleep, at least for us. So ask to have your room temp adjusted if you like to sleep with it cooler than 73*. We set it to 69* but it just remained at 73*. I would definitely stay here again now that I know that we can adjust the temperature. Pool, room, bar, etc were great! Loved Pressed coffee - walk there in the morning.
reviews.author: Addie Martin

reviews.text: I really loved this spot . Clean, friendly, great granola bowl for breakfast. Nice rooftop and room views.
reviews.author: Lauren Calloway

reviews.text: We have been having our WOCIP Conferences here for a few years and have always enjoyed the customer service,  comfortable beds, unique Cuban environment, Spa and hospitality of every member of the staff. We would recommend The Scott Resort &Spa to anyone looking for a great place for a conference,  Birthday party, vacation or Girl's/Boy's Trip. Golfing locations are also located near by so come one, come all and enjoy! We definitely are.
reviews.author: Elaine Powell

reviews.text: Wonderful accomodation and extremely helpful staff
reviews.author: Matt T

reviews.text: Beautiful boutique hotel that seems to be run by kids. The staff was very young, not an adult in sight! Booked two rooms and each one was at the opposite side of the hotel. Booked an early check in for 11am and the rooms were not ready until past the regular check in which is at 4! Was offered a downgrade to get into one of the rooms but no discount. No view, which you pay for. Pool music blasting all night because twice they forgot to shut it off. Some staff was beyond nice and some had no idea how they got there that day. It’s like going to a Home Depot, good luck finding someone who works there. Waited 15 min in the am for staff to show up to the restaurant during operation time just to be seated. Place was empty. They had no idea how the packages worked and they actually didn’t make sense. They over-billed me by $300. Food is good but very limited menu. At the pool, one day you could order from a full menu and the next you couldn’t. Area doesn’t offer much. The room was great and bed was super comfy. It’s a cute boutique hotel that’s  good for the gram. But if you’re over the age of 24 and know what a good hotel is, don’t go there. It’s not worth the money. Better off staying at the Omni, Phoenician or Biltmore for the same price.
reviews.author: sivan chapman

reviews.text: Canal club had great cocktails  and delicious  food.
reviews.author: Matthew McCullough

reviews.text:
Just got back from an incredible girls' trip at The Scott! 🌵 Despite some reviews calling it "dated," we found the hotel anything but. This isn’t your typical modern spot; it’s a design-forward, Instagram-worthy retreat with tons of style.

We enjoyed everything onsite, from delicious food and drinks to the cozy fire pits, perfect for evenings and breakfast hangs. The pool was our main daytime hangout, where the vibe was relaxing, and the service was spot-on. The true MVPs were the bellmen and shuttle drivers—they had the best tips and brought so much kindness to our experience.

My friend and I shared a double queen room, which was both spacious and private, with comfy beds and a cozy terrace we loved for morning coffee. Our friends' suite offered lots of hangout space and massive closets, which we took full advantage of.

Highly recommend The Scott for a girls' or couples' getaway! It’s not geared toward families but might work if you’re bringing a little one under one year old. Can't wait to go back! ✨
reviews.author: Dwyer Frame

reviews.text: Excellent experience!
reviews.author: Russ Cummings

reviews.text: Older resort in Scottsdale.  Stayed with my daughter and her husband.  While he was attending a work event, she and I spent the days lounging at the pool, nice background music, LOVED the sand beach leading into one of the pools!  Would definitely go back for a mini-vacation!
reviews.author: Norene Ré

reviews.text: staff was amazing, amenities were great besides the fitness center. Very outdated equipment. The food was amazing. Would stay again. very close to down town.
reviews.author: sirkristopher arrington

reviews.text: Thank you to all the staff of the beautiful The Scott Resort!!! From the moment I checked in to the moment I checked out every detail was so well organized for our company Bring The Heat convention. The resort is so peaceful and the ambiance is like walking into old Havana. The room was relaxing, clean and spacious. The grounds are well kept and make great photo opps. The food served throughout the four days was elevated and kept us healthy. The shuttle drivers were excellent. The servers, house keeping and reception were very kind and I never lacked anything. The location is so close to camel back Mountain and Old Town Scottsdale. You will enjoy your stay !
reviews.author: Cyn

reviews.text: Having stayed in 5 hotels on recent trip to the US unfortunately the Scott was the worst.The front desk staff upon arrival had no info or help just wanted to take all monies upfront. Had breakfast on first day which was heated up in a microwave, complained and they agreed to refund, which has not been processed as yet! its a real pity as the pace looks great but the staff and food was  poor, Im sorry to say.
reviews.author: C Robertson

reviews.text: Excellent stay as always. Highly recommend
reviews.author: Karen Dwyer

reviews.text: Great staff; Good food; Clean rooms; Bikes available; Jogging paths are close and Pools are beautiful.  Great experience!
reviews.author: Anne Clark

reviews.text: The Scott Resort is a GREAT spot to host an event or business meeting! The decor is stunning, the staff is friendly, and the overall experience is incredible. I look forward to returning to The Scott to host a future business meeting.
reviews.author: Katelyn Saunders

reviews.text: Gorgeous property!  Would love to stay here again
reviews.author: Melissa Cardoni

reviews.text: Fantastic resort! The hotel staff are kind and helpful. The rooms are beautiful.  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Dana Vettel

reviews.text:
This place is pure ambiance, it’s a retreat from the heat. I’ve staycationed here so many times and have unique experiences each visit. The signature music, scents, and botanical bliss are dreamy. It feels clean and fresh all the time.
Our last visit we were so impressed with the lobby/check in staff. So friendly, and ultra accommodating.
They just do things right here.
reviews.author: Terri Zgolli

reviews.text: lovely venue for adult couple get away.
reviews.author: Richard Wiehe

reviews.text: The resort was fantastic, with exceptionally friendly staff and excellent drinks.
reviews.author: HL Ko

reviews.text: Love the vibe, great ambiance!  Will return.
reviews.author: Landen Lunsway

reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and you really feel like you are at a resort! The staff was very friendly and helpful!  Would highly recommend and will definitely be going back!
reviews.author: Holly Abbott

reviews.text:
Multiple issues with front desk being rude, dismissive, and unapologetically inappropriate over valid issues.
- Kitchen closing well before it’s supposed to.
- WiFi not working.
- Keycards breaking building wide.
- moldy water bubbles in the bathroom ceiling

This place is gorgeous, expensive, and 100% rotting on the inside, literally and from the staff.

Just go to JW Marriott on Camelback or The Phoenician. Same amenities, better ambiance, and way better staff and rooms.
reviews.author: A-ARon (Calranos)

reviews.text: I cannot say enough about this place and the staff. My now fiancé and I were there for a long weekend in which I was going to propose and Allie Lillard and her team were incredibly helpful in helping me plan the proposal. She set up the location, found the photographer and was extremely responsive to all emails and texts leading up to the proposal. Her and her team made every bit of the day feel special for myself and my fiancé as every staff member that took care of us did it with a huge smile. This review alone does not do justice to how happy and thankful I am for everything Allie and the Scott Resort did for us and we i will absolutely be back!!
reviews.author: Brian Romano

reviews.text: Went for a staycation, and enjoyed ourselves thoroughly. Absolutely love the pool area, especially the sand beach entry. Salt water pools are a nice touch, although I wish the pool lights were a little less bright at night. Staff was friendly and efficient.
reviews.author: Jared M Spangler

reviews.text:
My all time fave Arizona resort.. great rooms, staff, food, drinks, pools. Location is great and it's always a good experience! Great attention to detail, yet so relaxed, and that's a winning combination!

Having now stayed at The Scott 6-7 times in the last 8 years, it continues to get better. Its a treasure of a spot, especially when its not busy.

The 40s Cuban vibe is so perfect, the decor is fun and beautiful, the grounds are very well cared for. The pools are salt water, and the pool areas are really wonderful, with plenty of seating, endless towels, great staff that always checks in but without pressure.  With a gorgeous canopy of Jacaranda, Palm and other trees, there is plenty of shade, but also ample open room for sunning your buns.

The music is always great, a nice mix of latin  with contemporary, low key...No crap, no edm, songs you actually like and want to hear, especially if you are an audiophile with a penchant for latin.
They also have DJs a few nights, which is always fun.. Classic movies  screen outside the Canal club on weekends and its really a sweet scene.

The Canal Club is a lovely little bar,  with delicious cocktails ( we recommend the Helen and Maude)  though they are  now almost $20 ea, its a treat, if you can swing it.

The restaurant is always good for breakfast or a snack, and the dinners look nice too.

Service is top notch resort wide, and every request we've ever extended has been quickly responded to with a yes and a smile.

The morning yoga, is a lovely start, a restorative class, not too challenging, but lovely, and in a gorgeous setting.

Bring your book, enjoy the cozy room, the wonderful pool and the truly lovely grounds. Its a gorgeous retreat, especially when its not crowded.

Perfect for a romantic getaway, a girls trip or a restorative solo trip, this place checks all the boxes.
reviews.author: Tasha Bundy

reviews.text: Hard to be the quality of service, relaxing vibe, and amazing location. Everyone at The Scott was on point when it came to ensuring we had a great stay.
reviews.author: Jason Reinhardt

reviews.text: Super friendly staff
reviews.author: mandeep sahota

reviews.text: We stayed as a group for a retreat. Location was great, staff were friendly and property was beautiful.
reviews.author: Amanda Rudd

reviews.text: Simply the most desirable place. Amazing service, very professional yet super friendly. Can’t wait to go back.
reviews.author: Atakan Camadan

reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful! Great esthetics and very welcoming! Staff was very friendly and helpful!
reviews.author: Brylee Helm

reviews.text: A quaint  1960s tropical cuban fantasy. I want every stick of furniture in it.
reviews.author: Lizz E

reviews.text: Not as upscale as in the pictures. Felt more like Palm Springs vibe then quiet spa retreat.
reviews.author: Megan Germuska

reviews.text: Excelent resort strategically located in the heart of the best area of Scottsdale. It's beautiful swimming pools are pleasureable and comfortable.
reviews.author: Manny Alonzo

reviews.text:
This hotel gets one star from me for the simple fact that they either call your room or knock on your door early in the morning on the day of your check-out.

If you're trying to get some much-needed sleep before your flight it's a total disruption.

It's happened to me every time I've stayed here so seems like an intentional pattern. Once they even made up a fake reason as to why they were calling.

I don't blame them for wanting to make sure people check out on time, but, to the managers of The Scott: do you really need to do it three or four hours early? How about like, one hour?

Stop stealing my sleep.
reviews.author: Craig Hammell

reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing resort!

5 Star worthy. Delicious food and excellent service. Perfect location and ride service, loved the resort and can't wait to return!!
reviews.author: Tyrone Williams

reviews.text: Spotless, clean and beautiful! Room was beautiful. Grounds were clean and manicured. Staff was great,a and very pleasant. Service was excellent.
reviews.author: John Bianco

reviews.text: We planned a special evening at the Canal Club and Aleishia was beyond helpful in accommodating all of our requests. They truly exceeded all expectations and made it an incredible night
reviews.author: Joseph Calistri

reviews.text: Spent our annual girls trip here and will definitely be back! We were sad the spa could not accommodate all of us because only one esthetician was working but hoping next time we can experience the spa. The resort and rooms are decorated so well, you feel like you are actually in Havana, Cuba.
reviews.author: Heather Inglima

reviews.text: This is just the restaurant.  We went for brunch.  Time from being seated until someone took our drink order, 14 minutes.  The whipped cream was house made but looked like they put it under a heat lamp after they made it.  The over easy eggs were cooked solid.  The “French toast” was just toast.   There wasn’t enough egg batter to even notice.  The drinks were great.   Which kept it from being one star.
reviews.author: Adam Leeds-Peralta

reviews.text: Great hospitality, great ambiance, great service and workers. Will definitely be back
reviews.author: Toni Pettway

reviews.text: This resort was pretty nice, clean & relaxing, did have some issues for example being told when getting a cabana that the bar would be open all day when it wasn’t it was closed after atleast an hour of being at the cabana & it w. The next day at the pool we ordered breakfast and all our meals kept getting mixed up . Other than that the rooms were really nice and comfortable w a relaxing patio and two pools to go to.
reviews.author: Food Fever

reviews.text: Excellent location. Minutes to downtown Scottsdale and walking distance to a few restaurants. Rooms are basic but very clean. Grounds are beautiful! Staff is absent and lacking customer service. Hard to find anyone and if you do, they are too busy to help or make snide comments. We are locals and needed a place during a remodel. I'd have been real disappointed if I came from out of town for the price of the room vs service. It was off season so there weren't many guests - which makes it even harder to understand the lack of customer care. I wouldn't recommend. There are so many other amazing places in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Mary Johnson

reviews.text: Hotel nel quale abbiamo soggiornato prima dell’inizio del nostro in the road americano. Camere ampie, spaziose e pulite. Elegante e raffinato l’ingresso e la zona del bar e della reception. Ampio parcheggio gratuito all’esterno della struttura. Listino prezzi elevato.
reviews.author: Gabriele Brizio

reviews.text: It was a beautiful nice clean room, the pool was nothing spectacular but it was still fun
reviews.author: Lacee Adams

reviews.text: Great place, great atmosphere.  Highly recommend and I will be staying there again!
reviews.author: Kevin Haggart

reviews.text: My husband and I had a great time at The Scott and would definitely stay there again. The hotel feels like an oasis.  We stayed in building E on the second floor and did not hear our neighbors at all. There was occasional street noise but it wasn’t bothersome. The pool was a little busy on Saturday due to the day passes but we had no problem finding chairs. We had one issue during our stay and the front desk handled it so kindly and went above our expectations.
reviews.author: Abby Neumiller Hanell

reviews.text: The staff was courteous and helpful, the vibe was good, and the stay was a very good experience.
reviews.author: Justin Smith

reviews.text: Room was very nice, spacious, and clean. Bed was VERY comfortable! Love the decor and overall vibe of the resort. Makes you forget you are in Arizona when you are in the outdoor common pool areas with multiple cabanas, hammocks, trees, etc. Very peaceful/relaxing. One of the pools has beach-entry with sand, and the hottub is big enough to share without feeling like you're right next to strangers. Bar drinks were delicious but a bit pricey.
reviews.author: Judith Michelle

reviews.text: Where do I begin . The Scott resort has a beautiful entrance and lobby. Once you pass that and head to your room, it’s all over! The resort has several buildings; all which have 2 floors. If your room is on the second floor, get ready. There is no elevators so you’ll have to lug your suitcases up and down the stairs. When I checked in, the front desk employee didn’t even offer to have someone assist us. I swear the resort has less than 10 employees besides the cleaning staff  if that.  The rooms are old and the dust is incredible. My sheets were stained when they were supposed to be changed the following day.  Oh and the pool was full of leafs. They clean the pool once a day and that’s it. So best you go first thing before it’s full of leafs. Oh and my flight wasn’t until 11 pm and I asked for late check out, they said no and it would I costs $30 for ever additional hour; mind it , it’s slow season and the hotel was not full. Stay somewhere else!!!
reviews.author: bano khan

reviews.text: Very nice all the employees was very kind and very sweet I had a wonderful time celebrating my one year anniversary I will remember this for a long time
reviews.author: David Az

reviews.text: Most favorite!!
reviews.author: Jennifer Garber

reviews.text: Perfect location. Room was immaculate.  Great vibe. The air quality was amazing! Also great customer service. Thank you guys for hosting us!
reviews.author: Julian Palomino (HKDA)

reviews.text: Beautiful Resort.  Clean and friendly staff. The only thing wrong was no microwave in the rooms or complementary bottled water
reviews.author: Terri

reviews.text:
My friends and I were looking for a spa day in June and we came across The Scott after a Google search. I really wanted to check it out because it looked like a charming, boutique-style get away and it definitely was!

We all scheduled spa services. I had a fascial and I can't remember the specialists name but she was amazing. Very friendly and complimentary.

I recommend getting to the pool early if you go on a weekend (we went on Saturday) because the pool does get busy. There are plenty of lounge chairs and the music makes you feel like you're on an island. The pool was a little dirty because of the surrounding greenery.

The only criticism I have is with the pool wait staff. They had no sense of urgency and several times, we saw them all grouped by the bar chatting instead of checking on customers. We even had to come to the bar to check on our drink orders after a lot of time passed. They were nice but not very attentive. Definitely be prepared to pay resort prices.

The drinks were good and the poolside food was okay. We ate dinner at The Canal Club and that was good!

Definitely a beautiful location if you are looking for something different! You really feel like you are in Cuba.
reviews.author: Jodi Amick

reviews.text: This is a Scottsdale MUST visit and see. The entire experience is luxury. Great staff. Excellent service. Beautiful grounds. Relaxing. Peaceful. My favorite place to visit in Scottsdale. It never disappoints.
reviews.author: Renee Clark Coaching

reviews.text: We had a wonderful family reunion here over Father's Day weekend. We experienced the Pool, The Canal Club, and the Spa Services. The only issue was that you were not able to charge spa services directly to you room on the days we were there. I understand that that is not the norm and the staff was apologetic. Certainly that was not big deal. All the staff was wonderful, welcoming, and helpful. The location is great and the property is more than Instagram worthy. I will be back!
reviews.author: Lori Piziali

reviews.text: We just had our daughter's wedding at The Scott. We were here for 4 nights/4 days and every one of them was perfect! We pretty much tried everything at the resort so can attest to it being top notch food, drink and service. We ate all 3 daily meals at The Canal Club and it was great food every time. We had drinks at the bar multiple times and they were excellent. Best G&T ever, per my husband. We hung out at the pools and enjoyed their poolside service. We had several family members get massages at the spa and they were all pleased. Our wedding reception included a cocktail hour with plenty of yummy hot hors d'oeuvres served by friendly and professional staff, a beautiful charcuterie table and a plated dinner that offered salmon or steak. My father-in-law says his steak was one of the best he's ever had! It was not your typical wedding food at all. The in room bar was well stocked and the late night food was awesome, too. The bride and groom wanted a weekend where they could relax and play with close friends and family and also get married. The Scott had so many close options and although most of us stayed on-site at the pool or lounge areas, the guys golfed in the area and some folks went sight-seeing. It's truly in a great location. The Canal Club bar area offers live music some nights and the energy and crowd added to the fun. Although our stay was not traditional it was about as thorough as it could be, we truly did it all. I'll say we are a pretty well-travelled group and our guests and family were all very pleased with their rooms and experience at The Scott. The word "perfect" was used in abundance.
reviews.author: Claire Adrian

reviews.text: The only thing that made our stay good was our poolside waitress Lauren and Logan who helped with our bags and drove us around. Our other poolside waitress never smiled, acted like we were inconveniencing her, didnt tell us the kitchen ran out of fries (at 11 am) but still brought food that was changed around assuming we still wanted it. She was just flat out rude. Bowls of food were left under chairs from the day prior. The pool was dirty and cloudy.  The maid stopped cleaning our room halfway through and only did one bed. How can you have a fully booked resort and run out of french fries, alcohol, mixers, juices, the list goes on. Do better for your prices!!!!
reviews.author: Sara Jossi

reviews.text: Gorgeous hotel! The food was superb. The grounds are amazing.
reviews.author: Brigitte Thomas

reviews.text: Very disappointed with the pool.
reviews.author: Sara Walcher

reviews.text: We loved this place. After reading some of the bad reviews online, I was scared, but we didn't experience of the bad stuff people wrote about. The staff was helpful and very accommodating. The resort was clean and beautiful. There is plenty of room and chairs at the pool for everyone. It felt clean and safe. We will be back!
reviews.author: Rebecca

reviews.text:
Great stay at the Scott. Hope to return soon! Loved the amenities - gym, first-come-first-serve shuttle, nice pool area (+ add more chlorination pls), beautiful decor, connect4+corn hole!, 24/7 ice water in lobby, free rentable bikes, location soooo close to Old Town Scottsdale!

Had a great time. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Nikki R.K.

reviews.text:
I have no idea what the bad reviews are talking about! Came here for the weekend for our baby moon. They got us in at 10am since we landed so early from our flight. All of the staff have been SO accommodating and nice. Service has been great. The shuttle is amazing, they have been able to drop us off and pick us up everywhere!

Rooms are a tad dated and could use fresh coats of paint, but the room was clean when we got here. Comfy bed too!

I got a prenatal massage at the spa and it was the best massage I’ve ever gotten. We will be back - next time with our little babe! Thank you to the Scott for an amazing trip!
reviews.author: Marisa H

reviews.text:
My husband and i were looking for a getaway somewhere new. What an absolutely gorgeous location The Scott is. It smells amazing, the atmosphere is beautiful, and the rooms are cool and spacious. Their shuttle service makes Old Town accessible and easy. There are so many restaurants and shopping opportunities near by, but definitely not close enough to walk in the heat, which was a let down for someone who would rather not rely on being driven places. There are also limited “fast” options, so you are having a seated restaurant meal unless you drive.
I also wanted to respond to some of the reviews regarding the service and pool. Perhaps because we came during the week, but there was always ample space at the pools, and service was incredibly friendly and responsive.
reviews.author: lauren lyon

reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay, the only complaint is about the restaurant service. Food orders took much longer than necessary to come out and internet is extremely spotty so it made ordering Ubers at times a nusiance. Overall, beautiful resort inside & out. Location is great and close to all the cute restaurants and bars. We loved the complimentary shuttle service. The shuttle drivers were excellent!
reviews.author: see chang

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with plenty of gathering spaces for family and friends. Rooms, pool and bar area are awesome.
reviews.author: Pat Sproehnle

reviews.text: Such a fun boutique hotel. First time in Scottsdale and such a lovely spot. Great customer service. Though the concierge service and food service outside was top notch and friendlier then the front desk or the indoor bar. The pool area loungers get get taken quickly so plan ahead. There is also and area for games ( corn hole, large connect 4, jenga). LOVED the complimentary yoga each morning. They also had bikes you could rent. The hotel rooms were clean. You can walk to the mall, old town, and restaurant. Otherwise they do have a free shuttle service that can drive you up to 3 miles from the hotel. And also can plan for pickup. Had a great time.
reviews.author: Michelle A

reviews.text:
The staff at this resort are not very welcoming or friendly. When I went to obtain my room key at the front desk I was verbally assaulted by a bridal party on site that day. There was not a single staff member in sight during the incident. I had to call the number listed on their website to get help. Upon departure I went to the bar to order a coffee to-go, the bartender was extremely rude and repeatedly ignored my presence. It took my over 15 minutes to obtain a coffee despite there being no one else at the bar.

The location of the hotel is great being so close to Old Town, but I would highly recommend finding somewhere else!
reviews.author: Nicole Burgess

reviews.text: amazing boutique hotel - wish I could've stayed longer
reviews.author: Joseph Kim

reviews.text:
We recently captured a wedding at The Scott Resort, and it was an absolutely stunning venue!

The resort offers an array of beautiful spots perfect for photographs, making it a dream location for any wedding. The staff were exceptional, ensuring we had everything we needed to make the couple’s day perfect. We are eagerly looking forward to capturing another wedding here soon.

On a personal note, we've stayed at The Scott Resort for a staycation and enjoyed every moment of it. The resort's proximity to Fashion Square, Postino, and the vibrant attractions of Old Town Scottsdale adds to its appeal.

Brittany and Leo (Delight In The Desert Photography)
reviews.author: Brittany Morales

reviews.text: I went here for a conference and had a nice experience!
reviews.author: Sindhura Maale

reviews.text: While the hotel has had a decent facelift, the overall quality is still a little subpar. The room was a nice size, but I wouldn't consider it luxury. The bed was comfortable and having the AC was great. Everything in the room is additional cost, which was a bummer - not even a free water (in a location where tap water should not be consumed). The lobby and bar area were nicely redone and the amount of lounging spots was great. I would NOT recommend the Canal Club. When we were there, it took a long time for our server to come over even though there were only 2 other tables with people. Then, when we were ready to order, we were informed that they were out of 2 dishes we wanted (Cubano and Queso Dip). It took a while to get our food. I would recommend the Gaucho Steak. They also were out of the Banana Toffee Cake, which was disappointing.
reviews.author: Ali Power

reviews.text: Understaffed, food is good but overpriced. Staff is overwhelmed, don't waste your money coming here. Other hotels nearby are 10x better. Company is very stingy and cheap and the rooms are terrible. Wouldn't come here ever again, company is a joke.
reviews.author: Korr

reviews.text: Beautiful resort with great amenities and a stunning design/layout, for both the lobby building as well as the courtyard and mingling area. There is beautiful landscaping, palm trees, and many little alcoves and patios for hanging out, which I think is what sets this place apart from the rest. I had an issue with my neighbors being very loud, but one phone call to the lobby and the staff took care of it swiftly! They also offer a shuttle to the nearby shopping area with lots of food and walkable streets, so the resort is in an ideal location. I specifically came here for the Phoenix Mineral Show, and it was close enough to be convenient. Overall, this resort is catered to the experience of its guests, and you can see the care that went into making this resort beautiful and enjoyable. I'll be back next year for sure.
reviews.author: Tama Higuchi

reviews.text:
Barely can be considered a 4-star. Nice enough amenities, but service is severely lacking any form of professionalism. Expect to wait on the phone for 10 minutes if you need anything. Expect to wait for 15 minutes to get another beer poured. Expect to wait 10 minutes for a menu. Expect for no one to take your order for 15 minutes with just 2 people standing at the bar and 4 bar tenders standing there chatting about the latest drama. Expect to wait on your tab for 20 minutes while the barista is god knows where. Expect for staff to ignore even simple quiet requests and wake up your loved ones when delivering things to the room. You’d think they’d stop￼ incessantly knocking over and over again after 5 minutes lol, nope.

Expect to be underwhelmed at every interaction. Still waiting on some damn extra pillows to be delivered that I requested 3 different times over the weekend. Tipped well too, about a $500 in random gratuity for the weekend. Didn’t seem to make any difference in service. ￼IMO the whole staff needs to be retrained on baseline service expectations.

Disappointing, the property is so nice. Will think twice before booking again.
reviews.author: Jordan Halvorsen

reviews.text: Very Nice space. Rooms were fine. Wanted to write a review echoing what people previously wrote which is that you cannot find a spot at a lounge chair by the pool because the guests are allowed to obnoxiously reserve chairs with their towels even if they aren’t actually hanging out at the pool. There are no signs discouraging this. My recommendation would be to simply put up a sign that says not to do this and to have staff move towels on chairs that have been unused for over 30-60 minutes.
reviews.author: max blanter

reviews.text: Amazing resort in the heart of Scottsdale. Beautiful courtyard and pool. Rooms have been remodeled and feel new.
reviews.author: PAY

reviews.text: The hotel was gorgeous. Rooms were gorgeous. Pool was fantastic. BUT by 9am every chair at the pool was claimed. People resorted to laying on towels all over the pool deck. The kitchen and bar could not handle the volume of food and drinks and stopped accepting orders after 1pm. Disappointing to spend $450/night only to find out we were competing with hundreds with $25 day passes for space and service.
reviews.author: Meghan Cyr

reviews.text:
The pool itself was an unpleasant experience and was extremely overcrowded likely because they sell day passes. For $460 a night at a resort I did not expect to fight tooth and nail for a square foot of shade by the pool… We came out for a relaxing resort experience, not a Mad Max style fight for (pool) water.
Additionally, it was a huge bummer that the pool didn’t have a shower, we hoped to spend our last day at the pool, shower, then fly out without being covered in sunscreen.

Staff was great but clearly completely overwhelmed and ordering food and drinks took 45+ minutes, with 2.5 hour wait times for lunch at the onsite restaurant. The grounds were clean pretty and well maintained.

Despite some positives, there are many other hotels in the area that offer much more bang for your buck. If you are looking for a relaxing resort experience, look elsewhere until they figure out their staffing and pool policies.
reviews.author: Chris Gousios

reviews.text: My girlfriend and I booked this place months in advance for our annual Mothers Day getaway. We arrived early (11am) and asked if there was any way we could get into our room early since We were exhausted from traveling and they promised us they’d text us. We went to the pool and there was no where to lay out because all the chairs were taken with towels (only half had people in them) so we had to sit on the ground. We got a couple drinks from the bar and I have never experienced such rude staff. The guy & girl working acted as if we were an annoyance to them, every time we ordered. After 4.5 hours of waiting, we receive a call at 3:45pm informing us that “Expedia had messed up our reservation and they had no hotel room for us for the next day/night and we’d have to check out and go to a different hotel”. Insane. We hadn’t even gotten to step foot into our room to relax and they were telling us we’d have to check out the next morning due to “unforeseen circumstances” which is a lie because someone had booked out our entire building. That is definitely a “foreseen” event and they had all day and months before, to let us know this. Finally we got into our room and it didn’t even look clean. There was a contact and dirt in the bathroom corner, makeup hand prints all over the door and dusty Ice tray. Also, it took an hour and 2 calls for someone to come Unlock our mini fridge. We also paid more for a Lagoon view and our view was of bushes . Overall, I’d say this place is like putting lipstick on a pig. Beautiful grounds & lobby. Terrible customer service, rude staff and dirty, old outdated rooms. Thank goodness they put us up in the Valley Ho Hotel because their staff & food helped save our disaster of a weekend. I will say, they did apologize, Comped our stay at the other hotel, & gave us a dinner credit but it still made us never want to stay there ever again. Go stay at The Valley Ho and save the headache, time and money The Scott wasted for us during our short vacation.
reviews.author: Heather Dukes

reviews.text:
My friend and I planned a Mothers Day weekend trip and chose The Scott because it looked beautiful. We booked our stay in January, 4 months before our trip.
