We arrived early before checkin and were hoping to get into our room a little early. They kept saying that rooms were still being cleaned. Went to the front desk at 3 (1 hour before checkin) and they told us that our room was still being cleaned but they will text us when it was ready. I kid you not, 10 minutes before our official check in time, I received a call from the front desk telling me that “due to unforeseen circumstances, we can only accommodate you for one night. We arranged for you to stay at another hotel down the street”. The “unforeseen circumstance” was a buyout of the hotel for some sort of conference. Seriously? We booked months in advance and you just realized day of that you  couldn’t accommodate us?

Not only that, our room that was so thoroughly being cleaned was not. Handprints everywhere, someone’s old dirty contact on the bathroom floor, dusty amenities. We had also paid for a lagoon view room and ended up with a view of bushes.

The customer service was severely lacking…everyone looked miserable and sometimes didn’t acknowledge us.

Stay away. Matter of fact, go down the street to Hotel Valley Ho. Wonderful service, delicious food and clean updated rooms.
reviews.author: Courtney Evans

reviews.text: This hotel is great.  Front desk reception staff needs to be addressed.  If you pay for early check in.  You should get it and you should never be met with the poor attitudes we experienced at check in
reviews.author: Trina Volz

reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, lobby and lounge area very unique. Our first impression was us parking our vehicle at the door for valet and the doorman basically ignoring us until we asked him for help. No other guests were around. Front desk check in was pleasant. Rooms are like a renovated motel rooms, small bathroom. Updated but average. The pool area and courtyard was really nice with lots of places to sit and relax if you’d like, some with gas fires which is a nice touch. Pool area is small for the size of the hotel. We were there for four days and didn’t get chance to use the pool o be because it was always full of people left a towel and a show on their lounger all day so they could come and go. Also, they roped off areas for meetings or conventions which is fine, but it was all day and nobody showed up until later in the day. You have other guests other than your meetings and groups.
The service at the hotel is seriously lacking. There’s a huge lounge and bar with no servers. You have to go to the bar and line up for a drink. On a Friday afternoon/evening there was one server and they were also training someone. We asked for service twice until finally we walked up to the bar. And then they got defensive about it which is really bad for business. In the restaurant we were there at 8:00 on Sunday morning and waited 15 mins for a coffee. I could go on…
We won’t be returning which is too bad because the hotel has so much potential. I think it needs to focus more on service and guest awareness. Management has some work to do!
reviews.author: Paul M

reviews.text: It was bad. Do not go here. Was the most disappointing hotel stay I ever had. Hallway smelled of urine. Room had dirty table and a fly. Room was also smelly - like the sewer vents were not working. Service is average.  Breakfast came fast but was cold. For the price it is wildly out of step. Choose a Holiday Inn instead.
reviews.author: Michelle DeVore

reviews.text: Great
reviews.author: Pastor John G

reviews.text: vibe was on point. pools were perfection. rooms were basic, but we weren’t in there much. great location, walkable to massive mall and Restaurants. would recommend to a friend.
reviews.author: m kay

reviews.text: A great place to relax at.
reviews.author: ulises morales

reviews.text: A nice place to go relax, the staff was wonderful. Really enjoyed all the amenities available. The bicycles are a great touch.
reviews.author: Sandra Molina

reviews.text: The Scott Resort was sooo beautiful! We didn’t stay there, but we did have brunch at The Canal Club which was fantastic! The food was incredible and our server was great, but the manager, Hannah, took it to another level. We were there for a bachelorette trip, and she was so accommodating to us and going out of her way to make sure we had the best day. We love you Hannah! Thanks so much for making our experience 100/10!!!
reviews.author: Noelle Gauthier

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, cuban theme , very tropical vibe. The amenities are amazing. Would come back.
reviews.author: Mairelys Teruel

reviews.text: Service was slow at the pool and in the lobby bar.  Friends stayed here.  The grounds were nice.
reviews.author: J S

reviews.text: This property is so incredible, and is located in the perfect location.  Beautiful outdoor space, indoor space, lots of entertainment going on all of the time.  Just an incredible experience.
reviews.author: Robyn Roberts

reviews.text: Wonderful experience, I highly recommend The Scott Resort & Spa
reviews.author: E E

reviews.text: xxx
reviews.author: Greg Mertes

reviews.text: Went to spend the day at the Scott resort for my friends 50th birthday. Not the greatest experience at the spa. It’s not really a spa. They offer facials, massage, and add-ons. There is no shower, lockers, steam room, etc. My friend was offered a mimosa but then told “sorry there was no champagne “instead of going to get some at the restaurant. My friends  Massage was not great. The girl asked my friend what she wanted her to focus on and the girl barely touched that area. gratuity was automatically added on which was frustrating because my friend probably wouldn’t have tipped that much. There was also confusion at the end while checking out I wanted to pay for my friends , but I had told the manager that ahead of time and it was just kind of a mess trying to pay for it. The spa manager was lovely and tried to make it right. We wanted to spend the day poolside. The grounds are lovey. Unfortunately ,the things we wanted to order  Had chicken in them and we were told they were out of chicken with was such an odd thing to be out of so that definitely put a damper. After getting home, I decided to send an email to the manager to tell them about my experience. I called and got an email from the front desk and no response. I called back to ask if I had the right email and was told that was not the right email and was given another one. It’s been a week and I still have not heard anything. it is a beautiful place but they need to work on their customer service
reviews.author: kelly Elarth

reviews.text: room was lovely; staff friendly and as lovely, and location - can't beat
reviews.author: k

reviews.text:
My wife and I decided to stay at The Scott the night of our wedding in Scottsdale to relax and celebrate our new marriage. My wife's mother filed a canary form so she could have the room on her card in advance as a wedding gift.

When we arrived to check in at 10pm following our wedding, the front desk didn't understand that my now mother-in-law's card listed on the canary form was already charged for the reservation and forced us to pay for the two nights in full at check-in with a new card in person. My wife and I were exhausted in our wedding dress and tuxedo so after 5 minutes of getting nowhere we gave up and double-paid for the room so we could rest after just getting married.

Our package included a $200 food and drink credit and a bottle of wine to be brought to our room. The bottle wasn't in our room at check-in so we called the front desk to have the bottle brought up. They said they'd bring it right away but it was never delivered. We followed up again several times the next day, each time being told "we'll bring it up now" only for it to never show up. The last time we asked the front desk directly when we returned later that evening, they told us "the staff is no longer available to bring it to you this late in the evening". She mentioned they were unexpectedly short-staffed for the day. I totally get having to wait longer than usual for services when you're understaffed, but straight up dropping a service that we asked for over multiple days was extremely disappointing. Eventually, we convinced the front desk to let us grab a bottle from the bar instead.

Besides the service, the rooms were nice, the restaurant was great, and the room service and cleaning was excellent. They eventually fulfilled their obligated service after confronting management directly, and my in-person card was refunded on check-out. They also let us keep our pool access after checkout for the day.

Overall, we were incredibly disappointed in the intransigent service we got from the front desk. We were excited to celebrate our first nights as a married couple at one of the more beautiful hotels in Scottsdale, but the intransigent service made us feel treated like a burden instead of welcomed newlywed guests.

I'd recommend The Scott to anyone who is interested in a nice property in a good location, but be prepared to fight with management to get the services you paid for. I'm just grateful that we didn't select them as our wedding reception venue!
reviews.author: Jacob Browning

reviews.text: Had my bridal shower bunch here. Lots of fun. Great service. Super fun vibe for taking photos for a trendy look. Smells divine in this hotel. Lots of places in Europe remind me of here! Would love to come back!
reviews.author: Kelli Calkins

reviews.text:
The place was okay.  Based on the price I expected much more in the way of quality.
- rooms seem to be a little dates.
- bar 9pm sat in the bar area for 35 minutes no one asked if needed a drink or anything.  At least 3 different waitresses passed by multiple times.
- the mini-fridge is so full of things they want to sell you at 10x value.  They might as well say the rooms do not include a refrigerator.
reviews.author: Tony Buchanan

reviews.text: Cute but cute is not reason enough to justify the cost. This is my third time staying here and the worst of my stays. Booked a room with a lagoon view and there was just gravel and a few bushes outside my room, no view. Had to drag my bags through a long walk with puddles and steps to get to my room. The morning of check out I had a housekeeping person knock and try to come into my room around 9 am even though I had the tag on my door. It happened AGAIN around 10:30 am while I was getting ready to check out. Customer service is very underwhelming to say the least, it’s a nice place for photos but I can’t think of any other pros sadly.
reviews.author: Stephanie Felix

reviews.text: A very nice place to stay when visiting Scottsdale. The location is ideal. The rooms, although old, have been updated quite nicely. Beds and pillows are very comfortable.  The maid service is superb. The front desk check in was pleasant and friendly. I had an excellent stay here for 4 days. The complimentary shuttle service to Scottsdale Old Town is a big plus.
reviews.author: Karim Poonawala

reviews.text: We could not speak more highly of our time at The Scott. The grounds were beautiful, with lots of areas that felt secluded with chairs to read or relax. Everything was so well-designed and aesthetic, and we were happy to spend the whole day at the resort. They offer a free shuttle into Old Town Scottsdale that makes it very convenient. We loved all the food we had at the restaurant and at the pool. We will definitely be coming back.
reviews.author: Mallory Smith

reviews.text:
I met some friends here for a pool day so I can’t comment on the rooms.
The ambiance of the lobby is really cool- lots of plants and open space. It’s a great tropical vibe.
The pool is big and there are a lot of outdoor areas to hang out and enjoy the Arizona weather.
reviews.author: Cosette Trantow

reviews.text: While the hotel is beautiful, there are some SERIOUS security concerns. French doors on outside doors are not appropriate. Even more so when the property is not secured by a gate or onsite security patrol. A women staying alone, put in a ground floor parking lot facing back of the property room is NOT safe. There is no elevator for second room floors and even each wing accessed by french doors presents a security concerns; a good push or pull on these doors renders them useless. My room had exposed electrical IN THE SHOWER and the TV was broken. It would come on, but was so dark, you could not read the guide or watch any TV; only noise. The bar is beautiful, but the staff was beyond slow and in fact staff not doing anything actually distracted and interfered by socializing and standing in the path of the bartender with staff helping patrons. On two different nights it took over 25 minutes to get 2 drinks. The second night it was over 30  minutes from the waitress and I had to personally grab them from the bar since they were sitting in the service well with our waitress no where in sight. The property itself is beautiful and in a phenomenal location, but these concerns are too great to allow me to book it again, or recommend anyone stay here.
reviews.author: kristen renaud

reviews.text: An amazing experience,coming back to to me where I born cuba 🇨🇺,this place is like cuba in the 50’s ,amazing food ,beautiful place no more words to discredit
reviews.author: D Royal Custom Food Trucks

reviews.text: 10/10 stars! This place is wonderful! I would recommend their Signature 90 minute service! Despite having one booked service cancel due to an emergency, the Staff was very accommodating to make it right.
reviews.author: Tiff

reviews.text: We are locals that wanted a quick staycation.  We stumbled on this property and were pleasantly surprised.  It is a hidden gem in the Scottsdale area.  A great value for the price.
reviews.author: Traci Tartaglio

reviews.text: We were in Scottsdale for spring break with our college age daughter and had a fabulous time.
reviews.author: Leigh Turnage

reviews.text: First of all I don’t know why we waited so long to stay at The Scott! My husband and I choose to do our anniversary weekend here and it did not disappoint! We had exceptional service the entire stay! My favorite part was The Canal Club….If you get a chance to stop in, do it!!! Also a ton of amazing spots for picture opportunities!!!
reviews.author: Jenny Thomson

reviews.text: Very disappointed in this quote. "Resort" expected more for the price I paid.
reviews.author: Star

reviews.text:
The Scott is beautiful and super cool. The staff were fantastic, f the moment we stepped on property.
The grounds are absolutely beautiful with mature plants, meandering pathways, and secret little spots. The two pools were great, as was the pool bar and snacks. Renovated rooms were comfortable, clean, and we loved the aesthetic.
This hotel has a vibe, and it’s a popular wedding venue. Even though there was a wedding going on, and the hotel was busy, it was easy to find places to relax.

The resort is compact. When the wedding reception was happening, it was not possible to escape the noise, even in the room. It was very loud. For this reason, we probably wouldn’t come back on a weekend. I bet it’s quiet during the week!

Also note that the cabanas state they include champagne, and they do not anymore. I’m not sure they’re worth the $400 price tag without some more amenities, though the sunkit and cold waters were welcome.

In all, a fun weekend getaway.
reviews.author: Deborah Gardner

reviews.text: Friend took me to the spa for my birthday.  Spa is very cozy and nice. Briana gave me an amazing massage! Thoroughly enjoyed it!
reviews.author: Rebecca Richardson

reviews.text: If I could this would be a zero. This place is obviously more concerned about their bar and restaurant than the hotel guests. Moldy shower. Musty smelling room that hits you when you open the door. Dirty sheets. Bugs on the wall. Not maintained. How this place is labeled five stars is beyond me. Disturbing behavior from the hotel manager also unwilling to tend to guests needs. Would not recommend this place to my worst enemy. Beware.
reviews.author: Laura Hotton

reviews.text:
-Not so friendly front desk
-When we got there and got to room there was someone in our room which was off.
- had a king bed frame with a queen mattress, they changed our room which was nice
- way too expensive and not so great of a place
- service was just bad they all seemed like they didn’t want to be working
reviews.author: Jules Mujuru

reviews.text: I can't tell you how thankful I found The Scott for our global team offsite. The grounds, rooms, F&B, everything was perfect. The team was so responsive and I felt so supported by the entire crew. Everyone couldn't stop raving over how well everything was run, organized, and put together. This will be on the top of my recommendation list for anyone doing an event in Scottsdale. 10/10.
reviews.author: Maggie Durant

reviews.text: Superd experience at The Scott Resort & Spa
reviews.author: See Ling Tan

reviews.text: From the minute we checked in until leaving, nothing was going right.  When we arrived at 4:20 to check-in, we were told the rooms weren't ready despite check-in at 4 PM.  The front desk gal spoke to a manager and somehow we got a room.  Then the TV didn't work.  Then the Internet didn't recognize my name and room number - not valid!  Then later, after coming back from a cold rainy evening out, we couldn't get the heater to work - 11:30 at night we had the (dis)pleasure of maintenance in our room fixing the heater.  While the hotel granted us an additional hour checkout the following morning, housekeeping took it upon herself to enter the room despite the privacy tag ON the door!!!!  That topped everything and when I tried to speak to her, her English was not good and she followed me back to the room and tried to enter!!!  I shut the door and called the front desk.  The room was somewhat charming, the patio was nice, but the service was unbelievably bad.
reviews.author: Pauline Turski

reviews.text:
Two weeks ago, approximately 50 of my work colleagues and I stayed here for a work meeting. To be fair, there were a few positives. The food service during the meetings was excellent, especially the lady making omelets at our breakfast. The bed was comfortable. The car and driver service was very nice for getting to/from restaurants. There were numerous areas to hang out around the property for after dinner cocktails and conversation.

The negatives? Security is non-existant! One day at breakfast, a coworker asked "does anyone know what happened to the blue truck behind building D?"  Steve (you'll see his review) jumped up and started heading to the parking lot. Yep, there is his brand new truck, on blocks, in the parking lot right outside the building where both our rooms were. He worked months planning this event to be a wonderful experience for his teammates to have this happen. He was stuck in that parking lot dealing with this issue for 10 hours, missing a full day of meetings and our evening dinner and fun event at Popstroke. Given that the police said this has happened 4 times in the past year, it seems systemic. Is it just that section of the parking lot because it's too dark and there is a driveway to a side street? Is there someone working there tipping a crew off that there's a really nice vehicle parked there? Why wouldn't the hotel have beefed up security by this point? So many questions! This happened on a Wednesday morning. I didn't check out until Friday. Given that all gate locks had been removed and anyone could enter the hotel grounds, it definitely gave me pause walking back to the room alone after midnight. The entrance to my building was tucked behind a stairwell about 20 feet from the gate with no lock, directly adjacent to the driveway out onto a side street.

Think twice before staying here, especially if you have a really nice vehicle. And, ladies, I wouldn't recommend walking the grounds alone given anyone can walk in off the street at any hour. There is no roving security on-site.

They did offer my friend a one-night hotel voucher. That's something, right? He's thinking about framing it.
reviews.author: Sherri Leetham

reviews.text: I will start with the positive - the facility is very pretty.  The pool well kept and a great spa experience.  Upon arrival, was checked into a smelly room (C building, I believe) that was uninhabitable.  We were moved with no explanation, no help as we had already unpacked.  My daughter is 6 months pregnant, moving to the E building has a lot of steps with no elevator, some porter help would have been nice. Eaten plates of food were slow to be cleaned up, no complimentary coffee.  Really!  Courtesy car was not readily available, the staff was very nice.  We weren't told that to obtain housekeeping we would have to ask.  Upon check out I was not asked about our stay, etc.  Probably great for bachelorette parties of which there were many.
reviews.author: Cindy Rosenfeld

reviews.text: My colleague had the wheels/tires of his truck stolen in the parking lot of the resort while we were here on business. The hotel staff indicated this has never happened before while the police who responded told us that this has happened multiple times in the last year at this property. This suggests a level of dishonesty or mismanagement that prospective guests should consider before staying here. The hotel did very little to remedy the situation - offering just a free night after this kind of experience left us shocked.
reviews.author: Ben Logli

reviews.text: Had our wedding there and it was great. The staff is fantastic, Ira in the event staff is awesome. She is very helpful and gets anything you need done. Korrine at the restaurant is great too, did anything that we needed to have a good time and for it to run smoothly. The room was very clean and comfortable, wish the AC worked a little better though but it is an older building. Overall I'd definitely go back for a stay, despite the high price. The food is really good and high quality, drinks are great too. The whole property is very well kept. Great place for a staycation too.
reviews.author: Doug

reviews.text:
The Scott Resort was awful.

I lead a 60+ person event at the Resort, and found my vehicle stripped of wheels and tires in the resort parking lot. In the middle of Scottsdale. At a resort.

I personally planned and booked the event with my administration team, spending over $50K at the hotel, and received the absolute worst/bare minimum support from them. I just can't believe it. I can't believe I even have to write this.

I was informed by the front desk and was told this is the first time it has happened in over 6 years; however, The Scottsdale Police Department informed me this was the fourth time they have been to the resort in the last year where vehicle theft/damage occurred. The parking lots have minimal lighting, poor security footage, and minimal support. There were no signs on that side of the parking lot, no information when checking in that this was a risk - especially since this has happened multiple times. It took over 10 hours to get my truck out of the parking lot and all I received was a phone call that day and an "I understand" from the team. The gates into the property were also missing locks, and we found one of the doors to the hallways propped open.

I was offered free meals and a certificate to return for my "inconvenience" - which was completely tone deaf due to the lack of safety, security, and overall wellbeing for a family traveling for business. I didn't even stay there the last night and checked out the next day because...why would I stay there or want to return if all the wheels on my vehicle were stolen. I mean...this was wild. For spending that amount of money at a resort and to receive a gift certificate...is something. I don't know whether to return it or frame it.

There's a solid chance you'll see 60 more reviews like this from my team and multiple corporate recommendations to no longer travel/stay here until safety, security, and other items are addressed holistically.

This was absolutely the worst, most bizarre experience I have ever had. You'll see a picture of my truck in a TripAdvisor review - I don't even want to share it again.
reviews.author: Steven Sininger

reviews.text: My husband and roughly 50 of his colleagues stayed at this resort for week-long conferences. My husband’s truck was parked in one of the side hotel parking lots with other guest's vehicles during this week, and in the middle of the night ALL 4 WHEELS were stolen off of his truck. His truck was left sitting on cinderblocks. When I drove down with my children to meet him and wait for the police, I spoke with some hotel staff who were standing by the truck. I asked them if this happens often at their hotel, and one staff member said that he has never seen it happen in the 3 years he has worked there. The officer who arrived, however, said that he has been to that exact hotel roughly 4 TIMES IN THE LAST YEAR for stolen wheels. The hotel provided no real help, and has only offered us a free stay (like we would ever stay there again). This hotel has incompetent security, poor customer service, and I warn anyone against staying here. Your personal property is not safe or protected here.
reviews.author: Brynne Sininger

reviews.text:
Dreamy Getaway.
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles and exceptional hospitality. The resort's stunning architecture and picturesque surroundings instantly set the stage for an unforgettable experience.
reviews.author: Odelia Lugasi

reviews.text:
For a resort of this level, why isn't there coffee in the lobby?  couldn't even buy coffee until the bar opened.  There was ice water and iced tea out all day, but no coffee in the morning. :(

The shower surfaces need a refresh.
reviews.author: Jay Constable

reviews.text:
The Scott has been on my list of resorts to experience for a bit now. Got to stay there as part of a wedding party. Everything here is exceptional. Customer service is out of this world, food is amazing, and spaces are all so well maintained. My wife and I LOVED Natalie, one of the managers there. She, along with the entire staff, made our stay feel even more luxurious. Natalie made amazing food and drink recommendations for dinner, took time to give us some daytime activities in the area, and answered all of the questions that we had.

The grounds themselves are gorgeous. Bushes and trees line the patios along the bottom floor creating nice privacy for morning coffee or drinks before bed. The pools are sparkling and clean, the bar area is to die for. Everywhere you walk within this resort boasts seating areas with umbrellas, fire pits, orchid trees, hammocks or swing chairs, all creating a relaxing and luxurious atmosphere.

Thank you so much to Natalie and the staff at The Scott for making our stay so comfortable. Can't wait to come back
reviews.author: Angela Appel

reviews.text:
Ambiance was excellent. There's so many features that I really enjoyed.

Sand beach pool, hot tub, fire pits, lounge chairs, anesthetic landscaping, quaint rooms.

Just lovely. All kinds of nooks great for photos.

Looking forward to another visit.
reviews.author: Aneissa Goss

reviews.text: A lovely, well maintained resort. I took one star off because the atmosphere of our room was stuffy and humid. To be fair, It's winter in Phoenix and air conditioning doesn't work when temperatures are below 70 degrees. However, I didn't feel comfortable leaving my patio door open at night because, I was on the ground floor, and  there wasn't a screen door or a window I could use to keep cool, fresh air circulating. I did not feel my issue could be resolved in a two night stay and I did not report it for that reason. Perhaps my issue could have been resolved if Id given the staff the opportunity to rectify it. Otherwise, the room, amenities, and the grounds were all lovely. The staff was friendly, responsive, and helpful. The food was terrific and the beds are very comfortable. If I were to stay there again in the near future, I would book a room with a balcony.
reviews.author: Carl Ash

reviews.text: The place was ok nothing great but overall I would never go back,  Not worth the money.
reviews.author: Jeremy T

reviews.text: This place is POSH. Beautiful grounds and pool and extra touches in every room.
reviews.author: Scott Adams

reviews.text: Great location, just North of Chandler Fashion Square and Old Town areas. Decor is so cute and Insta worthy. Fire pits all around outside and even has shuttle service and free bikes to check out.
reviews.author: Jen Anderson

reviews.text: We started at Table at the bar. It was dirty, no one came to greet us. Went to the front to ask to be seated at the table in restaurant. They asked if we had a reservation. We did not have one but that’s fine. The problem was 80% of tables were empty so we went back to area by bar where we were sitting and no one said anything. The place was not busy at all. The place was not busy whatsoever
reviews.author: Derrick C

reviews.text: I haven’t stayed here but I live in the neighborhood. It's an excellent venue to meet up with friends. The foyer and bar area is very chic and trendy with beautiful plants, soft lighting, and thoughtful details. Lucy at the front desk was truly a pleasure to be around and provided great tips for the area, as I am relatively new to Old town Scottsdale. Will definitely keep coming back!
reviews.author: Sophia Parsa

reviews.text: Overpriced for the service level. Snotty unaccommodating and untrained staff. Nice lobby. Dark rooms with cell block patios on the lower level. Pool construction unsightly. NO value for off season. Farther to Old Town Scottsdale than described. Citchy place who's service and amenities don't match the price.
reviews.author: Lisa Wheeler

reviews.text: Love the vibe and the look of The Scott Resort! Our room was lovely and quiet, but the wifi was not – very slow or no connection. We had issues with our AC on the first night but, after reporting it to the front desk, it was fixed promptly. We would stay here again!
reviews.author: Denise Shaw

reviews.text: The whole resort is beautiful with a ton of charm, great vibes and location! The grounds are lovely and romantic, great pools.  The rooms are older, our coffee machine and fridge were broken, but otherwise it was a nice staycation!
reviews.author: Meaghan Gomez

reviews.text:
So much potential, but fell WAY short of our expectations.
First, the positives: As you walk through the main lobby, the 40 foot ceilings, ample greenery, mid-century modern design and cozy fireplaces create a wonderful retro cool vibe. Smooth dub music is being piped through the sound system and you almost expect to see 007 sipping a martini on one of the many cozy nooks available throughout the property.
Unfortunately, there was annoying, loud obtrusive construction out by the pool area the entire time. Eight hours a day. Grinders, welding, jack-hammers etc. This was never mentioned to us upon booking of course. We weren't able to enjoy the pool area once.
The service is also NON-EXISTENT at this hotel Just a gaggle of grumpy, myopic, millennials doing as little as humanly possible. Not once was I ever acknowledged or asked if I needed anything. Horrible "service". Be advised as well that there is NO service for the pool area either. You need to go inside in your wet bathing suit and stand at the bar for twenty five minutes watching the staff totally ignore you. Which is super fun. We had dinner at the Canal Club once and it was by far the worst meal of our entire vacation. The "pizza" is a cracker, not pizza dough. The skirt steak was raw and completely inedible. Chicken sandwich was dry. The breakfast was marginally better. But overall the restaurant needs a complete overhaul of the dismal, sparse menu.
Rooms are spacious enough but the bathrooms are microscopic. We had two rooms so for $1,200.00 / night we certainly expected a LOT more. We checked out after night 2 of our 5 night stay and went to another nearby hotel that was much, much better for less money. We definitely will not be booking here again ever. Shame, because it does have some potential to be so much better.
reviews.author: Brendan M

reviews.text: This place is easy to get to and in the heart of everything. The hotel and grounds were so cute and inviting and the food/drinks were all really good. I’ll definitely we back and plan to stay longer.
reviews.author: Angie Palen

reviews.text: Hotel feels and is architecturally old. Two story buildings with no elevators.  The Spa is very small but the massage was nice.  Location is excellent; but I would choose to book other, newer hotels close to Old Town.  Everyone was friendly and helpful and overall I am glad we experienced The Scott for just one night.
reviews.author: Fidelity Real Estate Brokers

reviews.text: Stayed at The Scott for a conference.  Unfortunately, was cloudy and a bit chilly so could not take advantage of the outdoor seating (which is nicely done) throughout the property.
reviews.author: Nur Rajwany

reviews.text:
We booked this hotel to stay for 4 nights , we did early checked out after the first night because the room was old and AC was so loud, we couldn’t sleep.
Staff were very nice and pleasant but I wouldn’t stay here again. We booked Marriott hotel than the same street for lower price and much cleaner.
After settling and check out the bill. They also charged my credit card additional $21 and I left a message for their accounting department and no one even bothered calling or emailing me back.
reviews.author: Sheri S

reviews.text: Walking into the hotel, the atmosphere is unique with lots of greenery and thoughtful details. The grounds are well kept and clean, and the rooms were stylized and retro. The staff at both the hotel and restaurant were really friendly and answered any questions we had. Would definitely go back!
reviews.author: Kristina C

reviews.text:
Lovely hotel, but no elevator to haul my heavy luggage. Make sure to ask for floor 1 if you don’t want to pay an usher to bring your luggage to your room. I almost broke my shoulder bringing it down because I didn’t have cash on hand to tip so I wasn’t going to ask for help.
Rooms were a bit dated but bed was comfy and cleaned each day. Hotel food was delicious and atmosphere was serene and lovely.
reviews.author: Sara Johannesen

reviews.text:
Stayed for one night, hoping to get some time in the sun. Plenty of seatinf around the pool, however there was construction around the pool area all day. Very frustrating this wasn’t mentioned during reservation process. Hallways are low ceilings and dimly lit.

The room was clean, and decent. Overall, wouldn’t stay again. Especially at that price point
reviews.author: Doug Olsen

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, great location, wonderful food, and some of the best staff I've worked with.
reviews.author: Scottie Girouard

reviews.text: No elevator
reviews.author: Toschma Patterson

reviews.text: This is a nice hotel with excellent food.
reviews.author: Trace Ward

reviews.text: Cuban inspired and stylish.  Love the grounds and lobby space. Centrally located and appreciate the comp. short-range shuttle service. Rooms okay. Was here for meetings, and the buffets served were exceptional.
reviews.author: John Cooper

reviews.text:
We had a pleasant time at the Scott with a few amenties that needed attention. While the lobby is beautiful unfortunalty it has not carried over to the rooms.
There was no pool service and food was below sub-par. Not much entertainment.
We appreciate it being a dog-friendly hotel as it was lovely to see our furry friends.
reviews.author: Vanisha V

reviews.text: I’ve stayed here multiple times and love staying each time. The Canal Club has great food and service. The server was very personable and knowledgeable of the menu. The pool area is great for families with kids and adults. The location is convenient for walking, shopping and dinning.
reviews.author: Salar Raja

reviews.text:
Incompetent house keeping

The first room I went into had pee on the sofa, I was told they would wave the resort fee and they would take care of getting the sofa replaced. I come back to the room it was still there. I requested to move rooms, the next room had a broken tv and rotten cream that tasted great with the coffee. Again the solution was to move rooms in front of a construction site. I was told they would comp the resort fee but they never provided a receipt and even after calls and emails, I still don’t have it.
reviews.author: Daniel Wear

reviews.text: I would not stay again. This resort “refurbished” the space. Their lobby area is gorgeously done, but these rooms - which I think are the more important part of a hotel stay- are just not worth the price they charge. We found a cockroach on night one and nobody did anything about it. The AC does not move. I was boiling hot the entire night- I can’t imagine how people survive here in the summer! The rooms feel like an old motel room, but just redone to look modern. The pool is dated. My recommendation is just go have a drink or two, hang out in their lobby- which is nice and modern looking I will give them that - but don’t stay in the hotel.
reviews.author: Emily Feehan

reviews.text: Very friendly staff. Room was clean and comfortable.
reviews.author: Steve P

reviews.text:
1. Had to request multiple times for our mini-fridge to be emptied so to store medication and food. This was fairly annoying to have to call and request with the front desk and housekeeping staff.
2. Our ice bucket was not replaced
3. Had to walk to the front after 3 days because they would not replace the espessro packets,.
4. The door to the closet routinely knocked into the front room door which is just a poor design. This could be resolved with a simple curtain
5. The door to the bathroom is slow low that the bath floor mat would always obstruct or prevent the door from closing.
6. An sewage like smell would come from the pipes in the bathroom.

Ce
reviews.author: Richard Ferguson

reviews.text: Fantastic. We will definetely stay here again!
reviews.author: Simone Wilson

reviews.text: My wife and I had an issue. Gabriella solved the issue and was extremely helpful and knowledgeable in the issue. She is a great team member.
reviews.author: Jose Calderon

reviews.text: Loved the super relaxed atmosphere here. Rooms are beautifully designed AND functional. The on-site restaurant was great! Will be back!
reviews.author: A H

reviews.text: Nice peaceful place with great atmosphere
reviews.author: Todd Weiss

reviews.text: Beautiful property.  Wonderful service in the restaurant.  VERY comfortable bed. Pools, fire pits, lots of comfortable seating areas.
reviews.author: Conant Sowers

reviews.text: Great Location & service.
reviews.author: Joseph L

reviews.text: Guys, the property opened in 1961. Jane Mansfield was the celebrity ribbon cutter. It changed names over the years, becoming the Sunburst, Caleo and now Firesky. It is old. Established so long ago. It deserves all the respect it has and more.
reviews.author: Gabriel Guilbeault

reviews.text: The Scott is such a beautiful resort. I recently planned a corporate event here and they took great care of us. Our guests were blown away by the beauty and hospitality. We plan to immediately re-book for next year.
reviews.author: Alyssa Garcia

reviews.text: Overall still a great vibe here. The management/ownership is letting it get run down more then they should. with rooms over $300 a night this place should be looking cleaner then it currently is.
reviews.author: Sam Miller

reviews.text: Scott's Hotel in Scottsdale, Arizona exceeded our expectations during our recent girls' trip. Its prime location near the finest restaurants and exciting activities made it an ideal choice. The hotel's elegant decor immediately captivated us, and the spacious lobby provided the perfect setting to reconnect and catch up with friends. We highly recommend Scott's Hotel for anyone seeking a memorable and convenient stay in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Carrie B

reviews.text: Great for a trip to old town Scottsdale
reviews.author: David

reviews.text:
滿舒服的家庭渡假飯店，房間也大，可惜飯店沒有包含早餐，要另外加點。也沒有提供飲用水，房間所有的點心及食物都要付錢。
另外，我用Google Maps沒辦法找到這一間飯店，我建議Google map要調整一下導航。
要求抱怨的是，暖氣太吵了。
reviews.author: C X

reviews.text: Beautiful poolside with fire places and  the servers were amazing and the food was the Best 😁👍
reviews.author: Grant Brunsvold

reviews.text: 滿舒服的家庭渡假飯店，房間也大，可惜飯店沒有包含早餐，要另外加點。也沒有提供飲用水，房間所有的點心及食物都要付錢。
reviews.author: IsaacHsiao

reviews.text: Great peaceful place
reviews.author: Scott Ashley

reviews.text:
The location, food, ambiance and ‘carib vibe’ of this resort oasis is very cool.  Breakfast was amazing!  Service was great.  However, it’s in need of better management.

They booked me the wrong room, told me the “system was down” and swore it couldn’t be corrected.  Internet access was unavailable, front desk told me to call tech support toll free number.

Rooms are a bit outdated, the water pressure was low, and a musty smell was disguised by an overbearing air freshener nestled conveniently in the filter of the ac system.  Picture a dangling tree from the rear view mirror in an old 1980’s taxi attempting to disguise August body odor.  Now try to get some rest.

Watch for hidden “resort fees”.  Ask for a print at checkout.  Remember - under POOR MANAGEMENT.
reviews.author: Steve Berg

reviews.text: I was pretty disappointed. The bed was lumpy and cheap. Pillows were low quality. Floors uneven. Hallways had an off smell. Cheap finishings in the small bathroom. I couldn't find an elevator, which seemed strange. Furniture was cheap and uncomfortable. I couldn't get in touch with guest services on the room phone. The whole thing felt like an instagram trap or a cheap 24 hour motel makeover. Great location.
reviews.author: Brian Baldwin

reviews.text: Wonderful boutique hotel feel in the heart of Scottsdale. Tropical feeling pool courtyard and lobby plaza. Great service.
reviews.author: Sam Gerardi

reviews.text: This place is absolutely amazing. Wife insisted on bringing me here since she lives it so much. It did not disappoint. Service was perfect, spa was exactly what we each needed. We will be coming back, no questions asked.
reviews.author: Brian Domonkos

reviews.text: Absolutely loved my time at The Scott and in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Glen Tait

reviews.text: Try the spicy margarita. They are good... from what I remember.
reviews.author: Luis Schupbach

reviews.text: Planned a retreat for 70 of my employees at The Scott and we had an amazing time. The customer service, banquet/catering team, location, food was all top notch. We would definitely come again!
reviews.author: Vivian Keshish

reviews.text: The rooms were okay but looked worn. For this being a resort with fairly high room prices, we felt like the rooms weren’t anything special. The shower was just ok. I also think free coffee in the lobby would be nice. Just to get water bottles or coffee was $10. I think that should have been included in price of room or in resort fee..
reviews.author: Jane Butler

reviews.text: Must experience the Scott Resort.  It's a gorgeous resort, perfect for girls trips,  weddings, reunions, honeymoons. Enjoyed the quiet, relaxing setting.  From our room, it didn't feel like we were in Arizona.
reviews.author: Terri Langdon

reviews.text: Loved the vibe of this hotel! It was awesome to be able to use the facilities (especially pool and bikes!) even after we checked out. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others.
reviews.author: Amy Langmaid

reviews.text: Beautiful, quaint hotel. Rooms with balcony overlooking the pool were amazing. I think they were understaffed, very difficult to get any service around the pool or the patio bar.
reviews.author: Sarah Hume

reviews.text: Check in was delayed until almost 5:00pm! We didnt have time to shower before our dinner reservation. Not a good way to start a 5 day trip with The Scott
reviews.author: Dan Cass

reviews.text: This property is located near all the shopping centers and there is much to do in a very close proximity.  The property very clean and has a classic feel to it.  The staff were very helpful.  Clearly customer service is a high priority.  This was evident from staff working in various job functions.
reviews.author: Fernando Serrano

reviews.text: Great atmosphere, terrible experiences with the waitstaff.
reviews.author: Chandler Maas

reviews.text: Friendly and helpful staff. Shuttle service a huge bonus.
reviews.author: Nora Foote

reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. The entire space is on brand and filled with all the instagram moments you could ask for. Staff was wonderful and room upgrades were thoughtful. Loved the pools with plenty of space for groups.
Comfy beds and clean bathrooms 👏👏
Restaurant and bar staff were also great and the AV/tech team that supported our meeting was prompt and kind. Finally, the catering was as delicious as it was beautiful!
I look forward to returning!
reviews.author: Emily Wirth

reviews.text:
The resort is absolutely gorgeous. From the beautifully decorated rooms to the pools/fires and lounge. The ambience and vibe are old school Havana with a the turn on the century modern.
The bartenders at the bar, Eric and Sierra were incredibly friendly and attentive. All the interactions with the front desk were friendly and accommodating.
Incredibly relaxing and fun three days
reviews.author: Jen Rolph Yoga

reviews.text: What a great lobby, bar and pool area! Original cocktails that are delicious! Bar service and people are awesome!!! Matt was the bartender, and tons of complex drinks were just rolling through like clockwork. Best casual lobby bar I know of.
reviews.author: Dave Staten

reviews.text: I am a wedding planner from Vancouver, Canada and planned my first wedding here Oct 7th, 2023. We had such an incredible experience. I was so nervous coming from out of country, but Barbara and the team held our hand every step of the way to ensure we were taken care of. Communication was clear and fast. Every single person we encountered was incredible and went above and beyond. The grounds crew, the servers, the bartenders, the AV guys, everyone was top notch. If you are planning a wedding here ask for Barbara :) Also big shout out to Jim who managed the catering side of things on the day-- he was incredible too! We had a fantastic experience here and my client had the best day of their lives!
reviews.author: Morgan Churla

reviews.text: A quiet, classy and accommodating resort in the midst of bustling Scottsdale.  We loved it!
reviews.author: Elizabeth Peterson

reviews.text: TOP NOTCH team and property! I couldn't recommend this property and the team that comes with it more. They are all true professionals and detail oriented. I am an event/conference planner and we hosted 3 executive forums here for our customers. They made sure our customers were taken care of and made sure every detail we planned for was executed flawlessly. The property itself is gorgeous. The spa is incredible. And the catering/food is delicious! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Alice Hogarth

reviews.text: The rooms were spacious, well-appointed and very clean. Mattresses on the beds  were excellent. The patio and garden area around the pool is beautiful. The bar has very well trained staff, delicious drinks.
reviews.author: No Lastname

reviews.text: Lacking service at the restaurant and bar,  need elevators in building.
reviews.author: John Nelson

reviews.text: Wonderful resort and great value for your money
reviews.author: Holly Elizabeth Wilcox

reviews.text: What a lovely oasis planted right in the middle of the action! This place has super high vibes, the most delicious food and drinks, and more Instagrammable spots on property than anywhere else. When you're on the inside, you feel like you're in a private oasis, but it's really in the heart of Scottsdale, within walking distance of Fashion Square Mall and Old Town. This is my new go-to place to stay in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Christy Burch

reviews.text: Delightful escape to a slice of Old Havana with all the modern conveniences
reviews.author: Leto Quarles

reviews.text: Very nice place. Yoga available in the morning. The spa was great. Staff was friendly. Loved the shuttle service. Only negative was bar was understaffed and there’s limited quick service items to grab for breakfast. Poor girl was swamped with people getting their morning coffee.
reviews.author: David Kahalley

reviews.text: Nice place.
reviews.author: Sergio Lopez

reviews.text: Its a beautiful SMALL resort.  Old installation but nice pool, and comfortable beds. The walk ways are dreamy. The in room amenities are unusual, not high end.
reviews.author: Laura BG

reviews.text: Amazing! Loved that the driver would take us to a restaurant close by and pick us up. The Front desk staff was so friendly and our main man Christian behind the bar for breakfast was phenomenal. He saved us with some morning mimosas.
reviews.author: Michelle Willbur

reviews.text: A beautiful place. My husband and I enjoyed our stay. Great customer service and staff.
reviews.author: Carolina Garcia

reviews.text: Beautiful place. Great service. Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Dee-Dee Kaye

reviews.text: Gorgeous property with great location in Scottsdale!  Beautiful aesthetic decor throughout! Comfortable beds and quality bath products.
reviews.author: Sheila Pompeo

reviews.text: Wow Jazz and Coralee are absolutely phenomenal. I haven't had such great food since I've been in San Diego. Love this place and will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Paris Ryan

reviews.text: I stayed at The Scott Resort for 2 nights and let me tell you it is one of the nicest resorts I have ever stayed in. The aesthetic is immaculate, beautifully decorated from the lobby to the bathrooms. The hotel rooms themselves are luxurious with each bedroom having a balcony or patio. The pools are very clean and there is ample seating around the pool. Towels are provided at the poolside and you are able to order food and drinks poolside. EVERY staff member that I encountered was sweet and said hello to me. From the bartender in the lobby to the bartenders out by the pool and even the maintenance people. ALL were friendly I was so impressed!! One actually brought me my tacos poolside so that they didn’t get cold, very thoughtful. Not to mention that the food is DELICIOUS and reasonably priced. I had breakfast twice in the dining area and the French toast was incredible. Bikes are provided at the front and I enjoyed a leisurely bike ride one day. There is also a complimentary shuttle that takes you into downtown. I will definitely be back this resort was amazing!!
reviews.author: Kelly Gallagher

reviews.text:
I wanted so badly to love this resort. My company just treated us to a retreat Thursday and Friday, and while the decor is adorable and the beds are comfy, the staff is rude and couldn’t be more bothered to be of service. (Bar, desk, lunch server at the Canal specifically.)

Our boss did speak with a manager who was lovely after several of us were treated poorly at the bar Thursday night and she took care of our dinner in the outside lounge which was appreciated. Kudos to the catering manager/conference manager and servers who attended to us during our meeting both Thur and Friday, they were incredible and that part was the highlight of the trip- THANK YOU TO THEM!!!

Unfortunately, I would not personally come back the rooms are cute but the building is old, our A.C rattled all night until I turned it off (room 306) but as an AZ native, I appreciate the location and its very cool to see an original old hotel (The Sunburst) restored at best.
reviews.author: Brooklyn Beyler

reviews.text:
I stayed here with my boyfriend about two weeks ago and unfortunately didn't have a good experience with this hotel for many of reasons.
#1 I left my very large sun hat in our room closet and called the day of departure to talk to someone about it retrieving it. I was given a link to make a report after two weeks I was told they did not find my hat. I've made multiple attempts to try and talk to someone in charge about this and have not heard from anyone.
Either the house keeping is untrustworthy or the poor management of lost and found can't figure out how to answer a phone.
#2 There was no way of getting on to the wifi in our rooms. When we called front desk no one answered, when we called wifi service we were asked the dumbest series of questions until we just had to walk to the front desk because there was no solution given over the phone.
#3 The AC was NOT working in our room. It was 112 degrees that night and we were offered a fan.
#4 NO fridge were you can put our own food and beverages in without having to pay for moving things around.

This hotel is a complete joke. A quick flip from the former ownership. Nothing was or has been addressed from each problem we had.
reviews.author: ashley parrish

reviews.text:
I was really looking forward to this stay at the Scott, as I see it frequently on TikTok and instagram and it is beautifully advertised! However, from the moment we arrived to valet to the moment we checked out it was absolutely terrible. The valet did not greet us nor did the offer to help with our bags we had to ask multiple times. At the check in desk the again no on was kind of welcoming or even tried to pretend they were happy to welcome new guests. The interactions we curt and off putting. We arrived at 3 and were told we would get text when our room was ready. We decided to wait in the lobby and have a bite and drink but even that was uncomfortable. The lobby was warm and stuffy. There was no air circulating in the lobby whatsoever. Hours went by and by 5pm our room was still not ready, I went back to the desk again at 6pm and finally our room was ready.

When we finally entered our room the room was discombobulated. It looked like the furniture was just moved around. We booked a kind room with a pool view and it was just lack luster and could tell the rooms were refurbished. To make matters worse what was supposed to be a king bed somehow ended up being a pullout mattress of some sort. It was absolutely terrible. I don’t understand how at a resort that it supposed to be upscale could put any guests on a pullout mattress. We were also supposed to have had a bottle of champagne in our room upon arrival and they never happened.

The food for all meals and snacks was absolutely awful. Bland, not appetizing, cold when the food was supposed to warm and warm when it was supposed to be cold. Getting any type of assitance to the room was difficult.

We booked a couples message and that was okay nothing extraordinary. Wouldn’t book again for any particular reason.

Lastly, checking out was extremely difficult. I tried to speak to the woman at the desk to let her know about all of my frustrations and she brushed me off and said “we already gave you 50.00 in a food and beverage credit”. I ultimately left feeling disrespected, disregard, and extremely upset that I spent 500 on a one night stay, and another 300 on messages at a place that clearly did not care about my business nor care to have me return.
reviews.author: Alexandria Bowie

reviews.text:
The service, the spa, and the room
Was awesome! We had a great time and will be back again. We got the parlor suite and it was more than we imagined
reviews.author: Frugal But Chic

reviews.text: Overall a very nice resort. Aimed at a bit of a younger crowd than I expected (20 and 30 somethings) but they kept it quiet. My one big complaint is that the A/C in the room was either meat freezer cold or off - setting the thermostat did nothing.
reviews.author: Daniel Bobke

reviews.text: Attended a recent Medicare conference and REALLY enjoyed staying at The Scott Resort!
reviews.author: Sharie Rutherford

reviews.text:
Beautiful stunning place. Havana meets art deco. Beautiful rooms. Very cozy. Food is good. Service is great. Outdoors by pool is stunning.
Just nosey in common area. Very young crowds of people and Bachelorette parties. They really should have separate rooms/ parties plus put up half walls up around the bar area.
reviews.author: Alison Jerry

reviews.text: Great place to meet, hang out, see and be seen. Grand reception area with lots of comfortable seating and relaxing yet elegant ambience
reviews.author: John Oliver

reviews.text:
The Scott rooms are great very comfortable beds , mini bar items, plush towels and bathrobes .. we had a courtyard room that could get us directly over to the pool area.  Double doors open up to a cute little patio with wicker furniture ..only downfall that any of us found with the room is that it has a slotted shutter door on the bathroom so there’s no privacy as far as sound is concerned….

The grounds of the hotel are extremely lush. The pool area is filled with lounge, chairs, lots of umbrellas and big huge trees for shade. The lobby is filled with live green plants, lots of fun seating areas, live music, DJ music , fun movies on Friday nights the entire atmosphere is Instagram worthy and makes you feel like you are definitely on a relaxing resort getaway ..  they have a complementary shuttle within a 3 mile radius of the hotel which made our nights out easy transportation…
8 am every morning they offer complementary yoga outside on the lawn we enjoyed taking part in that relaxing activity..
Great food and drinks served at the resort..
reviews.author: Shelly F

reviews.text:
I am not even kidding when I say, there were a few moments here when I thought- I think I have been mistaken for someone famous... The service was incredible, the attitude of every single person I encountered made me think that they really actually did love working there AND were super happy I was there.
On top of that the pools are so, so great. One them has a beach! True story. The grounds are gorgeous with a games lawn and so many sweet little places to sit and relax. If I was an instagrammer, I would have been plastering pictures  all over the internet. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mittens C

reviews.text: Great resort. Perfect location for shopping and eating. Little small tweaks to be made to the room for improvement. Otherwise an excellent place to stay
reviews.author: Erika B

reviews.text: I love the interior design of this Resort! One of the nicest hotels I've stayed in. Staff are great. Rooms are great. And the Cubano sandwich at the Canal Club is phenomenal!!! I highly recommend staying here.
reviews.author: Jonathan Cohen-Kurzrock

reviews.text: This was my second year staying at The Scott during an August weekend.  Have expressed to event organizer, as long as event is held at The Scott, I will be there.  The atmosphere, inside and out, is such a comfort exotic feel with a touch of luxury.  I can't wait for next year to experience it all over again!
reviews.author: Kathy Chan

reviews.text: Great location! Gorgeous hotel! Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Sunshine Ellis

reviews.text: I booked a double bed and walked into a single bed room.  went down to the lobby and they said it is your peragative to move people around?  they didnt even give me a warning before I went into the room and then offered no apology.   the next question is "how satisfied were you with the action we took?"....you took no action whatsover.
reviews.author: John Cabello

reviews.text:
Lovely ambience rooted in a sense of place.
Casual, comfortable, so tasteful.
Excellent staff and food.
reviews.author: Stephen Paul

reviews.text: Muy bonito hotel , buena comida a buen precio , menú  corto pero muy acertado
reviews.author: RAUL B

reviews.text:
Spent my birthday weekend relaxing in the beaches of Scottsdale lol.

It was a well curated staycation...the pool is comfy with a GREAT DJ playing throughout the day and night at poolside.

The rooms are quaint-yet-roomy. I could stay there for weeks.

*my only complaint is the network/wifi wasn't stable...but they have a premium option you can pay for. I assume it would have been better.

If you're there to unplug, and getaway from the world. This is a luxurious affordable place to be.
reviews.author: Chuck Taylor

reviews.text: For a special occasion we wanted to stay somewhere different. We are the highest tier in Marriott and Hilton but wanted to spice it up. The decor was really cool, the whole lobby is vibe I can get into! I felt a little nickel and dimed about things here that I haven't at other hotels such as paying a fee to check in early and none of the snacks or drinks in room are complimentary. The rooms have a great style but some simple painting details and mistakes surprised me. The pools made me feel like I was somewhere out of the country but also could use a facelift. I missed the special treatment I usually get so I probably won't make a habit of staying somewhere outside of those hotel "families" often.
reviews.author: Brook S

reviews.text: It was a great first experience at The Scott. The staff were excellent and the bartenders at the pool are second to none. Great stay!
reviews.author: Cas Morgan

reviews.text: Lagoon was drained, my room was not properly cleaned, view from the room not as advertised. Staff was great, very friendly. Lobby is nice and restaurant was good too. Pool was also very nice.
reviews.author: Danielle Lee

reviews.text: A nostalgic look and feel which provides a great location for anyone visiting Old Town Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Lori Schock

reviews.text: Had a great stay this week for a work visit. Very convenient location, walkable to nearby shops and restaurants. The lobby and bar/restaurant are great, rooms are quite spacious, clean, and quiet. Parking on site was an added plus. Gym could use a major update and the pools are great but could be fixed up to elevate to lobby and rooms finishes. Front desk staff is very helpful and friendly. Will be back!
reviews.author: Dominik Jenson

reviews.text: Pretty hot inside. Needs AC upgrade for sure.
reviews.author: Pradeep Peethambaram

reviews.text: a mini-paradise! The rooms were wonderful
reviews.author: Kate Rosalik

reviews.text: I had called earlier in the day before check in to see if I can pay or get early checkin they said I can arrive early but no guarantee which I understood. I arrived and was told the room wouldn’t be ready until 4- understood no problem. I asked if I could use the pool they said the pool is just open and we didn’t need a key. (Good and bad) I booked the staycation so we can enjoy the pool amenities had I known that we could just walk in and use the pool without a reservation I wouldnt have booked a room. We didn’t get our room until after 5pm.. they gave us a $50 credit which I appreciate but still frustrating waiting. We hung out by the pool and noticed a guy being over served alcoholic drinks and being out of control- made us girls feel uncomfortable. That’s a shame because there was also kids around. We had the bell service hold our bags while we waited for our room. They took the bags to our rooms when we got a room. And one of our bags was missing. We called the front desk and they said they would check for us and call back. My friend who’s bag it was went to the front to look for it- the front desk couldn’t find it they said they would watch the security cameras and check where it went. We had dinner reservations at the restaurant and had to start getting ready. The bag showed up about 40 minutes later.. wasn’t told where or how they found it. Frustrating things throughout our stay. I would plan to go back and enjoy the pool especially knowing you don’t need a reservation and anyone can walk in. Overall not a great experience and first impression.
reviews.author: Rebeccah Planck

reviews.text:
I recently organized a two-day board retreat for our company at The Scott. Erin from the sales team was a pleasure to work with. She was patient and not too pushy during the decision-making process. Barbara, my event manager, was a godsend. She kept me on top of deadlines and provided us with all the information we needed for a fantastic experience.

Our event took place in the A/F Orangedale room, which was chic and lively. However, the lobby was quite hot and humid, which was a downside. Initially, our meeting room was warm, but it eventually cooled off. Unfortunately, the room next door was not soundproof, so I would recommend double-checking if neighboring events will have music if you're hosting a meeting-type event.

Despite the pretzels not being soft enough (haha) for our liking, the food was incredible. Overall, our stay at The Scott was pleasant, and I would highly recommend it to others.
reviews.author: Asia Johnson

reviews.text:
I was so excited to have a girls wknd with my daughter and wanted to make it special. I normally stay at another resort but thought I would try this place out since it was so cute online.  I saw the beautiful pictures of the hotel and was impressed. When I pulled up the bell men didn’t walk to my car to greet me and just sat there. I needed to know where to park so I could check in but they wouldn’t even acknowledge me.  The lobby is decorated so stylish but i think the Ac is not working well I noticed it was  warm and not comfortable. No one was at the desk to greet me or check me in. I didn’t know if I was suppose to ring the bell so I waited and  after 5 min someone finally came out from the office. I’m like ok weird start to the wknd but trying to make the best of it. Then get to my room thought it was decorated cute. BUT My TV volume was so low and I paid $20 for a movie and could barely hear it. The AC wasn’t working very well either and I had to set it to 65 to be more comfortable and that wasn’t even good enough.

But the worst part….Service after 6/8pm was horrible!!  I tried calling the front desk and no one will answer.
I had to call multiple times and finally after the fourth time calling and letting it ring 30 times a young lady answered and says front desk in an annoyed voice then told me she is busy and needs to call me back.  Never called so I had to call back again 15 min later to finally get her to talk to me.
Anything I asked she couldn’t help me with and told me to call in the morning. I expected way better service at a resort and spa but I feel I’m staying at a lower grade hotel.

Overall Just disappointed in the stay. I was hoping for an incredible wknd
reviews.author: Braxton Paynter

reviews.text: Fantastic place to stay. True oasis inside and outside. Reminded me of 1hotel with such beautiful green expansive lobby. I traveled solo, stayed for a few days, Tesla chargers were a huge convenience. Fantastic friendly employees! I loved everything about this hotel.
reviews.author: Tatiana K

reviews.text: Loved the charm of this resort. Location was ideal for access to Old Town Scottsdale. Staff is friendly and rooms are designed with a dated styling appeal. Pool was nice with bar tender.  Food was sub-par inside the restaurant. Shuttle was a very nice touch and used frequently.
reviews.author: Cameron Gray

reviews.text:
I haven’t been to this property since it was a Radisson.  Over 20 years ago.
It was a nice surprise to walk into the lobby and see it completely transformed from a more formal resort to a beautiful tropical oasis.  I loved the vibe.
The live plants and fountains in the lobby made it feel like a vacation on an island. There was plenty of comfortable seating available, a bar, and a very pretty restaurant too.  It’s somewhere I could go to sit and have a drink, after shopping.  During the evenings (weekends) there’s even a live dj.  Which makes it a fun place to hang out with friends.

The rooms were very well designed.  And clean. Plenty of space for two people to relax comfortably.  I loved the sectional and table, across from the bed for having a before dinner drink or coffee in the morning.
The bathroom was the best. Large space. Separate vanity area from the shower—so two people could get easily ready at the same time without getting in each others way.

I just wish that they had an actual mini fridge to put our own stuff in, rather than a paid mini bar. It wasn’t stocked with drinks that we would enjoy.  We bought a styrofoam cooler at a nearby grocery store to keep our drinks cold.  Which worked just fine.

The pools are nice.  It’s just too hot in Arizona to be refreshing during the summer. It was like warm bath water.  And it would’ve been nice if there was more shade around the pool. Whether temporary  sunshades over the pool or a section under an awning etc.

The food was good.  Small menu and nothing extra special but, fine for 1-2 nights.  Plus there’s a lot of great restaurants just down the street.

Overall a great staycation. I’d be happy to go back.
reviews.author: Jennifer Bell

reviews.text:
I came here just for a short staycation with my pup, Mr. Binky. Honestly, I felt like a bunch of things of things went wrong initially, but everything worked out. I couldn't get my Chromecast to work even though I did everything right. Reception was really helpful (I loved that I could just text them!) to get some guys out to figure out the Chromecast for me and they eventually got it to connect. Also, the first night I tried to order room service. No one answered. I was prompted to leave a message, so I did, but no one called me back or delivered my order. That might have been a blessing though 😅

Overall, I enjoyed my stay. I most appreciated La Vidorra Spa 🤤 My aesthetician, Stacy, was very kind and I hope to receive spa treatments from her again 😌
reviews.author: ellie k.

reviews.text: Cutest hotel! There were little details in every corner we turned. I was blown away by the food. The Cuban and Fruit and Grain bowl in particular were our favorites. Will definitely be back and will spread the word to friends and family in the meantime!
reviews.author: Nicole Hawkins

reviews.text: Facilities were beautiful and VERY clean. Only drawback to entire stay was how uncomfortable the bed in our room was. Sank in the middle, led to restless nights and sore body.
reviews.author: Jeff Spitzer Jr.

reviews.text:
Rooms were very nice and spacious. Pool was nice. But not very cool. Could use a little refacing. Air conditioning in the lobby/bar seemed to be struggling. Very warm. Bartender at the canal club was not the most hospitable or approachable. But she was the only one serving after the pool bar closed. Possibly overwhelmed.  We ordered food to take to the pool. Someone seemed to be just "hanging out" off duty by the food drop off area and put my to go bag by all of her items. I had to ask another server if that was my order, which it was. After it had been sitting by this person for 10 minutes.
It was a nice stay but hospitality could use some retraining.

reviews.text: Lovely place.

reviews.text: Will be Amazing new begining becoming Mother having married new father next our lives chapter life

reviews.text: Absolutely stunning. Delivered strawberries and champagne to my husband and I on our anniversary without us asking. Very friendly and hospitable staff. The food and drinks were amazing! Would recommend to anyone and everyone. Especially younger people and young couples.
