reviews.text: Such a cute and beautiful resort. Get to the pool early to get a spot, it fills up pretty quick. The location is awesome, being walking distance to Old Town. The free shuttle is super convenient as well. Both Katie and Lucy at the front desk are the best!
reviews.author: Jessica Heidorn

reviews.text:
It’s a
Nice spot   Great place for a wedding
reviews.author: Randall Williams

reviews.text: We hosted two days of meetings at The Scott and loved every minute of it. Everyone was very much in love with the hotel and the service. The rooms were reasonably priced and very nice, clean, and relaxing. Our only negative feedback is that the F&B pricing is a bit steep. However, the hotel did try their best to work with us to make things a bit more reasonable and we appreciated their assistance. Alexis, Ira, and Aaliyah were all very helpful!
reviews.author: Janice Szymanski

reviews.text: Loved the 60's Hollywood vibe of this resort. Check in was a breeze and I can't say enough about the staff, including our waiter. The resort is a bit dated but again, goes with the vibe. The food and prices at Canal Club can't be beat. Generous portions and delicious food. 2 people can eat and have a bottle of wine for under $100. Loved being able to charge everything to the room. Be sure and upgrade to a balcony room with a pool view if you're going to use it as it's totally worth it. Spa 1 hour message was amazing and my mother, who was a first timer at a spa, absolutely loved her 1 hour facial. Reviews about the pool service are true but you can always make the short trip up to the bar yourself. My strong suggestion to management: Vacuum the pools at least once daily but twice would be best. Hire a more mature staff for your poolside services well. We met the nicest people while here; everyone was having so much fun! Thank you Scott Resort staff for hosting our mother/daughter getaway!! We plan on coming back annually.
reviews.author: Elaine Wilkerson

reviews.text: Very nice resort beautiful inside good service. We are very enjoy their nice cocktail and write bar
reviews.author: Ilan Forsayt

reviews.text:
Resort getaway 2 minutes from Old Town and Fashion Square. The pools were a great escape,  music nightly over the weekend,  and the fire pits are an added bonus.
My bed was like sleeping on a pillow,  water pressure was outstanding, and there was ample space for unpacking clothes.
The Canal Club has a good cocktail menu,  and the tres leches French Toast is a MUST.
Will be staying here again and bringing more friends!
reviews.author: Melissa Calabrese

reviews.text:
Stayed at the Scott Resort & Spa primarily for business but added an extra day to enjoy the Scottsdale area.

Pros: Lovely property.  Has the feel of an oasis, with outdoor seating around fire pits to visit with friends, enjoy a nice cocktail.  Located in a convenient area that you can walk or take their complimentary shuttle to restaurants in the area.  Staff was friendly and welcoming.  Rooms are spacious but very little storage for unpacking your clothing; bathroom very small. King bed and comfortable. Nice ropes provided. An "L" shaped sofa w/round table. Nice balcony area as well.  Stocked refrigerator of drinks and snacks for a price of course. If you are a cappuccino fan, that is provided in the room; coffee available for purchase in the lobby bar.  2 swimming pool areas; one seemed to be for children. Adult pool has a jacuzzi. Nice bar at the adult pool. Good drinks!  A decent fitness room with free weight, treadmills & work out equipment.  Food was good although we did not sit for a meal at the restaurant; food provided during our business meeting was tasty, as was the pool side food options. If you enjoy walks, hiking, golfing or other adventures, there is a lot to do in the area.

Cons: Rooms do no have dressers to place your clothes during your stay. The small closet has 6 or 7 cubby shelves and 4 hangers, so if you plan to stay more than a day or 2, be prepared to live out of your suitcase. The bathroom is very small; had to close the door to use the toilet and get into the shower.  Vanity/sink area small as well and no shelves or drawers to put toiletries. Our room had a drink cart in the area in front of the closet as you enter the bathroom, with wine and whiskey options but this space could better accommodate the guest if they made this a dressing vanity. A nice jester, but total waste of much needed space. AC never cooled down at night; we set the temp for 68 degrees.  Pool service overall was slow; weekend crowd was busy and yet only 2 girls working 2 pools.  During the week, our work team spent the afternoon relaxing at the pool and there was 1 girl working both pools and was extremely slow to provide the drinks/food in a reasonable time frame.  WIFI was intermittent.

Overall, a 3 star rated resort, yet such potential to be a 5 star with more staff for to provide a higher level of service and add furniture in rooms for guests to unpack and enjoy their stay more comfortably.
reviews.author: Rhoda Washington

reviews.text: I hosted a team offsite at the Scott. Amanda and the team were wonderful to work with. It’s a gorgeous property, great meeting space, and solid kitchen. Looking forward to visiting this resort again.
reviews.author: Sean O'Connor

reviews.text: Cool place. Good food and cocktails.
reviews.author: Rene Barranco

reviews.text: Beautiful place and nice resort style feel. There are several different buildings and you have to take your luggage around the resort to get to your room, so be prepared to carry them. There is a bellman but he was busy when I arrived. The common areas were great to lounge around. The gym had decent equipment, though was small and busy. The restaurant was great though understaffed and had long wait times. I took a yoga class at the hotel and it was wonderful. Great instructor and good class. I enjoyed my time here.
reviews.author: Gabrielle Strout

reviews.text: Visited The Canal Club, didn't stay at the hotel, but it seems nice from the outside!
reviews.author: Lucas Kleinman

reviews.text: I just stayed here for 4 nights service was horrible if you didn’t have an opened account you were ignored at getting any service , they closed half the pool @ 2:pm for another party it was always crowded at night couldn’t sit anywhere me & my husband paid good money per night and in my opinion it’s definitely not worth it the rooms were horrible I don’t recommend nor will we ever be returning !! Oh while waiting to get a drink at the bar area we were told by the person working at the bar there’s waitresses walking around they can take your order all because they had a big group there with an open account just ridiculous , they only cater to big corporations parties and other big events so don’t waste your money rude people working here !!! I would also like to add there was dirty dishes and plates in the hallway of the rooms we were staying at the whole time we stayed there (4nights) disgusting horrible it’s smelled !!
reviews.author: Kathy Thompson

reviews.text: Updated review -Thank you for responding. I hope your team at the pool can assist in helping guests. The issue is particularly challenging with kids.
reviews.author: Jennifer Witt

reviews.text: We loved our stay at The Scott Resort for our Babymoon! The location is perfect and within walking distance to plenty of restaurants and shopping. The food at the Canal Club was amazing, we ate there for almost every meal while we were there because it was so delicious. The decor/entire vibe of the resort was aesthetically pleasing and very trendy. The staff was friendly and helpful. The pool was great as well as the pool menu. We loved that there was also a shuttle available to pick us up or drop us off to go shopping/eat/etc in the surrounding areas. The Spa was so relaxing and the staff was incredible. Truly a great experience, can’t recommend this resort enough!!
reviews.author: Alexa Cortese

reviews.text: Excelente hotel, excelente atención... Muy recomendable.
reviews.author: EnriquePC

reviews.text: I really wanted to give The Scott a better rating. We stayed for four nights at this older re-furbished property, extending our stay beyond a conference to spend some time sight-seeing. First, the location is great, just a few minutes walk to the ginormous "conspicuous consumption mall" and a huge variety of nice restaurants. Old Town Scottsdale and its many shops, eateries and drinkeries is about a 40-minute walk. The "Cuban" vibe is interesting, and perhaps a nice differentiator from the southwest focus of everything else in town. The grounds are nice and well-maintained, as is the pool area. We had a second floor room near the spa facing the courtyard -- after requesting a change from a first-floor room. Note -- there are no elevators -- you have to schlep your own luggage upstairs. We would have preferred a room with a king bed but were told none was available, so we ended up with two queen beds. The room was nothing special, however, it did have double doors to a nice balcony with seating. Still, I have to ding it a star because we had uncontrollable air-conditioning. It either worked or it didn't. The first night it ran about 77 degrees. After getting maintenance the next day it worked -- but the temperature could not be set. So we'd leave it running and it would cool down to low-60's at night. In addition, there is a fair amount of road noise from the street. The only meals we had at The Scott were related to the conference, and they were quite good, as was the service. Overall, I have to say that the value is not equal to the room rate.
reviews.author: Philip McCutchen

reviews.text: We stayed at The Scott as a means to celebrate my 30th with my family and friends. We were so discourged with the overall service and help at the resort. At times there was no one to seat us at the dining room for breakfast, to help at the pool or even at the front desk for questions. The hotel was very pretty but not worth the cost. There are much better resorts and hotels with pools. Overall I feel that The Scott was not worth the time, and although the food was great when we did get services, there were many details that were missed.

reviews.text: Beautiful resort. It was calm and quiet, which is exactly what we were looking for. The bathroom was tiny, but thankfully the sink/vanity area was separate from the shower and toilet. The property was 20 minutes from the airport. Everything we wanted to do was within a 5 mile radius. We did choose to walk 1/2 to 1 mile to/from meals as there is nothing to speak of immediately near the property. However grabbing an Uber or the hotel shuttle were easily accessible. The hotel restaurant was just okay compared to restaurants in the area. The pool-side food needed more appetizer options. My husband did have a problem with on sunny days cushioned chairs were only available for price, and a seemingly heavy one, but on cool cloudy days the cushioned chairs were available to all.

reviews.text:
When we arrived to the guest room - the place had a strange smell, there was a half empty cup of tea, mildly ceiling with a hole near the door, and there shower tile were old and had thick calcium buildup crusted everywhere in the shower. The room leaves much to be desired - old chipped paint on furniture, bed/pillows felt cheap and uncomfortable, cheap bathroom products and toilet paper, and much more. Guest services did their best by providing us a different room - but the room was identical.

The hotel lobby, restaurant, and spa were beautiful - I just wish they put more effort into the guest rooms. I would have stayed longer if that was the case.
reviews.author: Isabel Mike

reviews.text:
I just think all in all it’s not worth the price. We just got back last night from 3 nights there for our babymoon and there were definitely things about it we liked but overall, the parts of it that are part of what you’re paying for is a nice hotel, not a resort. Everything that would categorize it as a resort costs extra, and a lot $, so I just would’ve rather stayed somewhere else’s that felt a bit more amenity-driven or inclusive for such a high price. My husband and I both looked at each other at the airport and said “I liked that place… but if I come back I don’t think I want to stay there again” if that tells you anything. I called in advance before booking to prioritize part of my descision on where I booked being a heated pool since I thought it could be a bit cold in March. The girl at the front desk said yes, even though “we may not even need it to be since it should be warm swimming weather by then”… it definitely was not and was too cold and the pools were also too cold to swim in. The 4 days we were there there were only kids in or adults who we overheard jump in as a dare because of temp if that tells you anything. No adults swam. I’m pregnant so I couldn’t get into the hot tub so I didn’t put on a bathing suit once the whole trip which was a huge let down. If they do heat it, it’s very minimal and disappointing.
Overall the place just felt lazy in terms of staff. No overly warm greeting upon arrival, restaurant opens for breakfast at 7 (which we were there right at) but we weren’t greeted by a host till like 7 or 8 minutes past while we just stood there. My husband went to the Canal Club bar for a drink one of the days, waited 10 minutes for a bar tender to even be around and then ended up just saying screw it and leaving.
On-site restaurant is mediocre and expensive, drinks are expensive, poolside menu is expensive… all around food was meh but expensive. The pool has “cabanas” (kinda, it was just day beds under a slated roof directly up next to normal chairs) and daybed loungers that cost extra and for how much people are paying to stay, that should just be first come first serve since, again, this is a “resort”. There’s nothing to do at night other than sit at a fire pit or buy expensive drinks at the bar. No entertainment or activities.
The spa, where we got a couples massage, provided a great service but there are zero amenities at ALL. It’s just a walk in walk out service.
Again, I’m general I don’t know why this is considered a resort and not just a hotel. I’ve stayed at hotels with the same amenities and resorts with MUCH more. We looked into other resorts to compare and I just wish we would’ve gone somewhere else, for our money, unfortunately.

reviews.author: susan nilson

reviews.text:
Let’s Start with the Good:
-Hotel is beautifully decorated- loved the vibe, you can tell the designers looked at every angle when designing each space and rooms.
- nice pool areas and lots of seating but it does get a little pool party ish
- free parking
- spa is nice and relaxing, be sure to book in advance

Bad: ( I want to note we are experienced travellers in our 30’s, easy going, like nice things and expect to get what we pay for. We both work in marketing so have a good understanding of how a business should run. We understand nothing can be 100% therefore I’m only calling out the item that are a make of a bad business decision for the hotel and would ultimately effect a guest experience in a more than average manner)

Insanely disappointing and disrespectful events on sight:
- the Scott is more of an event centre (double dipping), they don’t care about their other hotel guests. The last night we were there they had an outdoor wedding party, I’ve never heard music so loud,  it was vibrating the bed. I understand the need for events but use common sense and only have indoor DJ’s. It was far from a resort experience. We felt like we were interrupting a wedding vs. a paying guest at the hotel. The manager basically said - deal with it, it’s their business model. They did comp. us $200 because we complained but in reality it should have been a free night.  I can’t even explain how insane the situation was, I literally woke up with a migraine because of the insanely loud party in the courtyard. We could hardly hear the TV with the door closed. At one point we thought about calling the police but because it wasn’t 10 pm we ultimately decided not to. (Hotel is an old motel built in a square so sound echos everywhere). My advice for managment- do not allow a DJ outside!! Also I felt bad for the women working the desk that night- she was getting multiple complaints from guest but was left alone without any managment on site (not set up for success). Note to managers: if there is an event on sight a manager SHOULD always be present- that’s just bad managment if no on is there with authority, not to mention unsafe! ( advice coming from someone who use to work in event planning and recently had a wedding where the manager was there until the very end)

Note- if you plan on not being at hotel in the evenings then this won’t matter- this should only concern guests looking to enjoy their room between 5-10 pm. (Music shuts off at 10 pm)
- restaurant food is terrible, we had both breakfast and dinner and honestly I have nothing good to say about it. My sister and I couldn’t stop laughing at one item we ordered- it was so comically bad. The coffee bar is cute though so breakfast won’t kill you but don’t eat dinner!

- no elevators (not an issue for us but I could see that being an issue for people with mobility issues)

reviews.text: The hotel itself was absolutely breathtaking. So beautiful, there are so many amazing details & just love the overall aesthetic. The reason why I’m only giving 2 stars is because the pool staff service & the restaurant service at the hotel were not good. I can think of a couple different instances where the pool staff was rude & spent more time hanging out with each other than being attentive to people staying at the hotel. I saw people multiple times waiting at the bar for the pool staff to stop talking to each other before helping or acknowledging people going up to the bar. A lot of them also just had bad attitudes. Some of them didn’t, but a lot of them did. We went to the restaurant to get seated and wait and hour before ordering, there was no one around when trying to order food. Then a girl bussing tables ended up taking our order after us asking for a waiter or waitress. The valet & the front desk were all very kind, professional & gave great service. It’s unfortunate I had such a poor experience with the pool staff and the restaurant staff. But we were at the pool for a majority of the time on our trip so it makes a large impact that their service was poor.

reviews.text: My husband and I just returned from a delightful and relaxing weekend at The Scott Resort in Arizona and we couldn’t be more pleased with the experience.  Katie at the front desk was very helpful and friendly.  She even assisted us with a family photo and patiently answered all our questions about the property and the check-out process.  We loved the romantic tropical atmosphere of the restaurant, The Canal Club, and were impressed by their menu and especially enjoyed chatting with Kayla, one of the restaurant staff who explained some of the resort history to us.  All of the staff were great and so helpful.  For us, something that really impressed was the gorgeous and fully equipped cocktail bar and especially the skilled mixologist there, Rachel, who had an impressive knowledge of her craft and of all the truly classic cocktails.  She was fun to chat with - professional yet personable and she happily shared her expert suggestions for drinks both on and off-menu that turned out to be just what we were looking for.  We stayed three nights and our room was beautiful and clean and quiet with a gorgeous view overlooking a pond and fountain.  We fell in love with the art throughout the resort and especially enjoyed the scent in the hallways/lobby,  We were excited to discover that we could purchase The Scott Resort lobby scent in a spritzer to take home, which we did.  We can’t wait to visit again!!!

reviews.text: The Scott is a beautiful hotel. The decor + grounds are beautiful! While I felt the common areas are immaculate and bright + beautiful, the rooms are just so-so for the price. Ours was very dark compared to the photos on the website, + tended to smell of toilet water after housekeeping was in (Housekeeping did a great job, it just didn't seem to smell the most pleasant when you first entered the room). You also have to do a specific request to switch from AC to Heat...just turning the thermostat all the way up will still blow cold air on you. I also felt that the front staff was always hidden away in the back room and seemed to take about 5 minutes always before they came out to help you. But overall, it is a breathtakingly beautiful hotel. The valet staff were impeccable + very accommodating with the shuttle services (a wonderful feature that transports you within 3 miles of the hotel). The service/catering staff were also quick+helpful during meals, the internet worked great, the gym was well-kept + had plenty of options. It was too cold to visit the pool on my stay, but it looked lovely as well. Would I stay here again? If the price dropped. For me, the discounted $319/nt for a group rate was still a bit high and I'm glad I split it with a roommate. If it were $249/nt or less, I'd definitely consider another stay!

reviews.text:
The Scott was amazing for a lot of reasons - super cool vibe, loved the details and gold accents in the room and throughout the resort. The pool was gorgeous, the food was delicious, the grounds had amazing seating areas and we had a massage at the spa which was phenomenal.

The downside though was our particular room. Every room has a balcony which looked so great to sit out on especially in the morning with your coffee but our room was the only one where instead of wrought iron bars we had a cement wall. So we literally couldn’t see a thing, no light got in and we felt like we were in prison. Despite that there were many unoccupied rooms we were told by the lady at the front desk we could not be moved. We felt like we explained our situation and asked extremely politely but we felt like she actually drew attention by raising her voice and making it almost embarrassing for us. Other than that experience, everyone who worked there that we encountered was nice.

We were staying for 7 days and so decided to leave early and spend our last couple nights at the shadow mountain resort which was also a gorgeous resort.
