reviews.author: Caroline H

reviews.text:
The Scott Resort is a hotel that just really wants to be a conference center. There were multiple conferences being held on the property during our weekend stay. The main pool closed early on Saturday for an event and all paying hotel guests were forced to share the smaller pool with no amenities. The pool bar was closed to paying guests and there was no drink service being provided. There were no towels at the smaller pool for guests. The smaller pool was very dirty. I assume workers were busy setting up for the multiple events. Every single chair had an old towel laying on it that had obviously been there for hours. The pool coping was riddled with empty cans and dirty glasses. We had to walk through the main pool in our swimsuits to get a towel. A lady working the event rudely told us, "unfortunately the pool is closed and you can't be in here". We explained we were just trying to get a pool towel and walked right past her.
In addition to the pool being closed, there was another event being held on the resort grounds and they had half of the grounds closed off to paying guests. We could not go in that green turf area to relax and have a drink. We paid more for a pool facing room so it sucked we couldn't use the pool and had to watch other people attending an event enjoy it. There was music playing at both events throughout the night. We had to turn our TV up pretty loud to block it out.
Our toilet in the room was very finicky and loud. We kept thinking it would get stopped up, but we eventually figured out the truck to properly flush it. I'm sure it woke up our neighbors when we flushed in the middle of the night. There was trash outside of guest rooms in the hallway that stayed there for days. Again, I'm sure the workers were too busy preparing for events than attending to hotel guests.
The hotel lobby is very well decorated and a great space to enjoy when there isn't an event going on, of course. The hotel lobby was riddled with booths, equipment for photo shoots, large machines from the company hosting an event. Definitely could not enjoy the beautiful lobby space as a paying guest.
When you stay at a hotel connected to a conference center, you expect these things, but not at a pricey boutique hotel.
I will never stay here again as I felt very undervalued and unappreciated as a paying hotel guest and would not recommend it to others.
reviews.author: Ashley E. Lewing

reviews.text: The canal club has excellent food and service. I love their side option of plantain banana chips or tostones.
reviews.author: Catherine Anderson

reviews.text: Rooms were very nice and spacious, but the shower drained slowly (I tried calling front desk many times, no answer). Secondly, the walls are very thin. I heard people's conversation so clearly in the next room and in the hallway. I had to turn up my TV volume to drown them out.
reviews.author: Anne U

reviews.text: I have never had a worse experience at a hotel than this last weekend at The Scott. The level of uncleanliness was unsettling. Bugs and mildew smell the entire stay. When trying to inquire about how the poolside service works (because the waitress was nowhere in sight) the bartender was extremely rude. I’m normally very patient and kind to those in service business, even when they don’t reflect the same, but this girl was so awful, It completely ruined our morning and we left our trip early. I mean, gossiping to the other staff and laughing and pointing at us was completely uncalled for. We also paid for a pool view room and what we received was a view of stairs and the back of a bar. This place is overrated. Save your money.
reviews.author: Baylie M

reviews.text: The front desk staff was extremely friendly and welcoming. That was probably the only good thing about our stay. When we got to our room, there was an old plate of food with 2 dead cockroaches right outside our door. The food and bugs were still there when we left the next day. Our bathroom sink had chunks of bar soap everywhere and there were crumbs of food all over our nightstand. Our shower leaked the entire time and smelled like mildew. This place is extremely run down. The bartender that was working the next morning was extremely rude and condescending. It was our first time at this hotel and she wouldn’t even answer basic questions we had about the menu and poolside service. The waitress that was taking orders never even came and took ours. We ended up leaving. We were treated awful by the staff and that alone ruined our entire experience. This place is not worth the money. We probably would have had a better experience at a holiday inn or motel. Overall the worse experience I’ve had at a hotel.
reviews.author: Alex Bloomfield

reviews.text: Nice Place, Great locations.
reviews.author: Timothy McCoy

reviews.text: Stunning property in a great location
reviews.author: Marcie Lewis

reviews.text: The name of the hotel is The Scott Resort & Spa, however our dining experience did not meet my expectations of a resort.  Food and drinks tasted great! But our first night we were told we could not eat at the restaurant because there was no availability.  However there were empty tables. They told us we could sit in the lobby and order from the same menu. As a guest of the hotel I would have thought The Scott would leave availability for people who are paying to stay here. This happened to us the next day when attempting to have brunch at the hotel. We were told there was no availability and to sit out in the lobby. I asked the restaurant host if they were short staffed because there were several empty tables within the restaurant. She said no they just had full reservations. We went and sat in the lobby and a few minutes later she came over and told us they had a last minute cancellation and would be able to seat us in the restaurant. We were grateful but still frustrated. Lastly, while enjoying the pool I asked the waitress if I could have a coffee. She told me that I would have to walk to the bar within the hotel to order myself a coffee, she could not bring me one. Considering the price per night to stay at the resort, the service we received was lower than our expectations. While all these inconveniences were small, it left us feeling that the "resort" should be renamed The Scott Hotel.
reviews.author: Alizabeth Ennis

reviews.text: Pro golfers off-season practice retreat. Service is Great
reviews.author: C E Camera

reviews.text: Very good
reviews.author: Fabio Luiz Braggio

reviews.text:
This resort was really nice. The rooms are bright with natural light during the day, they have a nice pool and hot tub plenty of drink options and done delicious meals in the menu.
I spent a weekend attending a festival and was starting to feel at home when it was about time to leave
reviews.author: Ayane Azevedo

reviews.text: Overall my experience at the Scott was fine. I attended a conference there and found the resort to be nice. The staff were friendly and helpful. However, the pool is small and not very inviting unless you are there to sunbathe. The lobby is small and gets overrun with bachelorette groups, which are loud in the afternoons and evenings. While there, I received a massage. The massage was nice, but the spa is small and lacks many amenities like a locker room with sauna, etc.
reviews.author: Brian Dixon

reviews.text: This resort is small but beautiful, well decorated, relaxing, and its location is perfect. Am not a big fan of the room hallway though. The smell of the hotel triggered my allergy very bad. Housekeeping needs to improve a little. Customer service is great and the lobby and outdoor areas are just beautiful and stunning. I still recommend the resort.
reviews.author: Sa A

reviews.text:
An amazing experience <3 The staff was so friendly, the food and beverage was always consistently exceptional, and all the details of the resort were so thoughtful. We did have a spa experience (couples massage) and it was one of the best i've had --- even my husband, who had never had one, said he  really enjoyed it and wants to get another! The staff made us both feel so comfortable and relaxed all throughout our stay.

The shuttle service was so convenient, thank you for offering this!

Also, just wanted to point out a small detail... we really enjoyed the music that was played during the pool hours.. it just felt SO relaxing and very on theme of the hotel. Can't wait to come back!!
reviews.author: Elizabeth Moroz

reviews.text: Great place to stay, I highly recommend it!
reviews.author: Kimberly Pagano

reviews.text: The location is perfect, we enjoyed the bicycles.  Lovely property, spacious rooms, the pool scene is nice but watch your bill.  Seems everything has a mistake or an upcharge.
reviews.author: Debbie Reynolds

reviews.text: Een populair en druk hotel. Ietwat trage service en nogal aan de prijs
reviews.author: Mickel E

reviews.text: Overall, the Scott was a good stay. The hallways had a somewhat foul oder, but that could have been a combination of the old building and lots of people smoking weed in their rooms (labor day weekend). The shower is in great need of a desalination, it looked pretty bad. Beyond that, it's an old hotel that is well cared for.
reviews.author: Eric Haltom

reviews.text: Very nice "old money" almost Caribbean vibe ..friendly staff good food
reviews.author: Matthew Paul

reviews.text: Great Resort Love the Feel! Very Beautiful Grounds.
reviews.author: Dave Dillman

reviews.text: The hotel is nice and the surrounding landscaping helps with the ambiance. The rooms were about what you would expect for the price and location, but they could use a little upgrading and the mattress needs updating. I liked the pool area and the bar at the pool. The best part about our time here was the pool staff from the bar. They were very attentive and quick to come around and make sure your glass was full. They also didn't let any drink cups sit empty and gathered them up quickly. They get an A++ Overall I give the resort a 4star and it just needs a little more upkeep to the buildings.
reviews.author: Bo Brosemann

reviews.text: Absolutely LOVE The Scott Resort!  Great design, vibe, staff - yummy food and drinks. I stay here everytime I am in town :)
The rooms and resort is beautiful!
reviews.author: Paige Pitcher

reviews.text: The food at the Cuban bar needs alot of help..
reviews.author: Sean Martin

reviews.text: The staff were amazing. Let's open with that. Everything else was meh. The rooms are dated and in at least 2 rooms I was in (mine and a friend) the TV's didn't work. The resort is really just a hotel with a poolside bar. There is nothing resort like about it. The location is perfect, minutes from the fashion mall and everything that goes with that. The main lobby isn't properly air conditioned, probably because it has a 30 foot ceiling so everytime you venture there its not comfortable. Additionally there isn't nearly enough parking and the layout of the property is weird. You have to walk outside every time you want to go somewhere else in the hotel.
reviews.author: Keith Gregory

reviews.text: Reserved this stay for my wife’s birthday staycation. I placed a birthday note in the reservation and mentioned it again when checking in - nothing was done. The room had drywall damage, a bathroom door that would not close unless heavily pushed, extremely loud creaking doors that would wake our child; to name a few. Shortly after getting into the room I placed the do not disturb sign on the door, 30 minutes later a maid knocked once and immediately opened and walked through the door while I was undressing into my bathing suit. A couple hours later, she entered the room again when I specifically stated to leave additional plastic laundry bags outside the door.  My wife and I were so upset we almost decided to just go back home. The next day at the restaurant I asked to see the lunch menu while my family was at the pool. The hostess argued with me that I need to scan the URL code to view the menu, after I continuously stated I didn’t have my phone and that it was at the pool. After standing there for 10 minutes telling me about the URL code, she finally grabbed the paper menu underneath her counter. Very unprofessional and unnecessary to get annoyed that I do not have a phone on my person. The sand at the sand pool was almost all in the water and exposing the concrete and sharp edges on the beach side. It was very unsafe to allow our 2 year old to play there and not comfortable to walk in the rough surface. When checking out, I wanted to mention the issues that we experienced at our room and the person at the counter was in such a mood (as if she didn’t want to be there) and attitude as if I was interrupting her from something else. We’re very disappointed with this visit and we’re shocked with the recent service compared to our previous visits. All in all, we would have had a more memorable time just spending the weekend at home.
reviews.author: Christopher Mitar

reviews.text: Rating the conference areas... Attended a work conference. The staff is friendly and the rooms are spacious. The parking is another story, limited.  I did notice that the pools are nice
reviews.author: Rolando Jaimez

reviews.text:
Beautiful property with comfortable and lovely rooms. Lots of pool area, never too busy (i was there in july)

Enjoyed the signature spa experience.

Very excited to see some gluten free options on the menu and had the gf avocado toast every morning (be careful! the egg will be runny unless you specify otherwise).

Would recommend and stay here again.
reviews.author: Chantal Wall

reviews.text: This is a lovely little place in a great location. We enjoyed the canal club and restaurant.  Service was friendly. I highly recommend the Cuban sandwich for brunch. For a sweet treat with coffee ask for the mini donuts, the guava sauce was amazing!. It's 3 minutes away from fine dining and fashion Square mall. We enjoyed our stay for sure.
reviews.author: Fabiola Chinchilla

reviews.text: Awesome place!
reviews.author: Madison Clark

reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay, the only thing lacking was service by the pool, but I'm in the industry so I understand( understaff ect) But overall had Pleasent time!! It was very clean! We will be goin back!!
reviews.author: Jacey Nicole

reviews.text: Amazing, canal club outstanding
reviews.author: Neto Hastedt

reviews.text: Nice resort .However, very expensive for what you are getting.
reviews.author: Gerry Fox

reviews.text: 5/5 !!! Hayley at the pool bar was the best !!!! She was attentive, kept the drinks coming and we loved her energy! We are from NYC where service in the city is such a hit or a miss, but this was 100% a hit! 10/10 would recommend, Hayley, THANK YOU for helping our girls trip be such a success!:):):):)! Enjoy The Scott and ask for Hayley every time!!
reviews.author: Mica

reviews.text: Lovely property with retro feel and great services.  Loved the room and the 70's charm😊❤️👍
reviews.author: Sirish Capoor

reviews.text: It's a lovely place and if you have allergies to scents/perfumes this is not the place for you. Their AC has added atmospherics (scent) which while subtle, aggravated my allergies and were unavoidable. I tried to keep the AC off while I was out of the room to minimize my exposure but when it's 113 degrees out, that's not practical.
reviews.author: Carrie “Eve” Wenzel

reviews.text: The vibe/decor was excellent!  The pools were very relaxing during the week.  They were very busy on the weekend but we still enjoyed our time at the pool by grabbing a spot around 9a. The staff were friendly and attentive.  We will be back!
reviews.author: Tanya Legg

reviews.text: Absolutely fabulous resort. Insta worthy, clean, staff was super nice and helpful. Car service available to take you downtown was a great touch. Rooms were spacious with cute little balcony’s. We went for an event and the event space was great. Would highly recommend
reviews.author: Tanya Abbate

reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful resort! The staff are friendly and very helpful. I can’t wait to visit again!
reviews.author: Nanci Fox

reviews.text: Very cute boutique hotel! The check-in staff is so nice and helpful and the bartenders at canal club and pool are all very sweet! I will be back just because the customer service is amazing!
reviews.author: Giselle Padilla

reviews.text: We had the best time here.  It has a very comfortable and laid  back atmosphere.  Everyone is fantastic!  The Canal Club has fabulous food.  The pools were great with fantastic drink service.  We would stay again in a heartbeat!!
reviews.author: Julie Copp

reviews.text: This was our 2nd year in a row staying here for a couple's staycation. We love the vibes! It's so relaxing... plants everywhere, carribbean/Cuban feel, unique food, split pool under the large trees. We enjoy sitting in the lobby with drinks in hand and people watching. So many Bachelorette and birthday celebrations. It's nice when they go out on the town Friday and Saturday nights and then sleep in the next morning because then we have the pools basically to ourselves for late and early swims. I enjoy ask the little spots to touch away in with a book.  The bar is open at 7 for coffee and certain breakfast items that I take and enjoy by the pool. The restaurant and bar have unique food items. In regards to other reviews... yes I've seen the room service for sit out about 24 hours in the hallways.. unsure why. For those who complained about a dirty pool... I'm out there in the early morning when they are cleaning it and they put in a lot of work. I own a pool in AZ and it's a full time job. In order to enjoy having the big shade trees and ambiance over the pool there is going to be a constant tree litter. For those that say the rooms are old... it's an older style and I enjoy the charm and feel. If you are looking for busy luxury resort this isn't it... but that's what we enjoy about it. It's not a huge place with tons of activities but it makes us slow down for a weekend and just relax and enjoy and reconnect. We will probably be back again next year!
reviews.author: msbusyblonde

reviews.text: I had one of the best weekends of my life! Seriously this resort is the most beautiful place I have ever stayed at! I can't wait to come back and bring my family!
reviews.author: Jessica McCarty

reviews.text: The hotel and rooms were really nice but the tacos and drink I had was meh. Also, Cuban food but no ropa vieja? That should have been a red flag, lol. I would stay at this resort again but would get food and drinks elsewhere.
reviews.author: Beta_xa2

reviews.text: Such a beautiful resort. The ambience is super nice and the rooms were really are done! Definitely a higher up 4 star hotel!
reviews.author: Desirae Bock

reviews.text: The canal club has a very small menu, room service is even more limited. They failed to follow through with instructions for our turn down services that we paid for. They were told in the reservation notes about this stay and failed to give us what we were looking for. The room was clean and tidy. The resort in itself is very nice. The spa… this was by far the thing that saved the stay. The staff in the spa were amazingly friendly. They focused on everything that we asked them too and even finished it off with a mimosa and some lemon sand which cookies. The staff at check in for the resort seemed unbothered that we were there and didn’t seem to care that we had no idea about anything about this resort. It wasn’t until AFTER we left that I found out about the welcoming beverages in the lobby. Checkout was about the same experience… there was no one at the desk and we waited for some time for someone to come. I’m not sure if I’d recommend anyone to stay here… I would like to give them a second chance for redemption but the (should of been) specialness of this stay is not something that can be made up.
reviews.author: Autumn Bourque

reviews.text: Great vibes and the staff is amazing
reviews.author: Gabriel Landreville

reviews.text: I just loved this resort!! From the decor, to the front desk staff, to the others working around the resort, to the first person of contact when you drive up to the door. The shuttle drivers were AMAZING, POLITE and PERSONABLE! Josiah, Jacob and the other two gentlemen I can't remember their names but thank you for your service!! This resort is the perfect location for photoshoots, weddings and just a quick weekend getaway!
reviews.author: TAUNYA GREEN

reviews.text: The best decoration i have seen attention to detail nice front desk  lady
reviews.author: Vito

reviews.text: Great place with awesome people.
reviews.author: Richard Goodman

reviews.text: We went for business meetings, everything was great; staff. the food the only thing about the rooms was, they just didn't seem to cool down enough until late at night.
reviews.author: Bill Harod

reviews.text: Unfortunately we were very disappointed with our experience. We checked in our room which was smooth, but once we arrived in the hallway to the room we were blasted with a mildew smell. The hallway was extremely dirty. Once we entered the room I could not believe how dated the room was, especially for this resort advertising 4 stars. We stayed in our room less than 5 minutes because of the overpowering smell of mildew. We also requested a courtyard view, and instead we had a view of some 1960’s apartment complex  and old power lines, which had been attempted to be masked by some overgrown plants. We booked this resort for our 4 year anniversary and are phoenix locals. We love to stay in the resorts in town and support local businesses. This hotel is no where near 4 stars, and unfortunately would classify this hotel near a motel 6 with how dated and dirty it was. The one positive thing I can say is that we did request a refund and were accommodated. Which we appreciate very much for that kindness.
reviews.author: Kerri Loucks

reviews.text: Building feels outdated, rooms are nice but bathroom is small. I wasn't explained anything like where the pool is or what I can enjoy while staying there at check in ...more like here's they the key. I liked the patio the room had. They gave us a room right in front of the laundry room so we could hear people going in and out. Guests at the pool were extremely loud and there was a cockaroach on top of our T.V.......just not what i would expect for the price they charge....sure the lobby and restaurant area are nice. I wouldn't stay here again.
reviews.author: Susie Madrueno

reviews.text: Beautiful lobby and fun pool area.  Rooms have a cute vibe but could use some touch-ups. Front desk staff were more interested in socializing with each other than greeting guests which was a missed opportunity to provide a great first experience.  The restaurant food is mediocre at best---recommend making reservations at one of the many fab restaurants nearby.     Highly recommend spending the money for a room that looks towards the pool.  Ours looked out to a parking lot with a dirt patio that was equivalent to a Motel 6.  It also gave access to other rooms' patios (we were on the ground floor) which felt incredibly unsafe.
reviews.author: Erin Malone

reviews.text: I had a ladies' get together/reunion. This hotel is so pretty and every corner is picture perfect. It was candy for the eyes. The value was good too! We had a great time. Had daily iced coffee and scrambled eggs at the bar every morning and ate 2 lunches in their pretty lounge and restaurant. We had dinner at nearby Toca Madera which was delicious and had a cool vibe for dinner.
reviews.author: Katie S

reviews.text: Excellent rooms and poolside fun
reviews.author: Amy J

reviews.text: Resort was phenomenal! Beautiful, relaxing, up to date decor, staff was extremely hospitable. Hannah was very accommodating, sweet, friendly, knowledgeable and gave wonderful restaurant recommendations. We will definitely tell our friends about this place. Thank you for an amazing vacation!
reviews.author: Megan Thompson

reviews.text: This resort is SO incredible!! I loved everything about this place!! So beautiful and the staff was great!
reviews.author: Eryn Vargo

reviews.text: Pool is great, don’t waste your money on the spa. Was rushed along the massage and then was told they automatically charge 20% gratuity. Would not recommend the spa
reviews.author: Vivaan T

reviews.text: What a stay! My wife and I stayed here for our honeymoon and it was great! Perfectly located between fashion square and camelback mountain there’s plenty to do for everyone! The staff was kind and friendly, especially the pool staff! They even remembered  us after our first day! Overall great experience and would totally recommend!
reviews.author: Nathan Milar

reviews.text: This is a great place to stay. Clean rooms and great relaxing pools.
reviews.author: Will Glause

reviews.text: Love this place 🥰
reviews.author: Suzanne Avina

reviews.text: My toddler loved the decor.... he thought rearanging the indoor rocks and walking through the wedding and the shower were great fun <oops>
reviews.author: Sunshine Harrison

reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for a 3 year wedding Anniversary trip. When we arrived we had been upgraded to the Presidential Suite. It was a beautiful room. We had the best time at the pool with drink service. Our room was always spot less when we arrived back after it was cleaned. The location is perfect for walking down to Old Town, Fashion Square & Night Clubs. The aesthetics of this place are SO PERFECT!!
reviews.author: Natalie Ingle

reviews.text:
Looks of the lobby and pool are good…but the rooms are equivalent to motel 6.  They’re old and you can hear EVERYTHING.  Staff won’t do anything about music and loud parties during quiet hours.  We stayed at a discounted group rate and it still wasn’t worth the price.
Our room wasn’t ready at the 4pm checkin time and housekeeping pressured us twice to leave before the 11am checkout.
We won’t be staying at The Scott again.
reviews.author: Erika Corrigan

reviews.text: such a relaxing place staff was super friendly cant wait to go back
reviews.author: shelly hyatt

reviews.text: Hotel was awesome and so beautiful. Everyone was kind but a special shout out to Chase the bell man/valet who took us to a few places in the complementary shuttle, he was soooo amazing!!! Very knowledgeable about the area and fun to ride with. We had a great time but he made it even better! We will be back Forsure and asking if he is available to help. Thanks again Chase.
reviews.author: Megan Mongeau

reviews.text: About to check out and I loved it.
reviews.author: John Austin

reviews.text: We love this place !
reviews.author: Drew Hodson

reviews.text: Beware, this place is not even close to as advertised! The Scott is way over priced, at best it's a 2 star hotel. Very old, poor smell, we literally did not even unpack. A solid no, we left immediately and went to the Andaz for the same price.
reviews.author: Michelle Markham

reviews.text: My group and I were told by the front desk that we would get a free shuttle to the shopping center, which was about 5 minutes down the road. When we got into the car, the guy that was driving us told us we owe him $30 when we arrived at the shopping center. We could have walked or gotten cheaper transportation using Uber or Lyft.
reviews.author: Savannah Stitts

reviews.text: Perfect spot for our girls getaway! The rooms are very stylish and you get the feeling of being in Cuba from the time you walk in the lobby. We dined at the Canal Club and the atmosphere was perfect. The pool area is broken up so it doesn't feel like your near two other pools.
reviews.author: Vera Gonzales

reviews.text: Excellent staff and wonderful accommodations. I will definitely come back!
reviews.author: Tammy Belton-Davis

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, the food and catering did a great job and the service was excellent.
reviews.author: Rich

reviews.text: Great food and drinks!!! Also great pool
reviews.author: Joe Jorgensen

reviews.text: Great place to stay with awesome staff and service.
reviews.author: Carrie MacKenzie

reviews.text:
Great experience, overall. Would like to see front desk and Canal Club better staffed. We either couldn't get service or waited a while for someone to show up.

Would also recommend a coffee bar of some kind (similar to what's done with iced tea and water) since the Canal Club doesn't up until 7am for coffee.

Had a great time. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Janice Zielinski

reviews.text: This is a really nice hotel with a very chill vibe. Every corner smells great with their signature fresh beach air freshener. Only negative is that it is a lot more expensive than other hotels in the area.
reviews.author: Marie Ekpema

reviews.text: Pool was filthy. We'd picked this location for our 20th anniversary weekend, ordering a romance package (chocolate covered strawberries and champagne)..they were never delivered, even after going to the front desk and discussing it. For $600+/night, we figured it'd be better than it was. Will not stay here again.
reviews.author: Kevin Almeida

reviews.text: My Massage was very relaxing! The pools were nice and well kept. I ordered a wrap from the pool and it was good! They also have yummy cocktails. The ambiance and vibes are 10/10. I love this place!
reviews.author: Victoria Marek

reviews.text: The hotel has an amazing lobby and pool area. There is also plenty of comfortable stylish seating in the courtyard for enjoying a nice day or night outside. The hotel staff was very accommodating and the hotel even offered shuttle services around town. We stayed in a king patio room, which was very spacious in the bedroom. The only cons are the rooms are not as updated as the hotel website shows. The bathrooms were sacrificed to accommodate such a large bedroom area. The ceilings are maybe 6ft tall. Overall, I would recommend the Scott if you're looking to socialize with friends or enjoy being outside at the pool areas. The bar inside the hotel was great and there was live music in the lobby. The had plenty of seating and fun games spread around the lobby. Would absolutely book again.
reviews.author: Darryl S

reviews.text:
What a great place to enjoy drinks with friends! The menu has a bit of everything for everyone. Drinks are expertly mixed. The ambience is just right. Love the tropical theme.

As a local, I would recommend this place to anyone wanting to experience something unique in their travels.

Walking distance from Fashion Square and Old Town.
reviews.author: Diego O'Farrill

reviews.text: I really love this pool and patio area. You really feel like your in a topical location!
reviews.author: Bill Radke

reviews.text: Beautiful resort, very Cuban with a mix of Palm Springs and Hawaii vibes. It is in need of some minor repairs and staff but much of the industry is having a hard time hiring at this point in time. Staff was happy and helpful, made excellent drinks and was very accommodating.
reviews.author: Chris Garvey

reviews.text: The meeting rooms were far too cold because of excessive and wasteful air conditioning.  I don't know the source of the energy that is used for the air conditioning.  If the spa generates its own energy from solar, which should be a no brainer in AZ, then I am not so bothered (except for having to wear a coat in the meeting rooms).  But if the energy is from fossil fuels, then given the incredible threat of climate change, the extreme air conditioning is no only irresponsible, but it's also unpatriotic.
reviews.author: Barbara Simons

reviews.text: Excellent
reviews.author: Flynn Phillips

reviews.text: Our friend was physically and verbally assaulted on Saturday night by the valet driver. If you like to spend over $1,000 on food and drinks with a side of abuse, this establishment is for you! If not, 0/10 would not recommend.
reviews.author: Audrey Griffin

reviews.text: I was physically and verbally assaulted on Saturday night by the valet driver after spending over $1,000 here in dinner and drinks. Do not recommend.
reviews.author: Audrey

reviews.text: We stayed at the Scott Resort for a "staycation" here in Scottsdale.  The hotel is very professional, has a great ambience, and the style is a ton of fun.  Definitely check out the Scott if you are looking for places to stay in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Jason Kane

reviews.text: Overall the property and location were nice. We were disappointed with the level of service. Service was very slow for food and beverages. Getting coffee in the morning from bar/restaurant was a 30 minute wait. For the hotel and price, we had higher expectations for the service. The bellman were great, though, and so was our spa experience.
reviews.author: Tracey Bokermann

reviews.text:
Pool was horrible each day with tree droppings.  They didn't clean it throughout the day/our stay.  Kind of gross to try to swim and have tree droppings everywhere on you.  Clean room - but by busy road so the morning traffic was terrible.  With a little better attention to details could be a very nice place.

Food priced a little high for quality but was good.  Drinks were very overpriced and they didn't have the liquor we wanted for our drinks - EVER!  Doesn't seem to keep any top shelf liquor in the bar.  If this is an upper level hotel/spa - top shelf liquor should be standard; not an exception.  50/50 on whether we will return again due to pricing and level of service.  Clean - no bugs in sight!  Very comfy beds.  Towels not the softest but clean and plenty of them.  Wanted to do the spa experience with my daughter (mother/daughter vacay!!) but the pricing kept us from experiencing that.
reviews.author: Sue Felix

reviews.text: Lugar exelente
reviews.author: Alberto Garlobo

reviews.text: Loved the atmosphere.
reviews.author: Elvy Rocha

reviews.text: Laid back resort. well located and nice pool area. Food and beverage options and service in general OK but not amazing.  Rooms are nice. Spa was fully booked prior to our arrival so we did not get to participate in any of those services.
reviews.author: cbeyre

reviews.text: The Scott confirmed my disappointment with the resort experience.  It is ridiculous to pay a resort fee and not be able to get a seat at the pool!  I ended up reserving and paying for a cabana to ensure we had a seat....an additional $300 on top of a resort fee?!?  Insane.  Time to change things....maybe impose a time limit in the seats, break up time in a cabana (who needs the entire day??) and charge less for each session...until then, I would not return or recommend The Scott if you plan to use the pool.
reviews.author: Nicole Goodwin

reviews.text: Sadly, we were very disappointed with our stay. We planned a 40th bday girls trip and made reservations 6 months in advance. We requested that the two rooms be adjoining. Despite the advance notice of 6 months, the hotel wasn't unable to accommodate this request, and didn’t really provide a reason why, so our group was separated during our stay. A friend who wasn’t able to make the trip sent a gift basket for our room. The employees at the front desk signed for it, but never delivered it/stole it. Additionally, the hotel restaurant was apparently unable to handle the hotel occupancy as there wasn’t food available at the pool for much of our stay. Normally this wouldn’t be an issue but there was no other close by option for food. We ended up having to order Uber eats in order to have meals throughout the day. For a hotel that’s $600 a night, the whole experience was underwhelming. When I shared these complaints with the hotel, the response was “sorry, we hope you book another stay.” No thanks.
reviews.author: Kelsey

reviews.text: The hotel has some problems with internal communication and kitchen. We went for a 3 nights girls weekend and the food at the hotel was so disappointed. Waiting two hours to get the food for breakfast was definitely not ok. We tried to get lunch and the waitress at the pool said that they were cut off. (Still don't understand). The Barthenders are the only best think about this hotel! For the price on the rooms I think you can stay in another hotel!.
reviews.author: Gyna O'Grady

reviews.text: Don't waste your time or money. Over priced. Understaffed. The kitchen closes everyday because they can't keep up with the number of orders they get, supposedly.
reviews.author: Simon Baker

reviews.text: The Scott is a great resort located close to everything in Scottsdale. The Spa is incredible. Easily the best massage I've had.
reviews.author: Garrett Sprague

reviews.text: Chelsea is the only reason I keep coming back to the Scott/Canal Club. She is unbelievable!!!! Her level of service is better than any service I’ve ever had. Don’t come here unless you ask for her, she is THE best!!!!!!
reviews.author: Brianna Openlander

reviews.text: Lots of people commented on the poor, slow service, so wish I would have read the reviews before coming.  Travelled around the world in many nice hotels and it feels like the service here is worse than anything I’ve experienced.  Expected to order lunch at the pool & they closed down order lunch because they are too backed up like this is perfectly normal.  Breakfast at the canal was a train wreck & the servers looked like they worked at Dennys.  Seriously, this place is way overpriced with terrible service.  Shocking really.  And for the person who responses to our posts informing everyone what a terrible place this is your watered down comments and appreciated out feedback is in authenticity otherwise you would fix this disaster of a hotel service.
reviews.author: Wendy Larson

reviews.text: worst hotel experience my family has ever had.....and we travel a lot, from luxury properties, to hip boutique properties, to 2 star properties for soccer tournaments, etc...   its hard to describe how bad this place is.  the property itself is an attempt at renovating an old 70's appartment building and for us it completely missed the mark.  the real issue is it is a disaster operationally.  we had two rooms that were supposed to be quiet, yet we were literally on top of a very loud wedding one night with thumping music until 1 am.  there were loud corporate events right outside our balcony the other nights.  the food and beverage service was ridiculous.....to no servers so you couldn't sit in an empty restaurant to literally waiting over 75 minutes for a cobb salad b/c the kitchen kept getting the order wrong.  the pool is a total zoo filled with tatted up wannabe hipsters who put towels out first thing in the morning so literally nowhere to sit when our kids went to the pool at 10 am.  while the website looks cool.....avoid this hotel at all costs.
reviews.author: Scott Potter

reviews.text: NOT worth the money. Motel style, rude managers, horrible communication skills with the front desk/manager, long waits to eat in the restaurant. However, great food if you order room service and the bell staff was friendly.
reviews.author: Priya Bhalla

reviews.text: The beds were super cozy, excellent amenities in the room and wonderful service in the restaurants & pool. I will definitely be coming back :)
reviews.author: S K

reviews.text: If I could leave zero stars I would. Horrible service from the front door to the restaurant to the pool to the room. If you’re looking for a good time at the pool *with* frozen drinks, honestly just leave and go to the San Marcos in Chandler. Ask for Jordan at the pool bar.
reviews.author: Breanna Castro

reviews.text: The rooms had handles and fixtures falling off the walls. Room size was adequate. The bed was very uncomfortable. The TV has chromecast but no internet tv options like Netflix. The air conditioning was terrible. Outside the room, the resort was very nice and the service was very friendly. The bar closes fast too early at 10pm but they make very tasty drinks with a decent variety. The conference rooms are spacious and offer a lot of you're attending a convention.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.text: Great resort
reviews.author: David Miller

reviews.text: Not a great resort for a family with kids, would be good for a couples retreat or couples getaway. Wish house keeping kept the room clean more than just every other day and if the resort doesn't see your text for fresh towels or linens or if you don't text in the morning you probably will not receive fresh towels or linens. The resort has potential but also has a lot it can improve on.
reviews.author: Steve Arnold

reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and great location!  Friendly and helpful staff!  My only suggestion would be to have a self-serve coffee station in the lobby since it's easy to run out of the in-room Nespresso pods, and there was always a long line to get coffee from the bar in the mornings.
reviews.author: Jared Joella

reviews.text:
We arrived at 7pm. They gave away our prepaid room. The coffee machine was broken and took two days to replace. No coffee service in the lobby. Had to order at the bar and pay for it. No pre made coffee had to order from the espresso machine.  No service at all.  Had to order food at
The bar and the food was passable at best.  The Manager was a grumpy Gus each time we saw her.  When checking out there was no smile, no thank you, no  I hope you enjoyed your stay.  It was the most inhospitable hotel I have ever stayed at.  And for the price totally not worth it.  The grounds are pretty? The rooms are tired.
reviews.author: Jennie Engen

reviews.text:
If you love bad service, The Scott is for you!

From overbooking, to inability to get seated at the hotel restaurant (that is half-full), impossibility of getting a drink at the bar (which only has 3 of the 10 seats occupied), and the flat out refusal to clean the room and restock the minibar... your entire stay will be the worst experience of your life.

5-stars for the lobby, -4 stars for the services. Final score 1 star.

Tips for management: Foster ‘teamwork.’ Make “service with a smile” the mantra. Tell the servers to smile and serve, clean the rooms, staff appropriately, hire qualified staff, BUS the tables, allow guests to order through their phones from their seats to minimize the burden on servers. Add a self-serve coffee bar. Put a full-time manager on the floor to lead this circus. Stop apologizing and handing out gift vouchers and start providing excellent service.
reviews.author: Anthony DElia

reviews.text: Had drinks. Atmosphere good. Service lacking.
reviews.author: Mike Swift

reviews.text: This resort is in the perfect location. Walking distance to Fashion Square and Old Town Scottsdale. We loved our stay here.
reviews.author: Abigail Jennings

reviews.text: Overrated.. This place gets a ton of hype because the photos look onstagramable, but really disappointed with the service. We stayed here for 4 days. The room was alright, but our sink  owl in the bathroom was cracked, and the hallways smell rancid. The maid didn't even make our bed during the stay or throw our trash out.  The breakfast and lunch service was terrible, we waited over 15 minutes just to get a drink. One server forgot about my order on another day. One another night our friends hosted a party, and the hotel had one server on staff for 50+ people. All of her guests had to go to the bar, manned by two people. This place is lacking in management and service for the premium +$400 per night. If you are going to pay 5 star prices, you should have 5 star service.
reviews.author: Paulina Cronin

reviews.text: Very relaxing and enjoyable stay.  Attentive and friendly staff.  Awesome pool area
reviews.author: Brent Wilford

reviews.text: A recent gal pal long weekend was well spent in the luxury of The Scott Resort & Spa. Starting the mornings off with yoga on the lawn followed by a delicious breakfast on the patio and a day at the pool cabana was divine! The nearby shopping center provided entertainment on an unexpected rainy day. Exploring local restaurants by evening wrapped up a day well spent! Friendly staff, clean & safe environment! We can't wait to return when we make this an ANNUAL event!
reviews.author: Lori Reed Creative

reviews.text: Beds are very uncomfortable.  If you like a firm mattress, stay away from here.
reviews.author: Gabriel Lucas

reviews.text:
Don't judge a hotel by it's lobby!  What can I say, it's GORGEOUS.  The wow factor stops there.  It's like a girl with no substance.  I really wanted to love it.
Food is okay.  Alcohol selection is meh. Front desk girls are really nice and accommodating.

Let's talk about the room now.  It was just okay.

Let's get to the housekeeping, oh that's right, what housekeeping?  Room service dishes all up and down the hall for days (not hours).  When we asked why our room wasn't cleaned, they informed us it would be cleaned the following day (every other due to C19, say what?).  The following evening we came back to the same dirty room!  When my husband called the front desk, they said, oh...it should have been cleaned. Let us call you right back.  NO CALL BACK 30 min later.  I decided to clean myself, then let the front desk manager know what I thought about it.  Craziness.

Save your $$$!!!!  This is not resort style hospitality or luxury.
reviews.author: Lisa Lazar

reviews.text:
We had a really disappointing experience from basically start to finish. At check-in our room wasn’t ready until about an hour after the expected checkin time. We booked a suite which the online photos completely misrepresented. We were given adjoining rooms, not a suite and when I asked the front desk about it, they took back the second room but didn’t adjust our price. We way, way overpaid for a king room.

The kitchen and bar closed down over the weekend, due to some emergency maintenance, which I know if unavoidable but I think greater measures could have been made to make guests comfortable.

Pool service was nonexistent, though I saw other guests getting food brought to them.

We were also surprised to come back to our room that hadn’t received housekeeping service. When we called we were told they only clean the room every three days. This is unacceptable. Especially if it’s not communicated upon booking or at check in.

Internet never worked. Was sent in a loop trying to login and never actually successfully connected to the internet.

This felt like a place locals come to take trendy pictures not somewhere out of town guests looking for a high end, relaxing weekend should visit.
reviews.author: Heather Wheeler

reviews.text:
I paid for a 5-Star experience and ended up with a 2-Star experience. The room service, the food, the bar, the hours of operation and lack of professional staff made me feel like I was staying at a low quality motel with a pretty lobby!
Save your money and stay near places with good food and bars.
reviews.author: maz jamasbi

reviews.text: Staying here now.  Rooms are dated but clean.  Can't get into restaurant and in room dining only ever goes to voicemail and calls never returned.  Went to the to restaurant to ask about dining and food service and the staff was rude and indifferent.  Won't ever return.
reviews.author: Josh Belk

reviews.text: My wife loves this place. Definitely gotta boss up and take us here sometime soon
reviews.author: Deonte Marchena

reviews.text:
We stayed for one night at The Scott and were disappointed. The service is equivalent to what you would expect at a fast food chain, without actually being able to eat or drink. The servers are rushed and appear unavailable even during slow hours. We attempted to eat breakfast at the Canal Club this morning and were unable to order at the pool, bar, and within the seated areas. Ironically- while we were checking out a group of girls were complaining to management about a similar situation and were offered free room service. However even the room service is unavailable, we attempted multiple times and were placed on hold.

We stayed in a standard room. The interior design is beautiful however it appears to be slapped on what was previously a motel. The AC was broken and our “balcony view” was of the Scottsdale street. What is most frustrating is the price point- this was worth 200/night at best and even then I’ve had better experiences at a Holiday Inn. For how many wonderful resort and spas are in the Scottsdale area spare yourself and your wallet this headache. On a positive note- the  shared space in the lobby and by the pool are beautiful and would make for gorgeous photo ops. My suggestion- come for a picture, don’t stay here, and maybe you’ll get a drink at a bar if you’re lucky and patient.
reviews.author: Taylor Maramara

reviews.text: Awesome.
reviews.author: Nick D.

reviews.text: Overrated and over priced. Rooms are dated and service is extremely slow! Plenty of other options near by. Not a fan, will not return. Location is great if your visiting old town but that's about the only positive thing I can mention. If your looking for slow service this is the place for you! Lobby is nice however.
reviews.author: javier campos

reviews.text:
Pool area is spacious enough to not have small children around you if needed. It’s quiet, well maintained.
Rooms were great.
reviews.author: Darlene Ransom

reviews.text: Nice place to stay in downtown Old Town Scottsdale
reviews.author: Al Tracy

reviews.text: The hotel is really nice but the room’s bathroom could be a bit redone. There was a bit of mold in the shower and the toilet could use a bit more scrubbing.
reviews.author: Ainayi Alfonso

reviews.text: Overpriced. Service is terribly slow. We used the bar, the restaurant, the pool, and several amenities and there’s simply no justification for the price they charge for their rooms. This place is not a 4-star hotel. The rooms are dated, we stayed 4 nights and they didn’t clean our room once, and the rooms smelled. Save your money and stay somewhere else.
reviews.author: Bill Cronin

reviews.text: Great staff, relaxing atmosphere
reviews.author: Erik Triple Crown Chiropractic

reviews.text: Great meal in the Sunset Room with a friendly dining staff in an intimate environment. Had a little difficulty finding the proper room and most of the resort staff had no clue what I was referring to and there was no bulletin or notice of what events were taking place at the resort. That was really my only complaint. Otherwise staff was quite welcoming.
reviews.author: Dan Bare

reviews.text: Place is nice. Too much party life in this town in general though. If you’re traveling with kids, probably good idea to find a more kid friendly hotel/place/atmosphere. Otherwise the resort is very pretty. Also the heater/AC unit in the room emitted too much dust so we ended up not turning it on anymore. They do have a complimentary shuttle service which we loved.
reviews.author: Alex Anzhela

reviews.text: Beautiful place,  excellent food and great atmosphere.
reviews.author: PreciseTR

reviews.text:
Room poorly designed/layout. Would it kill you to put a radio in the room so one can listen to local news?
Common grounds are Great Spaces.
NOT A GOOD PLACE FOR CONFERENCES for which the attendees need to work.
And what is up with all the Bauhaus books in the lobby? Haven't they read Tom Wolfe? If Bauhaus is so great, why not renovate the Scott to look like a box of concrete? Oh wait, maybe the Bauhaus influence has made the rooms unusable for working...
reviews.author: Timothy Slaper

reviews.text: This is a 2-3 start hotel at best. The price is WAY TOO much for what you get. Rooms are dated, and minimal. You really don't get anything above and beyond for staying here. Choose another hotel across the street for half price and you'll be happier. We stayed her 7 years ago, and it was awesome. Pools were fun to hang at, but the price was right. We felt like we got what we paid for. For $500 a night I can stay at a Ritz Carlton.
reviews.author: Enrico Dolcecore

reviews.text: Nice place, but woefully understaffed.
reviews.author: Eric Heikkila

reviews.text: Wonderful resort with amazing amenities and features! Pool is one of the best in Phoenix and the lobby and bar are chic and fun!
reviews.author: John Dugas

reviews.text: Beautiful property and friendly staff. The rooms, dining, and bar are all exceptional.
reviews.author: A.G. Stockstill

reviews.text: Looks can be deceiving…
reviews.author: Nick Jones

reviews.text: Great place
reviews.author: Bohnny Bravo

reviews.text: 4 words.  Lipstick on a pig!
reviews.author: Rachel Mosher

reviews.text:
Not worth it for $675 a night. Lobby and outdoor area is great however the rooms  are rough and the service is less than satisfactory.

Air conditioning didn’t work properly even with maintenance called. Toilet barely flushed. Shower flooded the bathroom. Pillows are awful.

Stood at the bar for TEN MINUTES (middle of the day while it was slow) until someone noticed me as they were too busy standing in a circle in the corner talking.  Same with the restaurant almost 20 minutes for a server to come to the table. Another 25 minutes for a club soda which came after the meal..

Very disappointed.
reviews.author: Kristina Pizzanelli

reviews.text: Beautiful pool and lobby. Rooms were kinda rough for the price. Our air never worked properly even after 2 maintenence visits. And our room had a smell the whole time we were there. Didn't want to move because we were next door to friends. For the price, I expected the rooms to be nicer.
reviews.author: Amy Daws

reviews.text: Nice hotel, staff was friendly
reviews.author: Ian Shackleton

reviews.text: Great hotel
reviews.author: Josh Dye

reviews.text:
The Scott Resort is incredible! We came for a week and had an amazing experience from start to finish. The ambiance and aesthetic is stunning, no detail has been overlooked from the lighting to the decor to the music and well-manicured grounds.

We found the food and drinks to be outstanding - Sunday brunch was the best! Our room was clean, comfortable and beautiful and all of the staff were friendly and helpful.

We will be returning to The Scott Resort for years to come!
reviews.author: Becky Y.

reviews.text: This review is for anyone thinking of booking The Scott for a business or large event like a wedding. Take your business elsewhere! In November, my company had booked meetings at the hotel for four nights this month. When the Omicron variant struck two of our attendees were exposed to the virus. To avoid risking all of our leadership team from being exposed, which would devastate our business, we had to cancel. Although we were told this is a small family run business, we were left to talk to two middle management sales people who had no empathy or customer service. We were told that the most that could be done was to give us credit for $5k of $26k spent, but the credit would only apply if we spent another $26k total on the future event.  We asked for a full credit toward a future event and they said no. They didn’t care that we would be repeat customers as we do these meetings annually. So warning to anyone thinking of this hotel or any other property owned by this group in Arizona and California, don’t book your meeting or event here! You have many better choices. My company will never give this hotel chain our business again. I rarely give a bad review, but this place takes the cake. All you need to do is read all the canned responses from the hotel to the poor reviews they are getting to see that they just don’t care (edit after my initial review: note the canned response below).
reviews.author: John Webber

reviews.text: I had brunch here over the weekend and the food and atmosphere was great. I needed some additional help and a cute employee, Bella, was able to assist and make my time there enjoyable. Thanks and look forward to coming back!
reviews.author: Luke Moffatt

reviews.text: Every corner of this resort is absolutely gorgeous! The service and staff are very kind and we felt attended to even when it was busy. Stefan at the front desk always connected with us when we arrive and gave us great recommendations. Definitely would love to return here again and again.
reviews.author: Megan Lemay

reviews.text: Look no further for your Scottsdale stay. This is the best resort I’ve stayed at! The location, food, and service are excellent. The outdoor pool and hot tub are lovely. Will definitely be coming back!
reviews.author: jacque steffen

reviews.text: Brings back a special time in life growing up and this place takes the cake for the week of easy accessable to shopping areas ,nice quiet place to lay my head. And chill
reviews.author: Michael Pierce

reviews.text: My stay at The Scott was a whole vibe. The Scott was giving Havana vibes like as if you’re not in Arizona. As you walk in you’re greeted with the smell of aromatherapy oils through the lobby and hallways. I also liked that the music playlist just play the right songs throughout the day. The choice of music was good that I asked the guy out front who created the playlist.(lol) I also liked the shallow pool that has sand at the beginning of the pool. It’s so many good things that I liked about The Scott. Just visit The Scott and you can see for yourself. I feel like The Scott will be my first choice to stay while visiting Scottsdale. I almost forgot it’s a old car out front that just fit the whole Cuban Vibe.
reviews.author: Crystal El-Bey

reviews.text: Great atmosphere, great location :)
reviews.author: Melanie Porter

reviews.text:
The photos doesn't reflect the reality of the place.
Very expensive and it's not that luxurious.  I wish they can learn from hotels in Dubai and Riyadh how to make luxurious experience for the guests.
The restaurant is less than good. Food choices are limited and not delicious.
The check in is 4 pm and check out is 11. I don't know how come they ask guests to leave in the morning!
They charge you extra just to put you on a half pool view.
reviews.author: Abdulhakim Sabur

reviews.text:
We had a quick lovely stay here at the newly renovated Scott Resort which used to be a Kimpton property.
First impressions are that this place knows high end service: the interior lobby is beautiful with a sort of Miami vibe and the grounds are quite lovely.
I had asked about price matching and it doesn’t appear they do that - at least not for Hotel Tonight? Seemed a little strange to me considering most hotel chains encourage you to book directly and inquire about price matching. We ended up paying much more than I would have through HT (about $100+ or so), but the check in clerk upgraded our room since we booked direct. We did very much appreciate that.
Our 15 pound cutie of all cutiest dog stayed with us. Fees for pups are $100 per visit; I’d say it’s worth it if you stay multiple nights.
The room was beautiful and clean. We loved the decor very much. And the bed… oooo it was wonderful.
Where I think there is room for improvement would be the staff at the Cabana Club who all seemed very green - tables were not bussed (I’d say more than half had dirty plates left on them) and the cocktails weren’t made well or the recipe needed improvement (on the Paloma specifically). But the bartender was attentive and patient, allowing me to taste the different red wines (selection was v nice).
All things considered, I’d stay here again. It’s walking distance to Nobu, the Scottsdale Fashion Square and many other yummy restaurants. Wish I had taken more photos to share with you especially of the room. The room was exquisite.
reviews.author: Katie Dellegrotti

reviews.text: Awesome
reviews.author: Jesse Almeida

reviews.text: 19-22Dec.'21-The Scott Resort/Spa, Room 262 was captivatingly comfortable, with an exciting Cuban flare and relaxing scenic view from the balcony. The restaurant's decor and food was very authentic Cuban. It's on my list of returns, ie. Scottsdale, AZ.
reviews.author: gloria lewis

reviews.text: This place is so great!! Nothing but great memories here visited 2x now for a company Christmas party and was not let down the food was amazing especially the braised beef. The rooms are beautiful they have a separate vanity area. Very nice outside patio overall enjoyed all the amenities this place has to offer
reviews.author: Victoria Humphrey

reviews.text:
The resort is fine - but fine is unacceptable when you're paying US$500 per night for a room in my opinion. My two biggest complaints are that 1.) housekeeping only comes every other day - what?? We stayed for 6 nights and therefore our room was cleaned twice. Never in my lifetime of staying at hotels ranging from 2-5 stars have I experienced housekeeping every other day and definitely not for $500/night! 2.) There are two pools that are completely shaded. We came to Scottsdale for the sun and the fact that you couldn't catch a single ray of sun at the pool from the time it rose until the time it set felt disappointing. Some proper pruning is an easy solution here.

Overall, the hotel is instagrammable, sure but that's pretty much all it's got going for it. I won't be going back.
reviews.author: Rebecca Harris

reviews.text: We stayed with a group of friends. Had a fantastic time. The facility is well-maintained and the pool is fantastic. Would definitely come again.
reviews.author: Jason Ryszka

reviews.text: Facilities are comparable to a slightly dated Marriott. Feels like service training is led by someone that learned their craft in the fast food industry. As you look around you get the sense that there was a discount price you weren’t aware of. You can tell this place was created for the insta crowd. If you care about taking a couple of cool pics and pretending you were at a nice resort this place is for you. Many great resorts in the area if you want to stay at a legitimate resort.
reviews.author: tom elkins

reviews.text: Did a conference here. Such a beautiful place.
reviews.author: Sharon Rueckert

reviews.text: The front office staff was unprofessional, and the hotel is below average. They do a good job of dressing this place up in the pics but this hotel falls short in many categories. There are much better options in the Scottsdale area.  Do yourself a favor and choose a different hotel.
reviews.author: Shane Harper

reviews.text:
I came for my birthday. My stay was okay. I'm happy I tried it out. I don't think I'd stay again. If you're coming here with people and don't expect to use the wifi/TV at all then it's worth your stay. For me, I came alone and wanted to watch TV at night which was awful given the wifi/TV situation.

Pros: The place is very cute/great for pics.  The food was good. The staff were very nice. It was clean.

Cons: The wifi only works for 50 minutes then resets/disappears for 10 full minutes...like clock work, so I couldn't really stream TV very well and since I'm not tracking the exact 50 minutes it's up, it got pretty annoying even just to Google things. The wifi even went out as I was typing this review 😂. I tried two different rooms because the TV was kind of broken is each room.

The rooms are like a renovated motel (look up the June Motel on Netflix) so not a resort style I'm use to. I'd call it a botique hotel.
reviews.author: Morgan

reviews.text: Facilities were grossly understaffed (or at least the staff on hand could not handle the volume). For such a pricy, supposed "4 star resort", I was extremely disappointed. And honestly - I felt sorry for the staff. They seemed completely unsupported. I can give some specific examples. For starters, the check-in area is tiny and cannot handle large groups. Bad layout. On a busy Saturday, the Kitchen Manager apparently stopped all food orders at the Canal Club bar so nobody could order any food from the bar. Drinks were also pretty backed up, but again they seemed understaffed and the bartender was doing the best she could and friendly. The restaurant hostess, on the other hand, was rude and unprofessional. We approached her for seating and she was on her phone and we had to get her attention. We were told it was a 30min wait, even though there were tons of open tables. A couple after us was told 10min and when I questioned her she said, "I thought there were 4 of you", which there were clearly only 2 of us standing there. No waitress EVER came to our table and after 20min we went and hunted one down. They were also very overwhelmed and explained there were no sections assigned and they didn't know we'd been seated (again- hostess fail, but still they should have checked on us). Once we finally got our food, it was very good but I wouldn't say worth all the hassle and wait time. The only real positive thing I have to say is check out was very easy and there was a very friendly, helpful man that worked on getting us a car; very professional and constantly updating us. He gets a gold star, but the resort management gets a giant thumbs down.
reviews.author: Stacey Moore

reviews.text: Here for a conference. The hotel is beautiful, the staff seems friendly, and the coffee is great!
reviews.author: James Dryburgh

reviews.text: Came here on a resort pass. While relaxing place to spend the day, don’t expect much from the poolside service. Frequently forgot about our orders and took almost 2 hours only to receive the wrong menu item. Taste just ok. I have had much better elsewhere at much cheaper hotels.
reviews.author: Brianna Marie

reviews.text: This place is beautiful. Staff are welcoming. Would definitely come back.
reviews.author: Deejay C

reviews.text:
It was just okay. I will say beds are comfortable and pool is fine food ok. But ageee with Zachary m. As far as the front desk doesn’t really care or go out of their way with any assistance. And same with the pool staff.  I don’t like to be one of the ones that has to put a towel out at the pool by 8 am but it appears you do have to do that here.  I have enjoyed pools when attendants help you set up your spot and let you know if you leave
please let them know. So that not a ton towels just on lounges that no one has sat at for 2 hours.
Also they do charge 25$ Each extra
hour if u need a late checkout  -even with spa treatment?
reviews.author: julie gugel

reviews.text: Terrible customer service
reviews.author: Jack Walsh

reviews.text:
This place is ok.  The pool set up is nice.  The food catering is sub par (not sure if it was the hotel or external vendor to be fair). Had mosquitoes and may flies in my room.

Also, WiFi is really slow for those that might be interested in video conferencing.  My room phone's volume was really low so I had a lot of difficulty hearing the IT team that assisted me with my WiFi issues.  Front desk wasn't too interested in my concerns.  I doubt I'd come back here.
reviews.author: Zachary Moon

reviews.text: Just went for dinner but the lobby and dinning area was beautiful
reviews.author: Jade

reviews.text: when you look past the plants and esthetic you’ll see this hotel is putting all its hopes of success on the design (which is amazing, kudos to the design team) BUT The rooms, the bathrooms, the hallway, everything is straight up run down. It’s like they haven’t done a deep clean since their renovation and you can tell. Things are falling apart and growing crusty. Over the last 2 years I’ve stayed here at least 6-7 times and each time it gets worse. The staff at the bar (no matter when I’ve gone) are always rude, bouchée and care about socializing with each other then the people waiting. The pool looks great until you get in and see how nasty it is, the outdoor plants don’t even fit in their planters. Again, used to love this place, but this hotel is like the cool kid that’s hoping their coolness will take them far, but doesn’t actually have any substance. Great place for pictures and drunk shenanigans, but relaxing spa vibe? Not so much

reviews.text: Only stayed 1 night, thank goodness! The resort itself it aesthetically pleasing but our room was subpar, at best. Upon check in, we entered the hallway which had an odd smell and room service trays throughout the hallway on the floor. Our room had a very dirty smell (think dirty funky clothes) which was surprising considering the lobby smelled nice. We opened the balcony doors to air the smell out, which didn’t work. We called the front desk and asked about possibly changing our room to which they replied they would send housekeeping to our room. They knocked once and just opened the door, the woman who looked to me like a manager, walked around the room and sprayed ozone (an odor eliminating spray). Once she was done she said “there, your room is refreshed, thank you” and walked out. The sheets and/or blankets smelled of urine which was really gross. Given the cost of the rooms, this sucked! The restaurant has good food and the spa was great but we would never stay here again.

reviews.text: Do NOT have an event here! So incredibly overpriced, so many hidden fees, and very very poor communication. So much wasted $$$$ ! Stay AWAY!

reviews.text:
I was very disappointed with our recent stay at The Scott Resort especially considering how much we paid. The fact the pool area needed serious attention as far as cleanliness, and maintenance might be attributed to everyone's complaint with staffing during Covid, however it doesn't explain why it feels like nothing has been updated in years.
The rooms are nice, but half overlook the parking lot and the ones overlooking the pool really don't offer that much more that I had to pay extra for.
The food was pricey and everything seemed to be prepared heavy handed with too much salt, spice and grease.
It appears to be a very popular spot for young folks, so if that's your vibe you'll be happy with what you get, but if you are older and have traveled anywhere this is not a 4star resort by any means. The only reason I don't rate it a 2, is because the staff really seemed to try.

reviews.text: My boyfriend and I decided to finally take the plunge and plan a staycation at the scott. When we booked the room, we clicked on the room that had pictures of this beautiful space, with a nice bed. You know. Luxurious. The day comes and we get there a couple hours before check in to hang by the pool until our room was ready at 4. We ended up eating at the restaurant which was very good. We didn’t receive a text saying our room was ready until 4:30 which was slightly disappointing as the front desk lady in her words “guaranteed” it by 4. We go into our room to find our bed still on the wall. It was one of those fold to the wall beds. So I had to bring it down and of course there was no pillows. We had to call the front to request them. When we got there at 4:30 there were dirty dishes still outside our room from the last guest. We figured they would come get it. We then try and work our tv. The remote isn’t working so we went to the front. They told us they would send someone over. An hour comes and goes and no one comes. Our tv, instead of being mounted to the wall, was on this weird stand thing and guess what? The remote wasn’t working because the lip on the stand that holds the tv was covering the sensor. So if we wanted to change channels or turn the volume up or down, we had to get out of our mediocre bed and basically touch the remote to the tv to get it to work. We finally get annoyed with all this and my boyfriend decided to call the front again to explain nicely why we were frustrated. They said they would send someone for the dishes. Well we woke up in the morning and they were still there!! Not even ours. They stayed outside our door for an entire day. The bathroom was insanely tiny, the room itself was anything but what we would be expecting to be staying in at the resort since their pictures look so great. Not to mention I sat in one of their chairs they had in the room, and when I slid forward the seat part of it came unattached from the chair itself and I was stuck until my boyfriend came and helped me. I loved the atmosphere outside our room, super cute and tropical. But I was extremely disappointed. We were supposed to stay until one the next day, but we just left at 10:30 because we would rather go home than be there anymore. Over all just a really disappointing experience.
reviews.author: Raenie Burleson

reviews.text: We came here for our son's "micro-wedding."  Let me lead by saying that they did an AMAZING job making my son & his wile's day special.  The attention to detail by our "hostess" (Patti) and her concern for them was awesome.  The biggest knock we had over the few days we were there was the limited access to the restaurant and bar. Things just closed down too early or at odd hours.  The pool area was wonderful but generally crowded.  We would go back, yes!  And that is what really counts!
reviews.author: Jeff & Dana Clary

reviews.text: Fancy fun great pool and bar
reviews.author: mike K

reviews.text:
I booked this hotel because it was formerly the FireSky and the website looked really good. And it did live up to the media that was put out. The lobby is lovely, the grounds are wonderful. But it is not luxurious. The rooms are average, but they are decorated well. The bathrooms are small, it’s clean. But if you are looking for a truly luxurious stay you should try another hotel. I will say this, we were looking for a relaxing pool filled vacation after being home for over a year. The other guests skewed VERY young and they were clearly there to see and be seen. This is no longer what I consider fun, but if that is what you’re looking for, this is definitely the place for you.
The good: The hotel lobby and entrance is lovely and the grounds are well kept. The staff is extremely nice and accommodating and the hotel is clean. The pool service was excellent, especially Haley who remembered our last name and was very attentive despite being very busy. It's full of beautiful outdoor seating and the restaurant was nice.
The bad: Maid service in the room is only every 3rd day of the stay.  This is a very strange practice because if you’re there for a weekend you don’t get any maid service. My stay was from Thursday through Monday.  On Sunday there was still no maid service in the room so we called and asked and they came right away while we were in the pool. Prior to that we had to call and request toilet paper and fresh towels.
The pool was not good, which was the whole reason we were there.  It was outrageously crowded for an off-season time period. We were unable to get chairs unless we stood around and waited for people to leave. And for the first 3 days we could only get chairs at the "beach" pool. Which is the worst. That "sand" is burning hot and weird to walk into a pool on. We saw 4 people, including myself, fall when just stepping into the pool from the side. It's a 1ft drop, but the sand makes it ridiculously slippery. It's an ill conceived and poorly executed concept. I wouldn't have used that pool but we didn't have a choice. The other pool was FULL. Every day it was crazy crowded until Sunday. At that point things were great.
Also, on the second night we put our swimsuits on our first floor patio to dry. It was very nice and partially obscured, however, when we came back from dinner my white bikini top was missing. Someone clearly saw it and took it as there were 3 other swimsuits out there and that was the only piece missing. I reported it to the front desk and asked them to let me know if someone turned it in. No other assistance or compensation for the clothing was offered (not that I expected it, I'm the one who left my clothing outside unattended). I suspect it was one of the many bachelorette/bridal parties at the hotel. Everything was fine otherwise, the hotel is lovely, we had a good time, but our experience was not the best. I just chose poorly for the kind of stay that we were looking for.
reviews.author: Cicily K

reviews.text: Couldn’t check in on time room wasn’t ready along with several other people in the lobby having the same problem. Pool areas was covered in old used towels hard to tell what chairs were available everyday. Room wasn’t cleaned so had to go ask for cups and towels and room card didn’t work for outside doors. Not worth the price of the resort at all

reviews.text: The pool was overrun by people who didn't stay at the hotel. There were not enough sunbeds, everyone was on top of each other. Some people brought glass beer bottles, there were people lying by the pool in jeans and sneakers, like they didn't even bring swim suites. We never saw anyone checking  who came to the pool area and were left with a feeling that anyone can just wonder in off the street. The 'resort'' sells day passes, so perhaps this explains it. Although we didn't see anyone checking those either. This is most certainly not a 4-star hotel. Save yourself money, stay in Holliday inn, and just come here on a day pass. Seems like that's what every other person did. Although, given how crowded it was, Holliday inn pool might be more enjoyable.

The hotel rooms are cute but you can tell its older carpeting and infrastructure. The bed is cozy and our unit included a balcony with a few chairs. Recommend staying here if your out of town and want a great location in Scottsdale with a aesthetically cute environment.

The Scott is unique in that while it is part of a group of hotels (Classic Group and Hotels), each hotel has a completely unique design, and is managed directly by Classic Group to give each guest a beautiful botique experience! We loved our stay- highly recommend!

I didn't stay at The Scott but I spent two days enjoying the beautiful grounds, food and drinks from The Canal Club, and all the extremely helpful staff who assisted our group during the 3 day conference. It's such a romantic atmosphere I called my hubby and told them we'd be coming back! The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because I didn't stay at the resort but I'm sure they will get that extra star when my husband and I return!

reviews.text:
I would not recommend nor return to the resort.
The good- comfortable beds, pretty landscaping, good food. Close to old town.  Best for young couples and families.
The bad-customer service- 2 hour wait for our room, not responsive to turn down music in fitness room, locked out of our room on check out day even though we confirmed a late checkout.  Pool too crowded on the weekend. No chairs available. Very noisy. Not good for relaxation and older couples. Understaffed.
reviews.author: Steph B

reviews.text: The ideal guest here is someone who missed out on all four years of spring break and is looking to party.  It appeared as though ALL facility improvement money has gone to the street signage and lobby and nothing to the rooms.  They didn't have any sort of room cleaning because "Covid", yet they also had urinals overflowing in the main bathroom and crammed as many guests as they could around the tiny pools without restocking the clean pool towels past 11am.  Horribly managed property designed to maximize profits without regard to the impact to the guests.  Would never stay at a Scott property again...
